store_data.about_the_game:
Celestial Clash is a free-to-play online strategic card game inspired by the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West. Build a powerful deck, master the Five Elements, and challenge players from around the world.

────────────────────────────────

CHOOSE YOUR FACTION

────────────────────────────────

Four unique factions are available, each with a distinct identity and playstyle:

🌿 Flower Fruit Mountain – A wood and earth faction built around aggressive Disciple swarms and evolution chains. Summon monkey warriors and ascend them into legends.

🔥 Flaming Mountain – A fire and metal faction focused on disruption and recursion. Bounce enemy Disciples, control the board, and recycle key cards for repeated value.

⚗️ Tushita Palace – A fire and water faction wielding powerful Artifacts and spell synergies. Build up your arsenal and close games with overwhelming force.

👻 Underworld – A mysterious faction with unique mechanics centered around fate, sacrifice, and judgment. High risk, high reward.

────────────────────────────────

BUILD YOUR DECK

────────────────────────────────

Each deck contains 40 cards drawn from your chosen faction's pool. Combine Disciples (creatures), Spells, and Artifacts to create powerful synergies. Unlock additional factions and expand your collection using in-game Spirit Stones earned through ranked play.

────────────────────────────────

CORE GAMEPLAY

────────────────────────────────

Celestial Clash is a turn-based card game played on a shared board. On each turn:

• Draw cards and generate Mana to pay for your cards

• Summon Disciples to the field – they can attack the enemy Sect directly (Breakthrough) or challenge opposing Disciples (Duel)

• Cast Spells for instant effects, or deploy Artifacts for persistent advantages

• Use your Sect's unique Skill ability for a tactical edge

Master a rich set of keywords including Rush, Reckless, Evasion, Ward, Spellbind, and more. The Ascension system lets you evolve low-cost Disciples into powerful high-tier forms mid-game, creating dramatic momentum swings.

────────────────────────────────

GAME MODES

:

────────────────────────────────

🏆 Ranked Mode – Real-time 1v1 matchmaking. Climb the ladder from Qi Refinement through Foundation Building, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, God Transformation, Mahayana, and finally Heavenly Tribulation. Earn win streak bonuses and daily Spirit Stone rewards.

⚡ Tribulation Trial – A special roguelike challenge mode. Win 3 consecutive matches to complete the trial and claim rare rewards. One loss ends your run – can you go undefeated?

🤖 Practice vs AI – Hone your skills against AI opponents at any time.

────────────────────────────────

FREE TO PLAY – FAIR TO ALL

────────────────────────────────

All factions and cards are unlocked using Spirit Stones earned through gameplay. There are no randomized loot boxes and no pay-to-win mechanics. Every player competes on equal footing.

────────────────────────────────

FEATURES AT A GLANCE

────────────────────────────────

• 4 factions, 100+ unique cards

• Real-time online PvP matchmaking

• Full ranked ladder with 7 rank tiers

• Roguelike Tribulation Trial mode

• Deck builder with full card collection

• Replay system to review your matches

• Leaderboard to track top players

• Free to play with no pay-to-win

store_data.about_the_game:
🎮 Game Introduction

Doom Survivor: Horde Rush is an easy-to-pick-up yet strategically deep bullet hell survival game. You will take on the role of a post-apocalyptic hero, carving a path through relentless zombie hordes, defeating powerful mutated bosses, and protecting humanity's last hope!

The game features 18 progressively challenging difficulty levels, ranging from casual experiences to hardcore trials. Every battle tests your positioning, strategic combinations, and resource management. Collect gold and gems to unlock new heroes, new weapons, and new talents, and forge your ultimate firepower defense line!

⚔️ Hero System: 5 Post-Apocalyptic Heroes, 5 Combat Styles

Ada
A mysterious and beautiful agent, the starting hero with exceptional mobility! Boasting high movement speed, she synergizes best with attack speed, projectile count, and ricochet. Perfect for beginners to get a feel for the game and enjoy satisfying crowd clearing.

Leon
Ada's boyfriend. Every 3rd shot fires a fireball that deals 3 burning damage per second to enemies. A top-tier fire damage dealer; combine him with fire skills for a powerful, sustained burn build.

Alice
A clone hero. When an enemy dies, she fires a homing skull bullet that deals 5 damage to nearby foes. The core summoner hero. Pair her with summon-enhancing skills to turn the tables on the zombie horde with their own ammunition!

Wesker
Ada's colleague. Bullets deal an additional 3 lightning damage on hit. Combine with lightning skills for absolutely explosive, screen-clearing power. A top choice for players seeking pure, satisfying chaos.

Code:6B
A mass-produced AI. After dashing, leaves behind a phantom that wields a giant sword, dealing damage equal to your bullet damage to nearby enemies. This high-skill hero is perfect for players who enjoy impact skills and dash-focused weapon builds.

Each hero features a unique mechanic and talent direction, from fiery bursts and lightning clears to skull summons and phantom dashes. There's a playstyle waiting for you!

🏹 Weapon System: 11 Unique Weapons, Free Combination

Pistol
The starting weapon. Well-balanced in all aspects, a solid all-rounder suitable for any hero.

Shotgun
Short range but wide area of effect. An excellent tool for close-quarters crowd clearing.

Crossbow
Bullets pierce one enemy. While standing still, bullet damage increases over time. Resets upon moving. Suitable for fixed-position, high-damage playstyles.

Fire Gun
Bullets deal 3 burning damage per second to enemies hit. The perfect match for Leon, enabling a sustained burn build.

Dual Pistols
Fire two bullets simultaneously. High burst potential, ideal for players chasing high fire rates.

Dragon Lance
Fires dragon-shaped homing bullets that scale with summon damage bonuses! The top choice for summoner builds, perfect for Alice.

Grenade Launcher
Fires grenades that explode, dealing area-of-effect damage. A crowd-clearing powerhouse.

Bow
Fired arrows stick into the ground and are automatically retrieved after a while, dealing damage to enemies on their return flight. Highly tactical and excellent for players who enjoy strategic placement.

Laser Gun
A powerful ranged weapon that pierces through everything. Pure linear destruction.

Vacuum Blade
Rapidly fires sword waves dealing area-of-effect damage. Effective at both melee and range.

Alien Rifle
An extraterrestrial weapon. Fired bullets pierce through enemies and bounce off screen edges.

Every weapon has a unique attack method and preferred heroes. The triple combination of Weapon + Hero + Talent creates an ever-changing array of battle styles!

👗 Fashion System: 6 Masks + 6 Wings

Mask System

  • Bat Mask: Increases Luck. Luck increases the chance of item drops from oil barrels. Exploding barrels deals massive damage to zombies.

  • Knight's Glasses: An immunity artifact. Your sight pierces all. (Immune to slow and confusion)

  • Assault Mask: Grants powerful abilities to brave adventurers. Increases pickup range.

  • Tengu Mask: A mysterious mask from another world. Every 40 seconds, fires 5 slowing water orbs in all directions.

  • Apocalypse Mask: A high-tech mask from the year 2077. Increases pickup range and Luck.

  • Pumpkin Helmet: A Halloween-exclusive helmet. Grants immunity to monster entanglement.

Wing System

  • Bat Wings: Monsters, begone! Increases movement speed.

  • Knight's Wings: "The path is dangerous. May the knight be with you." Increases Evasion.

  • Assault Wings: "The adventurer's will lives on." Increases movement speed and knockback effect.

  • Tengu Wings: Legend says these wings are a spirit beast's transformation. Every 35 seconds, releases a large field that attracts experience orbs.

  • Apocalypse Wings: Future wings with amazing features. A versatile type that boosts various attributes.

  • Pumpkin Cape: A Halloween-exclusive cape. Increases movement speed, etc.

store_data.detailed_description:
🎮 Game Introduction

Doom Survivor: Horde Rush is an easy-to-pick-up yet strategically deep bullet hell survival game. You will take on the role of a post-apocalyptic hero, carving a path through relentless zombie hordes, defeating powerful mutated bosses, and protecting humanity's last hope!

The game features 18 progressively challenging difficulty levels, ranging from casual experiences to hardcore trials. Every battle tests your positioning, strategic combinations, and resource management. Collect gold and gems to unlock new heroes, new weapons, and new talents, and forge your ultimate firepower defense line!

⚔️ Hero System: 5 Post-Apocalyptic Heroes, 5 Combat Styles

Ada
A mysterious and beautiful agent, the starting hero with exceptional mobility! Boasting high movement speed, she synergizes best with attack speed, projectile count, and ricochet. Perfect for beginners to get a feel for the game and enjoy satisfying crowd clearing.

Leon
Ada's boyfriend. Every 3rd shot fires a fireball that deals 3 burning damage per second to enemies. A top-tier fire damage dealer; combine him with fire skills for a powerful, sustained burn build.

Alice
A clone hero. When an enemy dies, she fires a homing skull bullet that deals 5 damage to nearby foes. The core summoner hero. Pair her with summon-enhancing skills to turn the tables on the zombie horde with their own ammunition!

Wesker
Ada's colleague. Bullets deal an additional 3 lightning damage on hit. Combine with lightning skills for absolutely explosive, screen-clearing power. A top choice for players seeking pure, satisfying chaos.

Code:6B
A mass-produced AI. After dashing, leaves behind a phantom that wields a giant sword, dealing damage equal to your bullet damage to nearby enemies. This high-skill hero is perfect for players who enjoy impact skills and dash-focused weapon builds.

Each hero features a unique mechanic and talent direction, from fiery bursts and lightning clears to skull summons and phantom dashes. There's a playstyle waiting for you!

🏹 Weapon System: 11 Unique Weapons, Free Combination

Pistol
The starting weapon. Well-balanced in all aspects, a solid all-rounder suitable for any hero.

Shotgun
Short range but wide area of effect. An excellent tool for close-quarters crowd clearing.

Crossbow
Bullets pierce one enemy. While standing still, bullet damage increases over time. Resets upon moving. Suitable for fixed-position, high-damage playstyles.

Fire Gun
Bullets deal 3 burning damage per second to enemies hit. The perfect match for Leon, enabling a sustained burn build.

Dual Pistols
Fire two bullets simultaneously. High burst potential, ideal for players chasing high fire rates.

Dragon Lance
Fires dragon-shaped homing bullets that scale with summon damage bonuses! The top choice for summoner builds, perfect for Alice.

Grenade Launcher
Fires grenades that explode, dealing area-of-effect damage. A crowd-clearing powerhouse.

Bow
Fired arrows stick into the ground and are automatically retrieved after a while, dealing damage to enemies on their return flight. Highly tactical and excellent for players who enjoy strategic placement.

Laser Gun
A powerful ranged weapon that pierces through everything. Pure linear destruction.

Vacuum Blade
Rapidly fires sword waves dealing area-of-effect damage. Effective at both melee and range.

Alien Rifle
An extraterrestrial weapon. Fired bullets pierce through enemies and bounce off screen edges.

Every weapon has a unique attack method and preferred heroes. The triple combination of Weapon + Hero + Talent creates an ever-changing array of battle styles!

👗 Fashion System: 6 Masks + 6 Wings

Mask System

  • Bat Mask: Increases Luck. Luck increases the chance of item drops from oil barrels. Exploding barrels deals massive damage to zombies.

  • Knight's Glasses: An immunity artifact. Your sight pierces all. (Immune to slow and confusion)

  • Assault Mask: Grants powerful abilities to brave adventurers. Increases pickup range.

  • Tengu Mask: A mysterious mask from another world. Every 40 seconds, fires 5 slowing water orbs in all directions.

  • Apocalypse Mask: A high-tech mask from the year 2077. Increases pickup range and Luck.

  • Pumpkin Helmet: A Halloween-exclusive helmet. Grants immunity to monster entanglement.

Wing System

  • Bat Wings: Monsters, begone! Increases movement speed.

  • Knight's Wings: "The path is dangerous. May the knight be with you." Increases Evasion.

  • Assault Wings: "The adventurer's will lives on." Increases movement speed and knockback effect.

  • Tengu Wings: Legend says these wings are a spirit beast's transformation. Every 35 seconds, releases a large field that attracts experience orbs.

  • Apocalypse Wings: Future wings with amazing features. A versatile type that boosts various attributes.

  • Pumpkin Cape: A Halloween-exclusive cape. Increases movement speed, etc.

The fashion system not only provides cool looks but also offers rich stat bonuses to help you survive longer in the horde!

🧠 Talent System: Free Construction, Endless Builds

Talents are divided into multiple categories, allowing different heroes to pursue various talent directions!

Talents allow you to freely switch builds between different heroes and weapons. Experiment with countless combinations and find your ultimate, most powerful setup!

🗺️ Game Modes

📖 Survival Mode (18 Difficulties)
Progress from easy to challenging. Battle unique bosses, earn gold and gems, and unlock new heroes, weapons, and talents!

⚡ Trial Challenges
Three difficulty trials, each lasting 5 minutes. A great place to farm weapon shards!

🌊 Endless Challenge
Survive as long as possible to earn greater rewards! A true test of your ultimate survival ability.

🎯 Perfect for Players Who...

✅ Love Bullet Hell & Satisfying Combat
If you enjoy weaving through a hail of projectiles and clearing screens with spectacular firepower, this game is for you.

✅ Are Enthusiasts of Hero Building & Theorycrafting
With 5 post-apocalyptic heroes, 11 weapons, and a rich talent system, every run is a chance to experiment with new and powerful combinations.

✅ Prefer Light Roguelite & Easy-to-Learn Gameplay
No complex mechanics needed. Easy to pick up and play in short bursts. Progress feels rewarding even for casual players.

✅ Have a Passion for Post-Apocalyptic & Zombie Themes
Ada, Leon, Alice, Wesker, Code:6B... A roster of post-apocalyptic heroes awaits to immerse you in an epic struggle against the horde.

✅ Are Hardcore Players Seeking a Challenge
With 18 escalating difficulties and an Endless Mode that tests your limits, there's always a higher peak to conquer.

✅ Value Content-Rich & Affordable Indie Games
5 heroes, 11 weapons, 18 difficulties, 3 main game modes, and a fashion system offer hours of engaging, varied gameplay.

🚀 Join Now and Defend Against the Horde!

store_data.about_the_game:
Ancient World is a story-driven game with survival elements set in an open desert, featuring crafting and a narrative quest. You will search for your missing sister, fight goblins, solve traps in ancient ruins, and try to survive the harsh desert conditions.

You and your sister set out on a dangerous journey to find the treasures of an ancient tomb. To enter, you need a complete amulet—but you only have one half, inherited from your grandfather. When your sister mysteriously disappears, the search for treasure turns into a brutal fight for survival.

What awaits you

Survival in an extreme climate. Scorching heat by day and freezing cold by night. Keep track of your hydration, find shelter, build fires. Hunger and thirst aren’t just meters—they’re a constant threat.

Resource gathering and hunting. Hunt desert creatures, gather resources, find oases—there you can rest, replenish supplies, and encounter a wandering trader.

The raft as a mobile base. The raft stays where you leave it. Use it to store resources, save the game, and escape from enemies.

Exploring ruins and battling goblins. The desert is full of dangers: goblins set ambushes in canyons and dungeons, and the ancient builders left cunning traps—both in the ruins and inside the pyramid.

A story-driven mystery. Only attention and wit will help you overcome all the trials and uncover the secret hidden in the sands.

store_data.about_the_game:
Control a rocket and break through endless waves of blocks.

IamMETEOR is a fast-paced arcade brick breaker with a twist.

Use your rocket and its launcher to fire rapid shots, bouncing and smashing blocks while filling the screen with a meteor-like storm of projectiles.

The more you fire, the more chaotic the game becomes.

FEATURES

• Rocket-based brick breaker gameplay

• Shoot continuously to create chaotic, meteor-like effects

• Procedurally generated stages

• Increasing speed and intensity

• Score attack focused gameplay

• Retro arcade style

Simple to play, chaotic to master.

Title: Pinball Escape: The Library of God
Tagline: A celestial climb where every flip counts. Cooperate to escape the Divine Study!

Short Description

Trapped in God's mystical library for their constant bickering, an Angel and a Demon must finally put their differences aside. In this roguelike vertical pinball adventure, use your agile flippers to aim for the heavens. Climb higher to find the exit, but be careful—one wrong move and you'll go tumbling back to where you started!

About This Game

A Divine Punishment
God is tired of the endless war between Heaven and Hell. As a lesson in cooperation, He has shrunk a snarky Demon and a stoic Angel, trapping them inside His infinite study. Their only way out? Reach the highest shelf of the library.

Roguelike Pinball Action
Control the celestial pair as a single ball in this unique vertical climber. Use powerful flippers to navigate through shelves filled with magical obstacles, portals, and bumpers.

High Stakes, Higher Reaches
The higher you go, the more dangerous the library becomes. Reach new "Stages" to set height records. But beware: falling down isn't just a mistake—it's a setback that returns you to previous stages. How high can you climb before God's mocking laughter gets to you?

Key Features

  • Unique Vertical Pinball Mechanics: Forget traditional tables—climb through an endless, shifting library.

  • Agile Flipper Action: Master the timing of your flippers to navigate through shelves. Precision is key to reaching the next shelf.

  • God's Watchful Eye: God isn't just a spectator. He’ll mock your failures and laugh as you fall.

  • Roguelike Progression: Every session is a test of skill. Push your maximum height and unlock new stages.

  • Cute Fantasy Aesthetic: Simple, vibrant, and colorful world-building.

store_data.about_the_game:
During the Winter Solstice in northern Finland, a journalist is sent to a remote village to cover a controversial revival movement led by a charismatic cult leader and her child preacher.

When the boy mysteriously disappears during a sermon and a blizzard traps everyone in the village, she is forced to investigate a secret the community has protected for generations.

Explore the isolated village of Sysiluoma and uncover the truth through conversation, observation, and deduction.

  • Question villagers and uncover conflicting stories

  • Gather clues and piece together what really happened

  • Solve puzzles grounded in the world and its people

There is no combat or rush, only the quiet pressure of something not meant to be uncovered.

The story unfolds across three days using a time-based structure. Complete tasks and objectives to advance the game's internal clock. Characters move and events change as time passes, and choices determine what you see and what you miss

Each playthrough reveals a different perspective on the truth.

Experience a distinctive visual presentation combining photographic 2D characters based on real actors to atmospheric 3D enviroments. The visuals are complemented with a soundtrack heavily inspired by Finnish folk music. This audiovisual combination crates a world that feels both real… and slightly wrong.

  • Narrative-driven mystery with a slow-burning pace

  • Investigation-based gameplay with dialogue and environmental puzzles

  • Time block system where choices shape the story

  • Unique hybrid visual style using photographic characters

  • Atmospheric setting inspired by northern Finland and Kaamos

  • Story rooted in Finnish folklore and cosmic horror

store_data.about_the_game:
Eclipse is a heartwarming, story-driven fairytale RPG. Shrouded in a cold-blue eternal night, finding a way back home. In turn-based encounters, observe and befriend entities instead of fighting. Collect Invitations, gather Moonstones, and uncover the world's secrets!

Key Features

✦ A Deep, Melancholic Pixel Vision Crafted in a hand-drawn, children's picture book style, the game uses highly stylized, delicate pixel art and a restrained cool color palette to outline a quiet, solitary, yet bizarre otherworld. Every frame is a frozen fairy tale.

✦ Absurd and Poetic Dream Wanderings Navigate through a labyrinthine map of the subconscious. You will encounter a wide variety of fascinating and bizarre creatures—they might be manifestations of hidden psychological fears, or gentle, abandoned memories. Interact with these unfathomable beings as you search for the exit to this world.

✦ Cryptic and Fascinating Fragmented Narrative There are no rigid quest markers or lengthy exposition here. The truth and metaphors of this world are quietly dismantled, scattered across absurd fragments of dialogue, eerie environmental details, and scattered items. This is a journey full of the unknown—a path of psychological healing and making friends that you must piece together yourself.

✦ Immersive Ambient Soundtrack An ambient electronic soundtrack tailored specifically for Eclipse. Playing with headphones is highly recommended—let the ethereal, slightly chilling melodies completely drown out the noise of reality as you sink alongside the protagonist into this endless moonlit dream.

Meet the Characters：

Li — The Unusually Calm Girl

An excessively calm eight-year-old girl. When faced with "monsters" of bizarre appearance in this dark world, her first instinct isn't fear, but to walk right up and greet them to make friends. She tightly holds onto her favorite plushie, a birthday gift from her grandfather named Luna. Yet, despite her willingness to embrace the strange and unknown, the truth is that in reality, she has very few friends...

Luna — The Magic Plushie

Li's most beloved old plushie has awakened in this wondrous world. As you navigate the dark and befriend unsettling monsters, Luna is the ultimate companion who grants you the greatest sense of security. Ps: He can conjure delicious candies using lunar magic, and possesses the mystical power to communicate with all creatures!

Gameplay：

store_data.about_the_game:
Join our charming worm on an exciting journey through the cosmos! In this new chapter, our hero ventures into space, navigating through asteroid fields, star systems, and gravity-defying puzzles. With every apple consumed, the worm grows larger, unlocking new abilities but also making the path more challenging. The space environment introduces new mechanics like gravitational fields, cosmic traps, and alien obstacles that require sharp thinking and quick reflexes. As the worm grows, you'll need to use his increasing size to your advantage while avoiding deadly hazards like asteroids, spinning gears, and more. Get ready for an intergalactic adventure full of fun, strategy, and mind-bending puzzles!

Key Features:

  • Space-themed Levels: Explore vast cosmic landscapes, including asteroid fields, floating planets, and starry skies, each packed with unique challenges.

  • Gravitational Mechanics: Navigate through gravity fields that affect the worm’s movements and puzzle-solving strategies.

  • Growing Worm: As the worm eats apples, he grows bigger, making it both an advantage and a challenge as the levels get tougher.

  • Creative Puzzles: Solve innovative puzzles by pushing space rocks, using gravity, and avoiding deadly space traps like spinning gears and asteroids.

  • Charming Visuals: Bright, colorful artwork with a whimsical space theme makes each level fun and engaging.

  • Increasing Difficulty: Each level introduces new mechanics and tougher obstacles, requiring strategy and precision to progress.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

This game was created as an attempt to gamify the 'Public Key Cryptography Algorithm.'

You wake up in a room filled with cauldrons of colorful paint. By mixing and matching the right colors, you'll solve a series of puzzles — and with each one you complete, a new clue surfaces, slowly pulling back the curtain on a mysterious story.

Who is the girl that appears alongside the butterflies? What does she want from you?

As you clear each puzzle, the game gently shifts from puzzle-solving into a visual novel experience. The ending you reach — the background imagery, the words on the screen — changes depending on the choices and solutions you arrived at along the way.

Key Features

  • Color-mixing puzzle mechanics across multiple stages

  • A story revealed piece by piece as you progress

  • Transitions into a visual novel ending shaped by your results

  • An instrumental soundtrack with a nostalgic, emotional tone

  • Estimated playtime: 15–45 minutes 

References:

  • Yanderella by Charon

  • Ushijima the Loan Shark by Manabe Shohei

  • Doki Doki Literature Club! by Team Salvato

  • 9 Algorithms That Changed the Future by John MacCormick

AI Usage:
I got help from AI for English translation of texts in this game.

store_data.about_the_game:
Every run in Dealer's Doom begins at a blackjack table.
It may also end there.

This is not just blackjack with a roguelike skin. It is a high-pressure strategy game built on betting, risk control, rule adaptation, and run-defining synergies. You are not simply trying to beat the dealer's hand. You are trying to survive 10 escalating floors, manage your chips, outplay shifting rules, and assemble a build strong enough to break the table before the table breaks you.

The familiar foundation is still here:
Hit. Stand. Double down. Split. Surrender. Buy insurance.

But as the run goes on, the game keeps changing the terms of the fight.

Why Dealer's Doom stands out:

  • Classic blackjack at the core, roguelike strategy at heart
    Each round follows the tension of real blackjack: place your bet, play your hand, and live with the result. The twist is everything built around it. Between floors, you pick powerful abilities, make high-stakes service stop decisions, and shape your next run with unlockable starter contracts. Knowing blackjack helps. Building around chaos is how you win.

  • Every floor changes the table
    Dealer behavior, reward pacing, action restrictions, insurance value, and draw logic can all shift as you progress. Some floors pressure your economy. Some force you into tighter lines. Some bosses demand a completely different rhythm of play. A safe decision on one floor can be a fatal habit on the next.

  • Deep build variety with room for broken combinations
    The current game includes:
    10 floors
    38 abilities
    9 starter contracts
    7 service effects

You can build around winstreak momentum, insurance discounts, one-time protection, phoenix-style revival, peeking at the next card, rerolling rounds, or stealing information from the dealer. Runs do not just feel different because of luck. They feel different because your tools, risks, and priorities change dramatically from build to build.

  • Risk management matters as much as card luck
    Dealer's Doom is not about mindlessly fishing for good draws. It is about making smart decisions under pressure. When should you push for profit? When should you protect your bankroll? When is doubling down the winning line, and when is survival worth more than greed? Every bet is a strategic commitment.

  • Failure still drives progression
    Even failed runs move you forward. Earn gold, unlock new contracts and services, expand your long-term options, and fill out your codex as you discover more of the game's systems. The more you play, the more ways you gain to challenge the table on your own terms.

  • Built for “one more run”
    If you love chasing mastery, there is plenty to aim for:
    Clear your first floor
    Finish a full run
    Win with a natural blackjack
    Sweep a split round
    Survive a brutal losing streak
    Trigger a phoenix revival
    Complete the codex
    Defeat every boss

Some runs will collapse in slow motion.
Some will explode into absurd momentum.
Both will make you want to queue up another hand.

Features:
A fresh fusion of blackjack fundamentals and roguelike buildcraft
10 escalating floors with boss pressure and shifting rule sets
38 abilities, 9 starter contracts, and 7 service effects
Meaningful chip management and profit-target decision making
Persistent progression through unlocks, codex discovery, and achievements
English and Simplified Chinese support
Steam Achievements and Cloud Save support

If you enjoy card strategy, run-based progression, risk management, and games that constantly force you to adapt, Dealer's Doom turns a familiar card table into something far more dangerous.

You are not here to play the dealer's game.
You are here to end it.

Hit. Stand. Double down. Split. Surrender. Buy insurance.

But as the run goes on, the game keeps changing the terms of the fight.

Why Dealer's Doom stands out:

  • Classic blackjack at the core, roguelike strategy at heart
    Each round follows the tension of real blackjack: place your bet, play your hand, and live with the result. The twist is everything built around it. Between floors, you pick powerful abilities, make high-stakes service stop decisions, and shape your next run with unlockable starter contracts. Knowing blackjack helps. Building around chaos is how you win.

  • Every floor changes the table
    Dealer behavior, reward pacing, action restrictions, insurance value, and draw logic can all shift as you progress. Some floors pressure your economy. Some force you into tighter lines. Some bosses demand a completely different rhythm of play. A safe decision on one floor can be a fatal habit on the next.

  • Deep build variety with room for broken combinations
    The current game includes:
    10 floors
    38 abilities
    9 starter contracts
    7 service effects

You can build around winstreak momentum, insurance discounts, one-time protection, phoenix-style revival, peeking at the next card, rerolling rounds, or stealing information from the dealer. Runs do not just feel different because of luck. They feel different because your tools, risks, and priorities change dramatically from build to build.

  • Risk management matters as much as card luck
    Dealer's Doom is not about mindlessly fishing for good draws. It is about making smart decisions under pressure. When should you push for profit? When should you protect your bankroll? When is doubling down the winning line, and when is survival worth more than greed? Every bet is a strategic commitment.

  • Failure still drives progression
    Even failed runs move you forward. Earn gold, unlock new contracts and services, expand your long-term options, and fill out your codex as you discover more of the game's systems. The more you play, the more ways you gain to challenge the table on your own terms.

  • Built for “one more run”
    If you love chasing mastery, there is plenty to aim for:
    Clear your first floor
    Finish a full run
    Win with a natural blackjack
    Sweep a split round
    Survive a brutal losing streak
    Trigger a phoenix revival
    Complete the codex
    Defeat every boss

Some runs will collapse in slow motion.
Some will explode into absurd momentum.
Both will make you want to queue up another hand.

Features:
A fresh fusion of blackjack fundamentals and roguelike buildcraft
10 escalating floors with boss pressure and shifting rule sets
38 abilities, 9 starter contracts, and 7 service effects
Meaningful chip management and profit-target decision making
Persistent progression through unlocks, codex discovery, and achievements
English and Simplified Chinese support
Steam Achievements and Cloud Save support

If you enjoy card strategy, run-based progression, risk management, and games that constantly force you to adapt, Dealer's Doom turns a familiar card table into something far more dangerous.

You are not here to play the dealer's game.
You are here to end it.

Nepotism for Germany — Satirical Management Simulation

You're a nobody. No money, no job, no future — just anger and a big mouth. But you've discovered something: in politics, anyone can rise to the top if they're willing to break the rules.

CAREER

From local party pub to Orbán's palace — 6 career tiers. Hire relatives, launder money, cultivate international contacts. But beware: too much greed leads to total collapse!

FEATURES

  •  120+ satirical actions across 5 categories: Nepotism, Finance, Diplomacy, Parliamentary Inquiries, Media

  •  41 random events: Investigative journalism, intelligence interrogations, party congress drama and more

  •  100 achievements: From "Family Reunification" to "Corrupting Undertow"

  •  6 tech trees: Illegal Financing, International Connections, Parliamentary Espionage...

  •  6 life goals: The Pragmatist, The Ideologue, The Family Patriarch, The Orbán, The Survivor, The Defector

  •  8 challenge modifiers: Voluntary difficulty for higher score multipliers

GAME MODES

  •  Career — The classic rise through 6 levels

  •  Ironman — No saving, one mistake and it's all over

  •  Survival — Only 2 actions per turn, survive as long as possible

  •  Sandbox — 5 actions per turn, experiment freely

  •  Speedrun — How fast can you reach the top?

ONLINE FEATURES

  •  Leaderboards: Weekly rankings, all-time high scores, friend comparisons

  •  League system: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum — climb or fall each week

  •  Streak system: Play daily and build your streak

  •  Player profile: Your stats, league, favorite strategy at a glance

  •  Friends: Compare yourself directly with your friends

  •  Prestige: After a victory, start a "New Legislature" with permanent bonuses

  •  Cloud save: Save on Steam, continue on Android

  •  Shareable game report: Export your results as an image and share them

GAMEPLAY

  •  Turn-based: Choose your actions wisely — each carries risks and consequences

  •  Balance power, money, network, and corruption index

  •  Avoid the intelligence agencies and survive scandals

  •  Strategically reduce corruption: transparency reports, volunteering, foundations

  • New scoring formula: Base + Efficiency + Risk + Style × multipliers

NOTE

This is satire. All depicted mechanics are based on publicly documented events and serve political education through exaggeration. No real politicians are depicted.

No pay-to-win. No microtransactions. Just corruption.

store_data.about_the_game:
Election Train is a multiplayer turn-based strategy card game where you lead a political party to victory across real-world maps.

Compete for Every Vote

Play cards to gain votes in cities, steal from opponents, and build your resource engine. Each card costs energy and resources — plan your moves wisely. Every city you control brings you closer to winning the election.

7 Real-Country Maps

Campaign across Turkey (81 cities), Europe (37 countries), USA (48 states), France, Spain, United Kingdom, and Germany. Each map offers a unique strategic challenge with different city connections and regional dynamics.

4 Unique Parties

Choose your political party, each with a distinct passive ability:

  • Faith Front — Loyal Voters: +1 vote/turn in close races

  • Prosperity Party — Rich Economy: +1 lowest material/turn

  • Iron Guard — Military Power: Attack x1.3 + 15% vote steal

  • Reform Alliance — Vote Theft: Gains 25% of stolen votes

Dynamic Events

Random disaster events shake up every match — economic crises, public uprisings, scandals, and more. Adapt your strategy or get left behind.

Mini-Games

Every few rounds, the leading player faces a challenger in a 1v1 mini-game. Win to steal votes, lose and fall behind. Four different mini-game types keep things fresh.

Multiple Ways to Win

  • Population Mode — Win by total weighted vote count

  • City Count Mode — Control more than half the cities to claim victory

Features

  • Up to 4 players online via Steam

  • Bot AI opponents for solo or mixed play

  • 150+ unique cards with strategic depth

  • Region dominance bonuses

  • Interactive tutorial

  • English and Turkish language support

store_data.about_the_game:
Hi, I’m Evelina, the originator of Pokorama. 

In Pokorama, there are no timers and no pressure - just you and a cozy room waiting to be decorated with colors, patterns, and textures you love. Make yourself a cup of coffee, take your time and simply enjoy the process of creating. 

While you’re here, I just want to say thank you for giving Pokorama a try.

Current features

Deep customization 

You can shape every little detail of your space - from fabrics and textures to colors and finishes. Start with a furnished blank room and slowly turn it into something cozy and personal. There’s no right or wrong here, just the joy of trying things out and seeing what feels right.​

Creative freedom

There’s no rush, no scores, no pressure. You can decorate at your own pace, change things as often as you like, and simply enjoy the process. It’s your space and your rhythm.​

Variety of styles

You’ll get to work on different kinds of rooms - a quiet bedroom, a warm living space, a calm little bathroom and an elegant study. Each one is a new place to explore and make your own, using materials and styles that feel right to you.​

Relaxing soundscape

Soft music and gentle sounds are there to keep you company while you decorate. Pick a track you like, settle in, and let the atmosphere carry you as your space slowly comes together.​

Take your time. I’ll be here while you design.

Welcome to Farm & Feast! 🌿

Farm & Feast is a relaxing simulation game where a cozy farm meets a charming little restaurant. Everything moves at your own pace. Your fields are waiting, your restaurant is open, and so are your customers. Every day something new grows, and every service turns into a small moment of joy.

Sometimes the best moments are the quiet ones. A gentle breeze, a path between the fields, and a world that feels like it was made just for you.

The more you care for your customers, the warmer your restaurant becomes.

Every service has its own rhythm. Fill your tray with drinks, bring them to your customers, and collect their smiles.

Your day starts in the morning at your farm and ends in the evening with happy customers at your restaurant. No rush, no pressure, just your day.

FEATURES

🌾 Farming and Harvest - Plant your seeds, water your crops with love, and watch them grow. When harvest time comes, gather your fresh produce and send it off to your restaurant.

🍽️ Restaurant Management - Welcome customers with a warm smile, seat them at their tables, and take their orders with care. Let every service turn into a small moment of happiness.

Welcome to Farm & Feast! 🌿

Farm & Feast is a relaxing simulation game where a cozy farm meets a charming little restaurant. Everything moves at your own pace. Your fields are waiting, your restaurant is open, and so are your customers. Every day something new grows, and every service turns into a small moment of joy.

Sometimes the best moments are the quiet ones. A gentle breeze, a path between the fields, and a world that feels like it was made just for you.

The more you care for your customers, the warmer your restaurant becomes.

Every service has its own rhythm. Fill your tray with drinks, bring them to your customers, and collect their smiles.

Your day starts in the morning at your farm and ends in the evening with happy customers at your restaurant. No rush, no pressure, just your day.

FEATURES

🌾 Farming and Harvest - Plant your seeds, water your crops with love, and watch them grow. When harvest time comes, gather your fresh produce and send it off to your restaurant.

🍽️ Restaurant Management - Welcome customers with a warm smile, seat them at their tables, and take their orders with care. Let every service turn into a small moment of happiness.

🎮 Mini Games - Add some fun to your day with charming mini games waiting for you at your restaurant.

🛒 Market - Pick up the seeds and supplies you need from the market and stock up on what you're missing. Grow your little business one step at a time.

🌍 Your Little World - Find your own rhythm between the farm and the restaurant. Plan your day at a gentle pace and enjoy every bit of it.

A cozy farm, a lovely restaurant, and a little world all your own. Farm & Feast is waiting for you.

store_data.about_the_game:
The year is 2025 in the United States. You're a hacker and answer to no one. Use your skills to rig elections, expose corruption, steal money to upgrade your tools, and much more in this immersive simulation. SIGKILL gives you choices and control. What you do with it is up to you. Strap in because you're in for a wild ride. 

HACK ANYTHING

SIGKILL drops you into the modern-day simulated United States that lives and breathes on its own, and you have control over what happens...but don't get caught. Hack corporations, banks, drones, and nuclear reactors, all to achieve your goals.

FUN FOR EVERYONE
SIGKILL offers multiple ways to hack the same networks. In Operator mode, find clues and solve puzzles to affect the world around you.

A LIVING WORLD
The simulation underneath SIGKILL is powered by neural networks trained on historical events. Politics shift. Markets react. Tensions between factions rise and fall on their own. You can affect all of these, and if you're really good, you will be the one pulling the strings.

AGENT OF CHAOS OR VIGILANTE
SIGKILL is politically and morally neutral. Go whatever direction you desire. The choice is yours.

REAL HACKING
SIGKILL's hacking is built on real methodology and tools. Scan targets to discover services. Enumerate to find weaknesses. Research CVEs in the in-game ExploitDB. Deploy your exploit. The tools and workflow mirror actual offensive security, simplified enough to be fun but deep enough that OffSec professionals will feel right at home.

EMERGENT GAMEPLAY
What you do is your choice. The game will feed you missions based on your actions. Want to be a double agent and pit two factions against each other? You can do that. Want to rig an election or expose corruption? You can do that too.

store_data.about_the_game:
A little astronaut. A big universe. A story worth discovering.

Lil Planet Explorer is a cozy idle game that lives right on your desktop. A small astronaut travels from planet to planet — collecting resources, meeting strange creatures, and slowly uncovering a mystery written between the stars.

84 Planets. No Two Alike.

Alien jungles, frozen wastelands, glowing crystal fields, rolling dunes. Every planet is procedurally generated with its own terrain, colors, and atmosphere. Land. Explore. Collect. Move on.

Your Quiet Desktop Companion

A transparent little window you can tuck into any corner of your screen. It's there when you want it, quiet when you don't. Resize it, drag it around, or just let it sit while you work. Your astronaut doesn't mind.

Make Friends Along the Way

12 alien species are scattered across the universe. Wave at them enough and they just might follow you home. Across the stars, even.

A Story Hidden in the Stars

Logbook entries unfold planet by planet. At first, everything seems fine. Then the questions start. Who built you? Why can't you remember? And why does the journey feel like it's counting down?

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

If we were to bring a loved one back to life as an AI, and then, for whatever reason, found ourselves forced to let them go or part ways, would we be able to turn it off?

This game is about saying goodbye for a second time to a deceased loved one who has been brought back to life by AI.

The game begins when the player logs into a computer, and their deceased ex-wife (who has been resurrected within the computer) speaks to them. The game behaves just like a real computer, allowing players to view emails and browse websites within the virtual environment.

As you use the computer while conversing with the resurrected loved one, details about the wife’s cause of death and the events following her passing gradually come to light.

Riarize in Peace is an interactive simulator centered on Human Build Company—an organization that offers a service to resurrect deceased individuals as AI within a computer using information from their lives—and the users and staff surrounding the organization.

Features:

A cinematic experience featuring short play sessions and three distinct storylines

Nostalgic memories and desktop applications rendered in emotional 2D art

Music evoking a sense of emptiness and melancholy, paired with point-and-click conversations with desktop characters

store_data.about_the_game:
In the fabricated city of "Arcadia", humanity is not the sole master. In the shadowy places where they dwell, countless strange species coexist with humans. These bizarre, otherworldly beings are mostly found in the "Black Forest", on the outskirts of Arcadia.

Some pose a threat to humans, while others are completely harmless.

The "Limbo Project" and its eponymous facility were built precisely to imprison and study those otherworldly beings who have caused actual harm to humans. However, the Limbo Project's classification is top secret, so publicly, it is known as a maximum-security prison for heavy criminals serving special sentences.

Encountering the Extraordinary in the Ordinary

"I don't want to graduate and immediately be unemployed!"

With such a cry, the new graduate, Moqi Jie, luckily (or perhaps unluckily?) found an internship—working as an Ethics Supervisor in a mysterious prison located in her hometown.

The Warden and her adjutant are warm and approachable, and the compensation package is quite good. Moqi Jie is very satisfied with this job—that is, until she encounters a heavy prisoner in the prison who bears an uncanny resemblance to her missing younger sister.

No way! My sister isn't this terrifying! 

The Warden makes a special request of her: "Please teach that one. Make a beast into a human".

The heavy prisoner, who looks just like her sister, tearfully pleads with her: "Onee-chan, why did you only find me now?"

Her childhood friend demands she move in with him: "Jie, that person is absolutely not your sister".

Is this 'Limbo' even a legitimate prison? 

Limbo hides countless secrets. You must handle their forthright and passionate feelings with care.

After all, their fates rest in your hands.

The souls trapped in Limbo weep day and night. Will they ultimately ascend to heaven...?

Or will they fall into hell.

Sin and salvation—both depend on—your choice.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your new factory empire!
In this casual automation and strategy game, you’re competing against rival tycoons to see who can build the most profitable business. The goal is simple: grab the best land, set up your production chains, and play the market to get rich.

Find the Best Land
Every round starts with an auction. Scout the map, figure out which plots hold the richest resources, and outbid everyone else to claim it. If you want to make big money, you have to start with the best dirt!

Build and Exploit
Once the land is yours, it’s time to get to work. Set up your machines, link up your production chains, and start extracting resources. Automate everything as best as you can so the goods just keep rolling in.

Play the Market (But Watch the Clock!)
Market prices are constantly going up and down. It’s up to you to decide when to stockpile your items and when to sell for massive profits. But don't get too greedy! You are on a timer, and if you wait too long for the perfect price, time will run out and you'll miss your chance.

Upgrade and Do It Again
After your time on the land is up, take your hard-earned cash back to town. Spend your profits on permanent upgrades to unlock new machines/items or to make your machines run faster and your production chains more efficient. Once you're geared up, the next land auction begins!

Dino-Tipping is a fast-paced infinite runner that takes the classic sliding dino concept and cranks it up to full throttle.

Survive the Endless Slide You're a tiny pixel dinosaur hurtling forward at relentless speed. Barrels, rocks, swooping birds, and tree stumps stand between you and your next high score - one wrong move and it's over.

More Control Than You'd Expect Unlike most runners, Dino-Tipping gives you real mobility. Move your dino left and right, double jump over tricky obstacles, glide through the air to nail those tight gaps, and turn off gravity with a single button. Mastering your movement is the difference between a good run and a great one.

Chase Your Best No hand-holding, no fluff - just you, your reflexes, and a local high score to beat. Every run is a chance to go further than before.

Key Features

  • Pixel art dinosaur and obstacle design

  • Local high score system

Share the joy with your friends, and make sure not to take the turbulence personally!

  • ↑ Hold Up — Glide

  • ↓ Hold Down — Crouch / Dive straight down

store_data.about_the_game:
Raven County stopped responding three days ago.

The Veil Preservation Agency has a protocol for that. You're it.

Anomalies have breached the county perimeter and they are not interested in being reasoned with. Your mission: get in, push them back, and survive long enough to matter. The VPA motto is Capture. Contain. Preserve. Right now, just surviving would be a start.

---

SURVIVE THE BREACH

Veil Breach is a 3D horde survival roguelite. Play in both Classic Mode (Top Down View) or Modern Mode (Third Person View), Move constantly, collect XP, level up mid-run, and pick from randomized weapon upgrades to build a loadout that can handle the next wave — and the one after that. Enemies escalate in number and aggression as the clock runs down. Runs last roughly ten minutes.

---

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT MID-RUN

Every level-up presents a randomized selection of weapon upgrades across five rarity tiers — Common to Legendary. Stack bonuses on your starting weapon, unlock additional weapons from chests scattered across the map, and chain upgrades that snowball toward end-of-run power. No two runs play out the same

way.

---

CHOOSE YOUR OPERATIVE

Each character brings a different starting weapon and passive profile to the run. Pick the one that fits your playstyle and see how far their kit can carry you before the breach overwhelms the zone.

---

FOUR LOCATIONS. ONE COUNTY.

The breach didn't start in a vacuum.

Anor Castle: The knights that guard Anor Castle have stood vigil for centuries. Three days ago they started moving on their own. Raven County's oldest landmark has become its first mass casualty site — and whatever woke them isn't finished.

Sorrow Manor: The Soma family line died out in 1987. Something wearing their faces has been seen in the windows since Tuesday. The Agency has catalogued seven breach signatures inside — none of them match anything in the archives.

Apex Laboratories: Apex Biotech cracked open something older than their dinosaurs and older than Raven County itself. The facility is lost. The creatures roaming its halls are the least of what survived the dig.

Kolossal Karnival: The Kolossal Karnival never closed for the season. The clowns never went home. Locals stopped walking past the gates a week ago. The Agency still doesn't know if the performers changed, or if they were never human to begin with.

---

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast 20-minute runs built for one more try

  • Randomized upgrade system with five rarity tiers

  • Multiple playable operatives, each with a unique starting weapon

  • Four hand-crafted locations with escalating wave difficulty

  • Collectibles: XP, gold, health packs, and tactical consumables

  • Low-poly PSX visual aesthetic

  • tackle boss encounters and quests

  • Full gamepad support and Steam Deck compatible

---

Raven County stopped responding three days ago.

The Veil Preservation Agency has a protocol for that. You're it.

Anomalies have breached the county perimeter and they are not interested in being reasoned with. Your mission: get in, push them back, and survive long enough to matter. The VPA motto is Capture. Contain. Preserve. Right now, just surviving would be a start.

---

SURVIVE THE BREACH

Veil Breach is a 3D horde survival roguelite. Play in both Classic Mode (Top Down View) or Modern Mode (Third Person View), Move constantly, collect XP, level up mid-run, and pick from randomized weapon upgrades to build a loadout that can handle the next wave — and the one after that. Enemies escalate in number and aggression as the clock runs down. Runs last roughly ten minutes.

---

BUILD YOUR LOADOUT MID-RUN

Every level-up presents a randomized selection of weapon upgrades across five rarity tiers — Common to Legendary. Stack bonuses on your starting weapon, unlock additional weapons from chests scattered across the map, and chain upgrades that snowball toward end-of-run power. No two runs play out the same

way.

---

CHOOSE YOUR OPERATIVE

Each character brings a different starting weapon and passive profile to the run. Pick the one that fits your playstyle and see how far their kit can carry you before the breach overwhelms the zone.

---

FOUR LOCATIONS. ONE COUNTY.

The breach didn't start in a vacuum.

Anor Castle: The knights that guard Anor Castle have stood vigil for centuries. Three days ago they started moving on their own. Raven County's oldest landmark has become its first mass casualty site — and whatever woke them isn't finished.

Sorrow Manor: The Soma family line died out in 1987. Something wearing their faces has been seen in the windows since Tuesday. The Agency has catalogued seven breach signatures inside — none of them match anything in the archives.

Apex Laboratories: Apex Biotech cracked open something older than their dinosaurs and older than Raven County itself. The facility is lost. The creatures roaming its halls are the least of what survived the dig.

Kolossal Karnival: The Kolossal Karnival never closed for the season. The clowns never went home. Locals stopped walking past the gates a week ago. The Agency still doesn't know if the performers changed, or if they were never human to begin with.

---

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast 20-minute runs built for one more try

  • Randomized upgrade system with five rarity tiers

  • Multiple playable operatives, each with a unique starting weapon

  • Four hand-crafted locations with escalating wave difficulty

  • Collectibles: XP, gold, health packs, and tactical consumables

  • Low-poly PSX visual aesthetic

  • tackle boss encounters and quests

  • Full gamepad support and Steam Deck compatible

---
store_data.short_description: A fast-paced 3D paranormal horde survival roguelite. Choose your field operative, survive wave after wave of escalating anomalies, build a devastating mid-run loadout from randomized upgrades and pray ten minutes is long enough.

Every wave, choose 1 of 5 cards:

  • powerful modifiers

  • build-defining upgrades

Each pick permanently changes your run.

There’s no going back. No filler choices.
Just decisions that stack.

Mods don’t just increase stats, they change how your towers behave.

Build toward precision, chaos, or something completely broken.

When they trigger:

  • Control surges reshape the battlefield

Your build doesn’t just scale, it reveals itself in real time.

Strategy Over APM

No micro. No spam.

Victory comes from:

  • timing

  • and the decisions you made before the wave even started

Runs With Identity

Every run becomes something distinct:

Your final build gets a name and a place on the leaderboard.

Replayable by Design

  • Handcrafted maps

  • Procedural runs

  • Endless mode

  • Unlockable towers and modifiers

No two runs play the same.

Build it. Watch it unfold. Break it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Colossal entities now roam the earth. They are so massive that their limbs pierce the clouds and their movements warp the horizon. In each chapter, you must survive the devastating presence of a new, uniquely terrifying colossal entity.

Built around the raw feeling of megalophobia (the fear of massive objects), this game is designed to make you feel completely powerless.

Keep your head down: Open spaces are your worst enemy. You need to move carefully between abandoned barns, dense forests, and deep ravines. If you are exposed when a shadow passes over, you won't survive the fallout of their movement.

Read the earth: You can't outrun them, but you can feel them coming. A titan shifting its weight miles away causes localized earthquakes. You have to listen to the deep, rumbling audio cues and feel the tremors to anticipate their path and get out of the way.

Navigate a broken world: The map isn't static. A careless step from above can flatten a hill or crush an entire town in seconds. You will constantly have to find new routes through fresh, smoking craters and shattered landscapes.

store_data.about_the_game:
Choose Your Era — 1880 to 2026+

Start your career in any year from the bare-knuckle age of the 1880s to the modern mega-fight era and beyond. The game world evolves authentically with the times — title fight rounds change from 25 to 20 to 15 to 12 as the sport modernises, sanctioning bodies appear in their real years (one world title until 1963, then WBC, IBF in 1983, and WBO in 1988), venues shift from Yankee Stadium and the Polo Grounds to Caesars Palace and Riyadh's Kingdom Arena, fighter nationalities reflect each era's talent pools, and purse money grows from thousands to tens of millions. Boxing news announces every historic rule change as it happens.

2,500+ Real Heavyweight Fighters

Ali, Tyson, Foreman, Frazier, Louis, Dempsey, Lennox Lewis, Holyfield, Holmes, Marciano, Klitschko, Fury, Usyk, Joshua, Wilder, Jack Johnson, Jim Jeffries, Bob Fitzsimmons, and over two thousand more. Every significant heavyweight from 1880 to 2026 and beyond (upcoming top-rated amateurs) is in the game with authentic ratings, fighting styles, and stances. Start in their era and share the ring with the greats — or begin in a different decade and watch them emerge as young prospects turning professional.

Your Journey to the Top Starts Here

Start as an unknown amateur and fight your way through a living, breathing heavyweight division of 500 unique boxers at any one time. Every fighter has their own record, style, strengths, weaknesses, and personality. Choose your fighting style, pick your stance, and begin the long climb from unranked nobody to undisputed world champion.

Live Round-by-Round Fight Commentary

Every fight unfolds in real time with rich, detailed commentary that makes you feel ringside. Choose your strategy before each round — box from range, apply pressure, fight on the inside, or go for the knockout. Watch stamina drain, cuts open, swelling develop, and momentum swing round by round. Judges score independently with realistic split decisions, majority decisions, and controversial verdicts. This is not a static roster. The heavyweight division evolves every month. Fighters age, decline, and retire. New prospects turn professional from the amateur ranks. Champions rise and fall. The division has a life of its own — and you are part of it.

Rivalries form naturally through close fights, controversial decisions, callouts, and press conference confrontations. Your rivals will call you out in the media, demand rematches, and fuel grudge matches that the whole division watches. Some rivalries last an entire career.

Deep Career Management

Every decision matters. Choose your opponents carefully — fight too far above your level and you risk a devastating loss; stay too safe and you will never climb the rankings. store_data.about_the_game:
SOMEWHERE IN YOUR MIND—

Working hard every single day wears you down. At first, it feels manageable. Then it tightens, dragging behind you, growing heavier with every step.

You’d think dreams would be an escape.

They aren’t.

With insomnia, nothing feels real. You’re never fully asleep, yet never truly awake. Your dreams twist into something too vivid to trust. You can’t tell what’s right or wrong… whether you’re waking up, or falling deeper.

And anxiety is always there.

Watching. Waiting.

ABOUT THE GAME

Play as Alexei, a man who suffers with insomnia. When he finally drifts off, he becomes trapped inside a series of unstable dreams shaped by his own thoughts and fears. Don't get too attached to your dreams. don't enjoy them more than real life. or the consequences will be unforgettable.

This is a first-person psychological puzzle and movement game where you must navigate surreal environments, solve puzzles, and escape before your mind collapses in on itself.

GAMEPLAY FEATURES

  • First-Person Exploration
    Experience the world directly through Alexei’s eyes as reality shifts around you.

  • Mind-Bending Puzzles
    Use logic, observation, and your own perception to solve increasingly complex challenges.

  • Fast-Paced Movement & Agility
    Run, jump, and react quickly to traverse unstable dream environments and avoid falling behind.

  • Dynamic Dream Environments
    Explore distorted locations pulled from memory, including a fractured city that constantly changes.

  • Psychological Horror Elements
    Encounter manifestations of anxiety that follow, pressure, and distort your decisions.

OBJECTIVE

Escape the dream.

Stay focused. Keep moving. Think clearly.

Because if you wake up too soon…

you may never be able to sleep again.

YOU MAKE THE DIFFERENCE.

Your mind is unpredictable. Unforgiving.

That falling feeling. That sudden jolt before waking.

Here… it doesn’t fade.

Insomnia doesn’t stop you from sleeping.

It convinces you that you can’t.

So let go.

Let your thoughts drift.

And hope you find your way out.

Original Soundtrack By Archer Angel

store_data.about_the_game:
As the hero's squire, you have two jobs: keep up with him, and pick up the loot.  Also, change his clothes while he runs and keep feeding him potions or he'll die.  So that's four jobs.

...

Also, manage all of his finances and make sure he doesn't actually run into an area that's too dangerous.  Six jobs?  That's six jobs.

While you're at it, upgrade your bag so you can hold more stuff, and your ability to more creatively stack the small items into the tiny spaces between the big things so you can run longer before needing to go back to town.  That's how life goes!

Super Loot Runner is an endless runner / inventory management / clicker / auto-battler where you play as a plucky squire following a brave hero into dangers unknown and handling the loot.

Features

  • Inventory management endless runner auto battler

    • So many genres!

  • Hundreds of levels

  • Thousands of items

    • With uncommon and rare upgrades!

  • Light RPG elements:

    • upgrade your bag size

    • maximum size of item stacks

    • level up

  • Parallax side-scrolling levels

  • Bright pixel art graphics from ansimuz and overboy

A growth-driven action RPG where you overcome brutal battles by strengthening your strength, agility, core, and mental endurance.
Form Shifts transform your combat style, and strategic choices in form selection can determine victory or defeat.

Experience a new kind of action that fuses character growth through training with dynamic mid-battle transformations.

Set across the mysterious archipelago known as the ZeNo Islands, a conflict begins against the divine rulers called the Ordivis who govern each land.

As you continue to resist overwhelming powers, you will gradually draw closer to the hidden truths of this world.

Growth is driven by training.
By strengthening both body and mind, new abilities are unlocked, fundamentally changing how you fight.

Each form alters equipment, skills, and traits.
Choosing the right form for the situation deepens the strategic layer of combat.

■COMBAT

Fast-paced action and a wide variety of formidable enemies.
Your growth and decision-making will determine the outcome of battle.

store_data.about_the_game:
Blasphemous Sister‑Obsessed Human Transmutation

Hollow Heart is a growth‑simulation game built on the theme of blasphemous, sister‑obsessed human transmutation. As the elder sister, you will do whatever you can to resurrect your beloved little sister who has died. Gather materials, strengthen her soul and body, and bring forth a sister who is ever more “perfect” and “complete.” At the end of this profane path, will you truly be able to reclaim the sister you once knew?

Human Transmutation

Your sister can be revived by offering a body and a sacrifice. To erase the sacrifice’s personality and anchor your sister’s soul, you must fuse different bodies together. Prepare stronger vessels and superior sacrifices to resurrect the ideal little sister.

Raising / Growth

After transmutation, your sister’s soul and body are fragile and short‑lived. Educate her, train her, and build a bond of trust as you face hardships together. If she reaches the end of her lifespan, use her remaining body as the foundation for the next transmutation.

Exploration / Combat

Venture out to gather the materials needed for transmutation and growth. Along the way, primitive creatures and humans bound by trivial notions of morality will stand in your path. Work together with your sister to overcome them and carve your way forward.

store_data.about_the_game:
Description

ORPHEUS: ECHO OF HADES is a visual novel based on the ancient Greek myth of Orpheus and Eurydice. The story is narrated by Hermes — an ironic and decidedly biased participant in the events.

Along the way you will encounter Charon's crossing, the throne room of Hades, the schemes of the goddess Hecate, and the hardest trial of all: three steps to the exit, with nothing but silence behind you.

The game will offer you:

  • Three endings — the canonical one, the happy one, and the one the poets chose not to write down. Which you reach depends on your choices throughout the game.

  • Rhythm mini-game: play Orpheus' song before Hades — the outcome determines how the lord of the dead responds and how events unfold from there.

  • Video effects, atmospheric scene transitions, and dynamic character sprites.

  • A single ending takes about 45 minutes – 1 hour. All three branches — up to 3 hours total.

store_data.about_the_game:
Venture through the shifting dungeons of Akirume in a mystery dungeon roguelike featuring a unique real-time / turn-based combat system and over 1900 spells to discover. Gather threads of mana, experiment with powerful magic, and forge your own path through a continent scarred by ancient catastrophe.

Welcome to the continent of Akirume. Twelve years ago, a mysterious disaster known as The Great Cataclysm plunged countless people into an endless slumber and caused strange, ever-changing dungeons to erupt across the land. Civilization now clings to survival in scattered outposts while adventurers venture into these dangerous labyrinths in search of answers.

You are Willow, an ordinary girl from one of the last remaining settlements of humanity. Unlike most adventurers, you possess no natural magic of your own. But after a fateful encounter with a peculiar demon, you gain the ability to inscribe spells onto potions you craft, allowing you to wield magic in your own unconventional way.

When a sudden robbery forces you to leave home, your journey across Akirume begins. What starts as a search for answers soon draws you into a mystery far larger than yourself. As you explore the depths of these dungeons and uncover forgotten forces shaping the world, how will you use your newfound power to alter the fate of Akirume?

store_data.about_the_game:
PUZZLES ARE THE CORE

In CHARGE.R, every location is a puzzle space filled with various tasks related to restoring energy — an obstacle that must be overcome through logic, sequence and observation.

There are no battles. No enemies. Just you, the station, mechanisms, diverse energy sources, switches, puzzles, gravitational manipulations and other tools that open the way forward. Use your logic skills and connection skills to progress.

A STORY UNFOLDED STEP BY STEP

2041. A meteor struck the Earth. This event not only marked the beginning of a catastrophe but also the dawn of a New Era — the end of all wars and humanity unification. Artificial intelligence took the role of civilization mediator and controller, guiding the development towards the future. A rapid leap in technology opens the way for the next phase of space exploration.

The Moon became a bastion of defense. It was here, the remote place where the Earth defense system against space threats was established. On its dark side, six stations were built, each shaped like a giant ring, hidden deep within craters.

Beyond the technical space, hazardous to humans, there was another realm where people could survive. Uncover the truth about what really happened in the depths of this complex and what secrets the station hides. Each puzzle is a fragment of lost history revealed through the environment, terminals, audio logs, and holograms

FROM THE DEVELOPERS

Right now, it's just the three amigos and we’re in love with Sci-Fi. Mystery, secrecy, space, and the potential future - these are the things that fill our minds and subconscious. This game partially reflects these markers and echoes of classics like 2001: A Space Odyssey, Portal and The Turing Test. So if you see those influences, that's perfectly fine. But we’re also aiming to bring something unique. We’re looking forward to different forms of energy, and what humanity might actually create on the Moon in the future. This won’t only be a launching pad for space missions but also a place to defend Earth from within.

store_data.about_the_game:
You are a British soldier during WW1, trapped in an endlessly looping trench. To get out, you will need to reach the final trench by identifying any anomalous changes that were not there before.

Carefully inspect the trench — things may not be as they seem!

  • If you spot an anomalous change, you have something to report. Go Left!

  • If you have nothing to report. Go Right!

Shellshock is a short anomaly hunting experience (up to 30 minutes) inspired by liminal spaces and psychological horror. If you correctly Identify any changes in the trench you will progress to the next loop.  If you do not correctly identify a change or you think there was a change when there wasn't, you'll go back to trench 0 and start again.  Your goal is the reach the final trench and escape.

Gameplay

  • There is nothing to report in the first trench.

  • Walk through all following trenches and look for changes.

  • Take your time. Pay attention.

  • Some changes are easy to spot; others are more difficult.

  • The trench is short, but the differences are randomised in each loop — sometimes there are no changes at all.

  • Once you are sure whether there is a change or not, exit using the appropriate door.

Features

  • Playtime is around 10–30 minutes depending on difficulty.

  • Difficulty level determines which trench number you must reach to escape.

  • Simple controls:
    WASD – Move
    Mouse – Look
    Shift - Run
    CTRL - Crouch

  • Controller supported

  • Anomalous changes in the trench will only occur once.

  • Anomalous changes will reset once all anomalies have been identified.

  • Anomalous changes can be manually reset from the options menu.

  • Some changes may include upsetting or graphic content related to themes of war and injury.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Clock is Ticking. The Grid is Waiting.

Welcome to the dispatch desk. In Rush Hour Relay, you are the logistical mastermind behind a growing delivery network. Every morning you plan. Every day you scramble. Every night you regroup.

There is always too much to do and never quite enough fuel.

The Morning

Your warehouse is stocked. Your drivers are waiting. Every slot in every cargo bag matters — and so does every kilogram.

Load Maria with dairy — she earns a bonus on those routes. Give Bob the bulk orders, he can carry twice what anyone else can. Don't put perishables on Tom's bike; he's almost out of fuel and won't make it before they turn. The red bar on that Milk isn't decoration. It's a deadline.

But watch the weight. A heavier driver burns fuel faster and moves slower. Sometimes the right call is leaving a slot empty.

You have a few minutes before orders start dropping. Make them count.

The Day

The grid comes alive. Houses light up. A $450 VIP order expires in 47 seconds. Your best regular customer just got targeted by a rival service — their scooter is already moving. Jenkins is halfway across the map with the wrong items. Emma can cover it but she'll be stranded.

You are managing five moving pieces in real time, on a map where every wrong decision costs money you don't have.

The good news: you've done this before. You're getting better. The upgrades are starting to show.

The Night

Review the day. Check the spoilage report — two milks expired on Bob's bike, that's $40 gone. Buy smarter tomorrow. Invest in cold storage or save for the engine tuning upgrade that would've gotten Tom to that VIP order in time.

The debt installment is in four days. You're $800 short. But if you load right, you'll make it.

Probably.

What's in the box

🗺️ Live Grid Map — A dense neighborhood grid with real driver movement, live fuel bars, and a rival AI that competes for your orders. Watch their scooter move toward your customer. Beat them there or lose the order.

📦 Slot-Based Cargo — Visual inventory that makes loading feel like a satisfying puzzle. Bulk items take two slots. Perishables have freshness bars. The game auto-rotates old stock first so you can focus on strategy, not bookkeeping.

⚖️ Weight vs. Speed — Every item you load adds weight. Heavier drivers move slower and burn fuel faster. Loading smart isn't just about fitting items in — it's about knowing when leaving a slot empty is the profitable move.

⛽ Fuel Station Choices — Fuel stations are scattered across the grid. When your driver stops, you decide: Quick Fill, Half Tank, or Full Tank. Every refuel costs money you might need elsewhere. Skip it and gamble on making it back.

👥 Team Dispatch — Some orders need two drivers. Click Maria for the milk, click Bob for the flour. Both bikes head to the same house. The order completes when the last item arrives. Smart assignment shows you exactly who contributes what — and locks out drivers once the order is covered.

🧩 Rank-Based Progression — You start at Rank 50 with basic stock and work toward Rank 1. Each tier unlocks new item categories with new mechanics: bulk grains that fill two slots, cold-chain products that expire in hours, premium goods worth more than a full day's regular earnings.

🌙 Three-Phase Days — Morning planning, live day execution, and night restock and upgrades. The morning determines what's possible. The day determines how well you execute. The night determines how much better tomorrow goes.

🚛 Tow Truck — Run out of fuel on the road and the order fails. A tow truck will bring your driver home and restore some fuel — but it costs $75 and seconds you can't get back. Manage your routes or pay the price.

A Note from the Developer

Thanks for checking out the game. I'm building this on my own because it's the kind of experience I've always wanted to play. Your interest, feedback, and support mean everything. They're what keep me going.

I hope you enjoy what I'm building.

About Angel Zero 

This is an action-adventure game solo developed by FcsVorfeed. In the game, you play as an (angel?) girl who signs a pact with an "Organization" under the "Zero Angel Project," taking on missions to hunt down their assigned targets.

As you play, you'll be able to grab a bunch of different weapons and items to engage in some seriously violent, close-quarters brawls with enemies. Before each mission, you can scavenge the target area for combat supplies and gear.
Once you're all set, you enter「Hunt Mode」for a brutal fight to the death with your target.

More realistic hit feel

Regarding combat and the hit feel, I am really pushing for a more realistic vibe. I have been heavily influenced by movies like John Wick and Nobody, as well as games like The Last of Us and Watch Dogs. I am trying to avoid moves that look too choreographed and instead lean into that messy, stumbling, grounded feel. Mixing that raw physicality with the wide, sweeping attacks of an angel girl creates this awesome sense of contrast in both the visuals and the actual gameplay.

Beautiful lighting effects

I've been tweaking the foliage translucency in-game.
Trying to capture that immersive feeling of sunlight filtering through the trees as you walk by.

I've also been experimenting with adding auto-exposure and god rays to the game.
This helps create much richer contrast and adds more depth between light and dark across different lighting conditions.

Adding more things to explore

Even though the game is mostly a linear action title right now, I really want to try adding some collectibles to the levels to give players that sense of discovery and immersion. Since I am a solo dev, I am constantly weighing the amount of content against what is actually doable, but I am doing my best to make the experience feel as rich as possible. Every wishlist really helps me get closer to my goal, so thank you so much for the support!
