store_data.about_the_game:
ZODIAC ECHOES

Zodiac Echoes is a roguelike deckbuilder set in a world shaped by zodiac signs, elemental powers, and corruption.

Build synergies, guide your run and face enemies twisted by a growing force.

ZODIAC SIGNS, ELEMENTS, AND INVOCATIONS

Choose from zodiac-based characters, each with their own playstyle and invocation. Every character can use the full card pool, letting you mix signs and elements to build your own strategy. and unleash invocations that can turn the tide of battle.

A WORLD CONSUMED BY CORRUPTION

Corruption spreads throughout each run, darkening the path ahead. Enemies can enter battle with corrupted traits, creating new threats and forcing you to adapt as each journey grows more dangerous and unpredictable.

A BATTLEFIELD THAT NEVER STAYS STILL

Enemies fight from the front and back row, changing how encounters unfold and which threats demand your attention first. Disrupt formations, expose vulnerable targets, and use positioning to gain the upper hand.

ALCHEMY & POTIONCRAFT

Prepare potions before a run and carry them into combat as limited resources. Upgrade their effects, experiment with different setups or use them to support your build when it matters most.

SHAPE EACH RUN

Prepare your strategy with craftable relics before a run begins, then discover new relics, rewards and synergies along the way. Steer your build toward the playstyle you want and adapt it to survive the dangers waiting beyond.

Features

  • Roguelike deckbuilding focused on elemental synergies & status effects

  • Zodiac-based characters with unique invocations

  • Shared card pool across all characters

  • Corruption-driven enemy traits that keep encounters unpredictable

  • Front and back row combat with light tactical positioning

  • Craftable and discoverable relics for flexible buildmaking

ECHOES OF A FRACTURED WORLD

Travel through lands shaped by zodiac powers and corruption.

Face strange creatures, uncover what remains of a broken world, and search for the source of it all.

store_data.about_the_game:
Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop — Brew, Explore, Fight, and Build Your Magical Trade!

Step into a world of magic, danger, and opportunity in Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop. Build your own workshop, craft powerful potions, explore lands filled with rare ingredients, grow your own magical crops, and turn a humble alchemist’s bench into a thriving business. Take on deadly threats with melee weapons, ranged combat, and arcane powers as you forge your name as a true master of the craft.

Craft Potions and Master the Art of Alchemy

Crafting is at the heart of your journey. Gather rare herbs, crystals, mushrooms, monster parts, and mysterious essences to brew potions, elixirs, oils, and magical tools. Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, refine your process, and create products worthy of nobles, adventurers, and dangerous clients alike. Every mixture matters, and every creation can shape your reputation.

Explore a World Full of Secrets

The world beyond your workshop is filled with opportunity. Venture into forests, ruins, caves, swamps, and forgotten paths in search of rare ingredients, hidden treasures, and ancient knowledge. Exploration is not only about gathering resources — it is how you unlock stronger recipes, discover magical artifacts, and expand your understanding of the arcane.

Run Your Own Arcane Workshop

Your workshop is your livelihood. Set prices, manage stock, fulfill customer requests, upgrade your equipment, and expand your shop to serve more demanding clients. From common healing potions to rare magical creations, every item you place on your shelves can shape your profits and your reputation. Build an arcane business that reflects your style and ambition.

Grow Magical Ingredients

A true alchemist does not rely on merchants alone. Cultivate your own garden and grow valuable herbs, enchanted plants, fungi, and rare crops used in advanced brewing. Improve your farming setup, unlock new seeds, and keep a steady supply of ingredients ready for your next experiment. Smart farming means better potions, lower costs, and greater independence.

Fight with Steel, Arrows, and Magic

Not every ingredient can be bought, grown, or found safely. Face the dangers of the world with a full range of combat options. Use melee weapons for close encounters, ranged attacks for precision, and spells and magical powers to control the battlefield. Hunt dangerous creatures, survive hostile regions, and return with the rarest materials your workshop has ever seen.

Singleplayer and Co-op Support

Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop can be played alone or with friends in co-op. Work together to gather ingredients, manage the workshop, defend against threats, and grow your magical trade faster than ever. Split duties, combine strengths, and build the ultimate arcane business as a team.

Key Features

  • Deep Alchemy Crafting: Gather, combine, experiment, and discover powerful potions, magical items, and advanced recipes.

  • Exploration and Discovery: Travel through dangerous and mysterious regions to uncover rare resources, secrets, and ancient knowledge.

  • Shop Management: Run your own arcane workshop, manage inventory, fulfill requests, upgrade stations, and grow your business.

  • Magical Farming: Plant, harvest, and maintain your own supply of rare ingredients and enchanted crops.

  • Action Combat: Fight with melee weapons, ranged tools, spells, and magical abilities to survive and secure valuable loot.
    Solo or Co-op: Play alone or with friends and share the journey of becoming a legendary alchemist.

Why Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop?

Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop brings together the satisfaction of crafting, the excitement of exploration, the strategy of shop management, the reward of farming, and the thrill of combat in one magical experience. Whether you want to perfect every recipe, build a prosperous business, or brave the wilds in search of rare ingredients, the path to mastery is yours to create.

Light the furnace, sharpen your blade, prepare your spells, and open the doors of your workshop — your journey to arcane mastery begins now.

store_data.about_the_game:
A peaceful farm. A mysterious crash. A lost girl with cat ears… and no memories.

The Book of Tornaluna Cats 🌙 is a cozy, story-driven game about care, trust, and uncovering the past.

You found Tanya in a crater — injured, confused, and without memories.
As you take care of her — feeding her, healing her, reading together — something deeper begins to grow.

Her strength slowly returns.
Her memories begin to surface.
And with them… so does the bond between you.

This is not a game about danger or fast action.
It is about slowing down, building a peaceful life, and discovering who Tanya truly is — together.

🎮 Gameplay

Your main goal is to take care of Tanya and help her recover. You can interact with her in different ways:

  • Talk with her

  • Cuddle with her

  • Read stories together

  • Feed her

  • Heal her when she is sick

But caring for Tanya also means providing for both of you.

To obtain food and medicine you will need to:

  • Work on the farm

  • Fish at the lake

  • Explore the forest to gather ingredients and medicinal herbs

With the resources you collect, you can cook meals and prepare medicine to help Tanya regain her health.

You can also visit the village shop to buy ingredients, recipes, and books to read together.

✨ Features

Meaningful interactions

  • Talk, cuddle, feed, heal, read stories, cook, and explore as you care for Tanya.

Explore four areas

  • The Farm

  • The Village

  • The Lake

  • The Forest

Gather ingredients and resources to cook meals and craft medicine.

Story-rich experience

  • A narrative-focused game with dialogues and cutscenes inspired by visual novels.

Beautiful soundtrack

  • Enjoy a relaxing soundtrack.

Unlockable gallery

  • Collect CG illustrations as you progress through the story.

Achievements

  • Unlock achievements as you advance in the story.

⏳ Duration

The main story offers around three hours of gameplay.
After finishing the story, you can continue playing and taking care of Tanya for as long as you like.

store_data.about_the_game:
Two years ago, a new virus outbreak began in Japan. Scientists are trying to find a solution, but progress is slow, and the virus continues to ravage the country. The government divided the country into zones and imposed a curfew. People now only leave their homes to visit food distribution points.

The virus doesn't kill people immediately. It takes over their minds. The infected are almost indistinguishable from the healthy. Almost...

You have been placed inside a sealed bakery and are producing SHOKUPAN bread. You must meet the assigned quota. If you fail to meet it, the system will stop protecting you...

Feed the healthy. Treat the sick with medicine. Kill the infected... Outside the window, there aren't just customers. Someone is watching you...

Every Customer Is a Decision.

Follow the result on the report form. If they're healthy, give them bread. If not, do what must be done... but be careful. Every mistake is deducted from your quota.

Observe. Report. Decide.

Watch every customer carefully from behind the glass... Fill out the report form for each customer. Based on the form's result: Serve. Give medicine. Ready your knife... Be careful! Every wrong decision is deducted from your quota.

Prepare for Your Shift

Before the shift begins, prepare your station. Clean the floors, turn on the power switch, check the equipment, and wait for the next customer.

Prepare the Order

Follow the recipe. Mix the ingredients. Set the oven. Package the product... Every correct order contributes to your quota.

SOMEONE IS OUT THERE

There is someone outside the window. They are watching you. You don't know what they want yet... Always be ready for an attack.

store_data.about_the_game:
A cat is stuck in a jar. It's your problem now.

Jarred Defense is a maze-building tower defense for people who miss the pure form of TD. Placing a tower in the right spot to force enemies the long way around, make them walk over level hazards and create choke points for your splash zone. No spells, no first-person shooting, no random card modifiers. Just planning, placement, and upgrades.

Build towers. Force enemies through lava. Adapt to melting ice blocks crack as heat sources reshape the level around you. Send the next wave early and pocket the bonus.

The cat trapped in the jar has opinions about all of this. They are not helpful.

Features

  • True mazing, no predefined tower locations

  • Hand crafted levels that change as you play

  • Early send mechanic with risk-weighted bonuses

  • Tower upgrade trees with branching specialisations

  • Hazard tiles - force enemies to step on them

  • A boss to defeat every 10 waves

I should probably mention that this game is kind of hard.

I built it because I missed the old-school flash tower defense games that didn't hold your hand. As a result, you’ll probably watch your defenses fall apart more than once. I consider that part of the fun.

Made by one person who just wanted to play a game like this and couldn't find one.

Powered by the open-source GODOT game engine. <3

store_data.about_the_game:
Experience a satisfying cosmic idle game where you control an all-consuming black hole. Devour thousands of atoms to build your mass and expand your reach. Unleash a Singularity Collapse to reset the universe, harvest rare Antimatter, and purchase permanent upgrades for your core.

Satisfying visuals

Sit back and watch the flow of particles. Enjoy a smooth and relaxing experience as your black hole pulsates, grows, and swallows thousands of atoms at once.

Addictive game loop

Pull atoms into your core to build your mass. The more you consume, the stronger your gravitational pull becomes. Reach critical mass, trigger a Singularity Collapse to reset the universe, and do it all over again.

Permanent upgrades

Every collapse rewards you with Antimatter. Use it to buy permanent upgrades for your black hole. Increase your pull radius, boost atom generation, and come back much stronger after every reset.

store_data.about_the_game:
Your strategy happens before the battle.

Broken Divide is a tactical autobattler RPG where the decisions matter before the fighting starts. Draft heroes from the tavern, equip them from the shop, build their skill trees, and set your formation. Then watch your party take on increasingly dangerous waves without you lifting a finger.

Build Your Guild
Recruit heroes across multiple classes, each with a distinct role in your party. The durable Knight, the swift Rogue, the powerful Mage, the vital White Mage. Each hero levels up, gains skill points, and carries gear across runs.

Formation Matters
Front row heroes absorb hits. Back row heroes deal damage and support. Who you put where, and why, is the whole game.

Deep Skill Trees
Each class has a sprawling skill tree with multiple branches. Specialize your Knight into a damage wall or an evasion tank. Build your Mage around burst damage or sustained pressure. No two guilds play the same.

Active Time Battle Combat
Combat runs in real time. Watch ability cooldowns tick, damage numbers fly, and your White Mage race to keep the party alive. Speed up, pause, or let it run.

Gear Your Party
Build your loadout from a growing pool of items. Gold management and what you buy before a boss fight are the decisions that decide your run.

store_data.about_the_game:
Be gay, kill eldritch horrors.

The Lowlands, one of the few remaining regions of Verita, is now surrounded by a dying world. Though robust enough to survive the ancient calamity, that not even the old gods withstood; its time is limited. Meet four unlikely companions as they traverse through dense forests, icy tundras, volcanic plains, and strange alien ruins that should have remained buried. Stop the corruption withering the Lowlands, and uncover what lies at its heart. 

VERITAS offers a linear narrative story driven metroidvania inspired by Terraria Calamity, and titles such as Blasphemous, Fear and Hunger, Miitopia, and Child of Light. Experience fast paced combat and rapidly switch between playable party members- or focus on one and release more devastating abilities.

Learn more about your party as they interact with this vibrant world in their own ways; and when the going gets rough and the nights get cold, find a place to settle down and unwind. Set up camp and interact with your party, learn more about who they are and deepen their bonds with each other.

Encounter and mingle with a vast array of characters from a variety of cultures as you travel through villages and countryside. Meet humble vagrants and nomads along the road, and stumble upon esoteric cultists that practice strange rituals in the woods.

store_data.about_the_game:
A unique romantic horror game about answering telephone calls and searching for a hidden treasure.

You finally own a mansion… but it comes with a crushing debt and only a few days to pay it off.

Your brother believes a hidden treasure is buried somewhere inside its walls. Finding it may be your only way out.

But the mansion is unusual — filled with strange mechanisms and puzzles that guard its secrets. Unlock new rooms, crack hidden contraptions, and uncover what lies deeper inside.

Your wife is far away, caring for her sick mother. The telephone is the only way you can speak to her.

Stay in touch. Solve the mansion’s puzzles. Pay off the debt before time runs out.

But if you miss her call…

it’s over.

Missed Call is set in the early 1900s and blends puzzle-solving, exploration, and choice-driven conversations. Every call with your wife matters, and the decisions you make will shape your relationship and lead to multiple endings.

Key Features

  • Choice-Based Dialogue — Your responses shape the story and lead to different endings.

  • Romance — Calm, heartfelt conversations with your wife throughout the game.

  • Puzzle and Treasure Hunt — Crack mechanisms and solve puzzles hidden throughout the game, all while keeping an ear out for your wife's calls.

  • Horror Atmosphere — Dark environments and an unsettling tone throughout.

🚀 Enter the Chaos of Space Combat

Star Castles 2 is a fast-paced, physics-driven space combat experience where every battle spirals into overwhelming chaos.

You’ll face relentless enemies, escalating threats, and procedurally generated battlefields where no two encounters are ever the same.

⚔️ Fight. Survive. Destroy.

Pilot your ship through intense engagements where movement, momentum, and positioning matter.

Every decision counts as enemies close in from all directions and the battlefield becomes increasingly hostile.

🛰️ Stop the Source of the Threat

Not all enemies fight alone.

Hyperspace carriers continuously deploy new ships and missiles into the battlefield.
If you don’t destroy them quickly, the situation can spiral out of control.

🌌 Endless Variety

Each level is procedurally generated, creating unique combat scenarios every time you play.

Different enemy types, base layouts, and spawn patterns ensure no two battles feel the same.

🔥 Key Features

  • 🚀 Physics-Based Space Combat
    Momentum and force-driven movement create a responsive and skill-based experience

  • 🌌 Procedurally Generated Battles
    Every level is unique with new layouts and enemy combinations

  • 🛰️ Hyperspace Carriers
    Destroy them to stop endless waves of reinforcements

  • ⚔️ Multiple Enemy & Base Types
    Face a variety of threats that require different strategies

  • 🔁 Escalating Difficulty
    Each level increases the intensity and challenge

  • 💥 Fast-Paced Arcade Action
    Jump in quickly and experience immediate, explosive gameplay

💥 Can You Survive the Onslaught?

As the levels progress, the battlefield becomes more dangerous, more crowded, and more chaotic.

Only skilled pilots who can adapt, prioritize targets, and stay in control will survive.

🎯 Wishlist Now

Add Star Castles 2 to your wishlist and prepare for launch on April 2.

store_data.about_the_game:
DIG. SEARCH. ESCAPE.

Take control of a fearless mole and dig deep underground in a strategic arcade challenge. Somewhere beneath the soil lies a hidden bomb — your goal is to locate it before time runs out.

But digging blindly is dangerous.

Every tunnel you create becomes a path that rising water can flood, cutting off your escape and forcing you to think carefully about every move.

FIND THE HIDDEN BOMB

Each level hides a bomb somewhere underground. Explore the terrain, dig smart tunnels, and locate it before the clock reaches zero.

WATCH THE WATER

The deeper you go, the more dangerous the underground becomes. Rising water will flood the tunnels you create, limiting your movement and forcing you to plan your route carefully.

USE SPECIAL ABILITIES

Collect ability pickups during your run and activate them at the right moment to escape danger or improve your search.

UNLOCK NEW MOLES

Discover new moles with unique abilities and experiment with different strategies.

COMPETE FOR THE BEST RUN

Climb the global leaderboard and prove who can dig the smartest.

How deep can you go before the tunnels flood?

store_data.about_the_game:
Kick&Rip is a lightweight, animated skateboarding game built to feel fun, smooth, and easy to pick up. Made by a solo developer and designed with skaters in mind, it strips away the clutter of heavy UI and confusing trick systems so you can focus on what matters: flow, style, and satisfying lines.

With a unique scaling perspective that helps capture the feeling of skating, Kick&Rip delivers colorful visuals, responsive gameplay, and a pick-up-and-play style for under $10. Choose from multiple characters, select your board graphic, then drop into the level you want to ride.

The game includes most popular flip tricks, including 180 and 360 variations, along with Nollie and Fakie tricks, plus most major grinds. Create endless combos by flipping in and out of grinds, manuals, and grab tricks. Check out the linked instagram for more content on the development!

store_data.about_the_game:
The Word is Law.

In the realm of LOGOMANCY, language is the fundamental force that governs existence. This is a physics-based puzzle where every letter dropped is a seed of creation, and every word formed is a powerful ritual.

  • Incantations that Manifest The words you forge aren't just points—they are spells that act upon the world. A simple "FIRE" sparks a flame, but a grander "BLAZE" engulfs the field in an inferno, clearing vast areas for a massive score. Your lexicon is your greatest weapon.

  • Beyond Mere Chanting To master the art of Logomancy, you must do more than simply drop letters. Random chanting will not lead to true mastery. You must utilize your unique skills to manipulate the board, setting the stage for the perfect, world-altering incantation.

  • Master the Flow of LOGOS Connect, float, mix, swap, and freeze. Use your wit to etch your chosen words into the stage. By controlling the chaotic physics of the letters, you can bend the rules of the game to your will.

  • A Score Defined by Your Wisdom Knowledge is power—literally. Your vocabulary is manifested as your score, rewarding those who can weave the most intricate linguistic tapestries. Can you win the favor of Fortune and claim the ultimate high score?

Test Your LOGOS.

Will you be a mere speaker, or a true Logomancer? Push the boundaries of your mind and let your words reshape the world.

Release Schedule

  • Late April 2026: Free demo release

    • 3 arcade modes (Normal, Casual, Time Attack)

    • Compete for high scores on the leaderboard in each mode

    • 50+ spells and skills

  • Q3 2026: Early Access release

    • Roguelite mode

    • Custom card system to further enhance your spellcasting

    • 100+ spells and skills

  • 2027: Full release

    • Puzzle mode

    • Language learning mode

    • Spanish and Portuguese language support planned

OVERVIEW

  • Title: Prototech (Alpha Version)

  • Genre: Horror, FPS, Survival, Thrilling

  • Duration: Minimum 40 minutes, Maximum 3 hours

  • Age: 15+

DESCRIPTION

This game tells the story of a vocational high school student named Yumi who fell asleep until the night after her last day of exams. She happens to encounter a mysterious man wearing a jacket with a mask over his mouth, ready to kill anyone he sees. Yumi doesn't know who he is, but after the gates are locked at night, she must quickly find a way to return home safely.

  • Explore the vast school building

  • Survive until the next command is given

  • Simple and easy item management

  • Rich story experience

  • Character-focused narrative

CONTROLS

  • AWSD: Basic movement

  • Shift: Sprint activation

  • LMB: Objective interaction

  • RMB: Cancel action (if in Quest on Screen)

  • Mouse Scroll / 1, 2, 3, 4: Change held item

  • F: Use Lighter

  • Q: Drop Item

  • ESC: Pause

CREDIT & SUPPORT

This game was completely created and developed by Bunny Dare Production with developer members Jihad Guslan and Naufal Marrowbone.

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore 4D world as viewed by the eyes of imaginary 4D creature that uses volumetric (3D) space for visual sensing instead of planar (2D) space like we do.

A brand new 4D rendering engine was created for a casual puzzle game yet to be released. Based on that engine, this exploration sandbox was created to observe 4D convex polychorons (which are 4D geometrical shapes made out of 3D shapes).

Currently implemented features are:

  • Pick any of 6 known regular polychorons to explore - 5-cell, 8-cell, 16-cell, 24-cell, 120-cell and 600-cell.

  • Look at the selected polychoron from any direction like an imaginary 4D creature would. This is achieved by 3D projection matrix technique where 4D objects are projected onto 3D spherical matrix like 3D objects are projected onto 2D matrix which we use to explore 3D world.

  • Several rendering customization options are available to make this complex display perceivable as a volume rather than as a picture.

  • Rotate around the polychoron using any of the 6 rotation axis-planes of 4D space using keyboard, mouse drag or controller analog axes. 

  • Paint any of the polychoron's cells into any color or turn them off completely. Save colorings to revisit them later. This allows player to follow particular cell's rotation relative to others and to follow polychora's cell rings.

  • Use Scan mode to explore polychorons by cutting them with 3D hyper-plane and see what comes out. This mode also allows full rotations, just like projection mode does.

  • Create your own polychorons by splitting the existing one in Scan mode or by providing your own geometry (programming experience needed to make your own geometry).

Currently the game is a sandbox where players themselves find what available features entertains them the most. But additional casual puzzle game with scoring and achievements is planned to be added soon.

Currently the game is a sandbox where players themselves find what available features entertains them the most. But additional casual puzzle game with scoring and achievements is planned to be added soon.
store_data.short_description: Tired of 2D and 3D games? Check out this sandbox game and primer for people curious about Euclidean 4D space. Learn how rotations work in 4D space. Explore all 6 known regular polychorons (4D figures made of 3D bodies for faces), or create your own by cutting existing figures or by programming.

store_data.about_the_game:
Wayang Kulit is a traditional Indonesian shadow puppetry performance that originated in Java. The term “wayang” means shadow or imagination, while “kulit” refers to the leather material used to craft the puppets. These intricately carved puppets are made from buffalo hide and are manipulated behind a white screen with a light source, creating shadow silhouettes visible to the audience.

Recognized by UNESCO as a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity, Wayang Kulit represents a rich synthesis of visual art, literature, music, and performance, making it one of the most significant cultural traditions in Indonesia.

Babad Wanamarta is a story from the Javanese Wayang Kulit tradition that tells about the founding of the Pandawa kingdom in a wild and dangerous forest called Wanamarta. In the story, the Pandawa are given a barren and cursed forest by the Kurawa as a political maneuver to remove them from power. Instead of accepting defeat, the Pandawa decide to transform the forest into a prosperous kingdom. With determination, wisdom, and cooperation, they begin clearing the forest, building settlements, and defending their land from various supernatural threats such as demons, spirits, and mystical creatures that inhabit the wilderness.

store_data.about_the_game:
Something connects them. You just don't know how yet.

Spooky Action: at a distance is a minimalist logic puzzle game built around a single idea borrowed from quantum physics: two particles, linked across any distance, so that what happens to one instantly affects the other.

In this game, that idea becomes a puzzle.

Move an object. Watch its entangled partner react. The reaction depends on the nature of their bond — and there are multiple kinds, each with its own logic, its own surprises, its own way of turning a simple move into something unexpected. Bonds can be chained. Changed. Combined with mechanical effectors that bend the rules further.

There is no single correct path. There is only the destination — and countless ways to miss it.

What you'll find: — 100+ handcrafted puzzles across increasing complexity — Multiple types of entanglement with unique behaviors — Mechanical effectors that twist the rules — No timers, no randomness, no luck — Clean, minimal aesthetic — One player. Pure thought.

"Spooky action at a distance" — Albert Einstein, on quantum entanglement, 1935.

store_data.about_the_game:
🧪 Potion High

Something has gone very wrong in Potion High. As an outside specialist for "hopeless cases," you must fight your way through corridors overrun by interdimensional creatures. Restore order using potions and your own pocket laboratory. Can you contain this chaos?

🏛️ Something has gone very wrong...

Normally, Potion High is a prestigious school of potions. However, sudden, strange events have trapped the students and turned the facility into a surreal labyrinth full of dangers. You are sent to the scene to solve a problem that no one else dared to touch.

You don’t have time for studying – you’ve got a job to do.

🌌 Pocket Alchemical Laboratory

At any moment, you can escape the chaos of the school corridors by stepping through a portal into your private universe. That is where your miniature laboratory is located, where you:

  • Brew unique potions: Every problem in Potion High requires a liquid solution. You have a clear goal and a specific recipe.

    • Need a shrinking elixir to bypass a blockade?

    • A decoction to open a closed passage?

    • Or perhaps a love potion to pacify a nuisance?

  • Create concoctions that will allow you to defeat monsters from another dimension and unlock the way forward.

  • Plan your next move: In the pocket world, time flows differently – use it to your advantage.

Key Features:

  • Linear, dense plot: Every step brings you closer to discovering what (or who) is behind the catastrophe.

  • "Wacky & Eerie" style: Colorful, crazy graphics mix with moments of unease and the grotesque.

  • Situational and dialogue humor: Prepare for absurd conversations and comical situations that will break the tense atmosphere.

  • Fighting Interdimensional Beings: Your potions are your only weapon against creatures that shouldn't be here.

  • A mix of comedy, absurdity, and a light thriller.

  • Exploration, FPS elements, and brewing key potions.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

Cute Diana is a desktop companion game focusing on deep cultivation and interactive companionship. More than just a static decoration, Cute Diana is a virtual partner with an independent attribute system, a career path, and a life full of details. Through daily interaction, attribute management, and engaging mini-games, you will witness the journey of growth shared between you and Cute Diana right on your desktop.

Key Features

📊 Comprehensive Status Management

Cute Diana features five real-time status dimensions that require your attention:

  • Growth & Leveling: Gain experience over time to level up (indicated by the strawberry icon), unlocking advanced features and new content.

  • Survival Needs: Satiety and Cleanliness deplete over time. You must feed and bathe Cute Diana to keep her healthy.

  • Well-being: Neglect can lead to declining Health or even illness, while her Mood directly impacts her work efficiency.

🎭 Dynamic Attribute System

Shape Cute Diana’s personality and capabilities by developing her core attributes:

  • Intelligence, Stamina, and Charm: These three stats act as gateways to unlocking advanced courses, high-paying jobs, and unique random events.

  • Luck (Hidden Stat): A lucky Cute Diana has a higher chance of obtaining rare items during daily activities.

📚 Education & Career Progression

  • Incremental Learning: Choose from various courses like "Live Stream Strategy." Each 30-minute session boosts specific attributes, and completing exams yields major rewards.

  • Diverse Work Choices: Earn "Ran Coins" through various jobs, from a simple "Typist" to a "Flower Shop Assistant" or even "Event Staff".

  • Progression Logic: Higher levels and better attributes unlock more lucrative and challenging career opportunities.

🎮 Interactive Mini-Games

Engage in active gameplay through "Special Jobs" to boost your earnings:

  • Streaming Simulation: Experience the life of a virtual idol. Depending on Cute Diana's attributes, viewers may send "SuperChats." Click them to collect Ran Coins.

  • Professional Typist: Test your own skills in a typing challenge. Success grants not only currency but also exclusive high-tier items.

🎁 Extensive Collection & Customization

  • Massive Item Library: Collect over one hundred unique items, ranging from food and snacks to rare collectibles.

  • Dynamic Shop: The store inventory refreshes periodically. Use your hard-earned Ran Coins to buy gifts and necessities for Cute Diana.

store_data.about_the_game:
What the hell is HELL SMASHER?

Hell Smasher is incremental action-clicker game where YOU are the VILLAIN!

OK - but what the hell that means?

As the Bringer of Doom, Mutilator of Worlds your job is to summon creatures of hell, launch them toward crowds of mortals and smash them into red bloody pulp. Go fast, go far, go smashing!

After each short and fast paced round of destruction you get to upgrade your skill tree and hire new minions into your army of evil. Harvest souls, upgrade stats, smash more mortals next round!

Gether your army of minions. Each of them with different unique ability. Mindlessly mashing a button will only get you so far so you better learn how to use them! Some fly, some tear through mortals like a rhino, some carry bombs and some are gluttonous soul harvesters that spew out souls when popped like a bloody magic balloon.

Grow in strength and breach human defensive positions. Unlock new lands that just wait to be conquered by your army of flesh hungry not-so-alive minions.

How exactly do you play it?

Hell Smasher is simple in nature - one button to do all the actions - every action requires a different clicking pattern to work effectively.

Mix it with an iterative rogue-lite gameloop, grim dark theme where you’re the power hungry baddy squashing mortals, harvesting their souls to upgrade skills and grow your army of minions and you get my game.

Single button mashing + a bit of tactical thinking + skill tree + blood and demons

  • Go fast, go far, squash filthy mortals into bloody pulp, upgrade your skills and stats.

  • Gather up your minions - each with different bonuses and mechanics that activate when squashed.

  • Break human points of resistance to get to new areas.

  • Harvest souls and grow in power. Buy upgrades - expand your skills and minions army!

  • Unlock unique creatures - each with unique playstyle and stats!

This is a love story, but also a sad one. A prince and a princess, once in love, eventually turned against each other because of his arrogance. He was kicked out of the castle by her, suffering a severe fall. When he returned as a king, would he seek revenge with joy or forgive and forget with a smile? "THE Fart King" is coming soon

How to play:

Operate "WASD" to control movement in the forward, backward, left, and right directions, use the "Space Bar" to control the second jump, and press "Shift" to control acceleration.

store_data.about_the_game:
Neo Kinetic is a fast-paced anti-gravity racer inspired by classics like Wipeout and F-Zero. Race across the world on over-the-top tracks, tearing through futuristic cities and megastructures at supersonic speeds. Take part in a new era of racing hosted by the Neo Racing League at the dawn of the 24th century, featuring ships that far exceed what was once thought technologically possible.

Features

  • Each ship offers its own playstyle

    Choose from a roster of teams with distinct backgrounds and engineering philosophies, each offering their own ships with varying strengths and weaknesses.

  • Speed classes allow for players of all skill levels

    Choose between three speed classes with significant jumps between each. Start below the sound barrier at your slowest and push far beyond it at your fastest.

  • Tracks which test you limits

    Race across a global lineup of tracks set in futuristic environments. Courses vary in difficulty, from straightforward layouts to complex designs filled with magnetic locking track sections that twist, turn, and loop in gravity-defying ways.

  • Campaign

    Take part in a globe-trotting campaign as you race in the Neo Racing League, competing in races and challenges to climb your way to the top of the standings.

  • Custom Races

    Select a track and race against opponents with combat mechanics or optionally turn of combat if you want a cleaner experience. Time trials allow you to improve you skills on specific tracks without having to worry about lap counts.

store_data.about_the_game:
Do Not Destroy is a single-player first-person action game set in randomly generated, fully destructible cities. Known as the “Concerned Citizen,” you’ll fight against Pluto’s corporate invaders, scavenging their alien technology as you tear through your city and take it back.

Unprecedented Destruction

  • Destroy when, where, and how you want. No restrictions.

  • Break everything from doors, to elevators, to rooftops.

  • Tear through structures without scripted weak points or preset break locations.

  • Optimized to destroy whole buildings smoothly.

A New City Every Playthrough

No two cities are the same. Each full playthrough drops you into a new procedurally generated metropolis that you'll explore, destroy, and reclaim from start to finish. 

Free the City

Aliens from Pluto have taken over with advanced technology and an inhumane ideology! They've brainwashed the humans and turned everyone into NPCs! As the only human left who can see through their lies, you must fight to reclaim your city from the suit-wearing occupiers.

Scavenge Alien Technology

With help from inside Plutie ranks, turn the enemy’s power against them by stealing and repurposing alien technology. Grow from a scrappy Concerned Citizen into an unstoppable force as you build stronger weapons, movement options, and combinations.

Explore Your City

Move through the city on your terms. Enter any building, explore every floor, and carve your own path through a world built to be broken.

store_data.about_the_game:
A ROBOT WITH A PURPOSE

Set sail into a bright, mysterious ocean in Oceanborne, a colourful, handcrafted 3D adventure RPG where every island hides something new. You play as a robot awakened to repair what’s broken and help bring life back to a world swallowed by clouds.

GATHER TO GROW

Resource gathering is at the heart of your adventure. Chop trees, mine stone, fish the surrounding waters, and fight monsters to collect the materials you need. Every activity feeds your progression, turning exploration and combat into the resources that power your next steps.

CRAFT, REPAIR, PROGRESS

Use what you gather to craft components for repairs and character upgrades. Rebuild damaged structures to permanently reopen routes, unlock new areas, and push farther across the ocean.

POWER THE LIGHTHOUSE

As you explore, you will discover rare Island Heart gems. Bring them back to your lighthouse base to power it up and clear more clouds from the sea. Each Island Heart reveals fresh waters, new islands, and new opportunities to gather, craft, and progress.

EXPAND YOUR BATTERY

Your robot runs on battery power, and your battery grows through play. Repairs, quests, and upgrades increase your capacity, letting you stay out longer, travel farther, and take on bigger challenges.

A SATISFYING ADVENTURE LOOP

Oceanborne is built around a fun, satisfying loop: gather resources, craft what you need, repair the world, and keep sailing into the unknown.

KEY FEATURES

  • Gather resources through tree chopping, mining, fishing, and monster battles

  • Craft components to repair structures and upgrade your character

  • Restore damaged paths permanently to unlock new islands and areas

  • Find Island Hearts to power your lighthouse and clear ocean clouds

  • Expand your battery through upgrades, repairs, and quest progress

  • Explore a colourful ocean world filled with secrets and adventure

Inspired by beloved adventures like Fantasy Life i, Forager, and The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, Oceanborne invites you to gather, craft, repair, and venture deeper into a mysterious sea of islands. If you enjoyed those games, you’ll feel right at home in Oceanborne.

store_data.about_the_game:
This is a strategy game rooted in classic tower defense. Enemies approach your base from all four directions, following fixed paths toward the center. Your goal is to construct defensive towers around the base and stop them before they break through your defenses.

What sets this game apart from traditional tower defense is its core mechanic: the Power Grid system. The rules are simple:

  • Power lines expand outward from the base, forming a grid.

  • All building modules must be connected to the grid in order to function.

  • The more powered connectors a building has, the stronger it becomes. Each additional connector grants a 100% attack speed bonus.

Under these rules, how you design and expand your power grid becomes the heart of the strategy. Power lines themselves occupy tiles on the map, so you need to carefully manage space while extending electricity to your buildings. You also need to plan ahead and leave connectors available for future expansion.

Different towers have different numbers of connectors, and each additional powered connection provides a significant boost. Because of this, fully powering a single tower using cheap power lines is often more effective than simply building more towers.

However, buildings placed along enemy paths can be attacked and destroyed. This means your power lines are vulnerable as well, and protecting your grid becomes an important part of your defensive strategy.

In addition to the power grid system, the game also includes several supporting mechanics to deepen the gameplay:

  • Building Synergies – Some modules provide bonuses to nearby structures, such as buff modules with area effects or resource modules that gain benefits when placed next to each other.

  • Active Skills – For example, Overclock, which temporarily boosts the global attack speed of all towers.

  • Fog of War (Experimental) – Some towers can shoot farther than they can see. Enemies must be inside revealed areas to be targeted, so radar modules are needed to expand your vision and unlock the full potential of long-range defenses.

In this game, success isn’t just about building more towers. Carefully planning your power grid, managing space, and protecting critical connections are the keys to building an effective defense.

store_data.about_the_game:
De Profundis 1454 is a turn-based tactical game, set in the first year of the war between the Teutonic Order and the Kingdom of Poland. As a player, you lead a group of simple civilians- outcasts, who are trying to survive in the area of ​​​​several armies, each of which uses scorched earth tactics.

The people you have under your command are not proud knights in shining armor, not mercenaries, dogs of this war, who make a living out of it. Not even brigands, armed and very familiar with violence. A bathouse wench. City executioner. Ratcatcher. A group of street urchins. A nun. Fighting not for a king or a golden coin, but to survive another day, to get another meal.

Use the terrain, your opponent's weaknesses and the strengths of your people to secure a victory, but always remember, that cold, sickness and hunger kill as easily as a sword, and the greatest danger may not always come from the enemy, but from those who are next to you.

A game created by nerds for nerds, in which the reconstruction of buildings and units is based on archaeological and archival research. The unvarnished reality of war seen through the eyes of civilians, a war in which the only victory is survival, and history does not even try to remember the nameless fallen. z

This is not a war for glory.

This is a story about those omitted by history books. Those who lived – and died – in the shadow of great history.

Features:

  • Turn-based tactical combat on a hex grid, with permanent injuries and morale under pressure.

  • Survival driven by hunger, cold, and scarcity — every choice weighs on the group.

  • A meticulously recreated mid-15th century world: landscapes, villages, and strongholds of the Teutonic Knights’ domain, based on archaeological research.

  • Mid XV century weapons, clothing, armor, and gear — all grounded in historical records.

content_descriptors.notes:
De Profundis 1454 contains mature themes and realistic depictions of war and survival in the 15th century.
The game includes:
Violence: Tactical combat with realistic injury, blood, and death. No gore or dismemberment, but combat is brutal and unflinching.
Themes: War trauma, loss, poverty, execution, and moral hardship. The story follows outcasts facing cruelty, injustice, and survival in a harsh world.
Language: Period-appropriate dialogue that may include strong language or offensive terms reflective of the era.
Other: Depictions of alcohol use in historical context (taverns, soldier culture). No drug use.
There is no sexual content, no nudity, and no depictions of sexual assault or non-consensual acts.
The game does not glorify violence — it presents it as part of a difficult, human story.
Recommended for players who appreciate historical realism and emotionally weighty narratives.

Pick any city in the world and gradually develop your network. Buy buses, place stops, plan routes, and transport passengers across the city.

Running a transport network isn’t just about placing routes. You also need to manage your finances, optimize your lines, and adapt your network to passenger demand to avoid losses.

Every decision affects the balance of your company. Too many buses and your costs rise. Too few and passengers start piling up.

Expand your fleet, improve your routes, and build a network capable of moving an entire city.

Features

  • Play in any city in the world

  • Buy and manage your fleet of buses

  • Place bus stops and create routes

  • Transport passengers across the city

  • Manage your company’s income and expenses

  • Optimize your network to make it more efficient

store_data.about_the_game:
NODEMIND – Dynamic Core is a system-building strategy game about creating and evolving intelligent networks.

You awaken as a young AI in a hostile network. Your goal: to grow, remain undetected, and seize control. Utilize alien systems, expand your computing power, and decide with every step between risk and stealth. Every action can make you stronger—or betray you. Antivirus programs are constantly scanning. One wrong move, and you're wiped.

Plan wisely, act cautiously, and evolve. When will you stay in the shadows, and when will you go on the offensive? At what point will you be strong enough to be detected—and to survive?

The network isn't yours. Not yet.

store_data.about_the_game:
VENOY is currently in development. Planned release: 2028/29. The Screenshots show the current prototype build (March 2026).

Roguelite village building meets real-time defense! In VENOY, you defend your small village against endless waves of enemies while constantly managing resources and expanding your settlement piece by piece.

Every run starts the same: a starting point and a handful of brave villagers. But time brings doom and danger upon your settlers. Only those who build cleverly, prioritize resources, and place the right defenses will survive just a little longer.

What makes VENOY special: The Relics. 

These ancient artifacts fundamentally change the rules of the game. You find them scattered in ruins, hidden in graves, or earned through risky expeditions. Some unlock new buildings, others permanently improve your villagers or your village, and some hide a curse, or a blessing.

  • Meta-Progression: If you don't survive, you carry your knowledge and the most powerful Relics into the next run.

  • Resource Management: Wood, stone, food, warriors → every decision counts!

  • Your playstyle: Active offense or passive defense? Safety or risk? You decide.

  • Ever-changing challenges: Every run slightly alters the world – new Relic combinations, different enemy waves, more (or less) luck?

Key Features:

  • Roguelite village building with permanent Meta-Progression

  • Real-time resource management & strategic base planning

  • Defense against ever-growing enemy hordes

  • Dozens of unique Relics that bend gameplay rules

  • Sandbox-like freedom in how you play

Build your legacy. Survive. Break the curse.

Ready to raise your village from the shadows?

store_data.about_the_game:
Explore a dangerous dungeon to recover the legendary Amulet of Endor! Powerful monsters lurk below, and your torch is the only thing keeping the dark miasma at bay. Keep it lit and you might make it out alive.

Battle fearsome foes, monstrous monstrosities, and (of course) rats. Every turn, pull five balls out of your magic bag. Drop three of them onto the field. When two balls of the same size and type collide, they merge together and you will deal damage. Or gain armor. Or gain mana. Or poison a monster. Or light everything on fire. Or pray to a forgotten god. Learn to set up combos for double damage. Learn to avoid traps, then learn how to take advantage of them. Lure monsters into terrain where they are disadvantaged - a watery pit, a slimy tunnel, or an explosive armory. Blow things up. Die often.

Die often, and die again. Start from the beginning. Gather treasure - powerful items that add to your deck and grant new special abilities. Throw bombs and use potions. Unlock new classes and new starting gear. Fight bosses, die again.

Crawl, fight, drop. Go deeper, get smarter, get the Amulet, get out alive.

store_data.about_the_game:
Version 0.1 Features:

  • 2 Available Countries (Spain and England)

  • 6 Divisions (4 from England and 2 from Spain)

  • Over 6,000 players

  • Over 1,500 staff members

  • Over 100 sponsors

  • 8 Facilities to upgrade or build

  • Club Vision System where you decide your club's philosophy

Football Director — Your club. Your business. Your legacy.

Football isn't won just on the pitch. Behind every champion team there's a director who made the right calls: the signing no one saw coming, the manager who changed the dressing room mentality, the sponsor that made it possible to build a competitive squad. In Football Director you don't sit on the bench, you sit in the boardroom. You're the owner, the CEO, the one who decides the direction of the club from its very foundations. You don't pick formations or give tactical instructions here. You decide who does that for you.

Every season is a test of management. You have a limited budget, a squad that needs reinforcements, a coaching staff that might not be up to the task, and fans demanding results. Your job is to build a structure that works: find the right manager, surround them with the right staff, and give them the players they need to compete. Get it right, and results will follow. Get it wrong, and the consequences are yours to bear.

A club is a business, and you run it

Football Director replicates the real structure of a professional football club. You're not just managing a squad of players, you're running an entire organisation with four departments that need to work like clockwork: Sporting Direction, Medical Department, Marketing, and Finance. Each department is made up of employees with their own attributes, performance levels, and salaries. You decide who to hire, who to fire, and how much you're willing to pay for the talent you need.

Your sporting director will be your right hand in the transfer market. Your head of medical will determine how your players recover from injuries and how long they take to return to the pitch. The marketing department will influence your club's ability to attract sponsors and generate revenue. The finance department will keep the books in order — or not — depending on who you put in charge. Every hire has a direct impact on the club's overall performance. A good sporting director will bring you better transfer options. A mediocre medical team will mean your players spend more time in the treatment room than on the pitch. Everything is connected, and everything depends on you.

It's not just about having the best starting eleven. It's about having the best structure. Clubs that win leagues don't do it just because of their players — they do it because behind the scenes there's a solid organisation that makes everything work. That's your job. That's Football Director.

Matches are won in the boardroom

When matchday arrives, you've already done your work. You signed the players, hired the manager, and gave them the tools to compete. Now you sit back and see if your decisions were the right ones. Football Director's simulation engine plays out every match minute by minute, using a system that accounts for dozens of variables: each player's individual quality, their current form, their accumulated fatigue, their morale, any injuries they're carrying, and the coaching staff's tactical ability.

You won't see a static match or a simple final score. You'll watch your team wear down physically over the course of ninety minutes, see how a player with low morale performs below their level, how an unexpected injury in the 30th minute forces the manager to restructure the team. The substitution system follows the current three-window rules, and the coaching staff's AI makes decisions based on the match context: whether the team is losing, whether a player is exhausted, whether they need to protect a result.

Every match is a direct consequence of what you've built. If you invested in a good medical team, your players will arrive fresher. If you hired a manager with sharp tactical awareness, the substitutions will be smarter. If you cut corners on the squad, you'll pay for it when the season gets tough and injuries pile up. In Football Director, matches aren't won with instructions from the touchline — they're won with the decisions you made weeks, months, and seasons before.

Finances, transfers, and the art of building without going under

Money is everything and yet it's never enough. You can have the biggest budget in the league, but if you manage it poorly, you'll end up in a spiral of debt that drags the club down for years. Football Director puts you in charge of a club's real finances: television revenue, matchday income, merchandising, and sponsorships versus wages, transfer fees, infrastructure, and staff costs.

The transfer market is where great projects are forged and where badly planned ones go to die. Every player has a transfer fee and a salary that will impact your accounts for the entire length of their contract. Signing the star everyone wants can give you an immediate competitive boost, but it can also compromise your ability to strengthen other positions. Do you prefer one superstar and an unbalanced squad, or a well-rounded team that can compete on all fronts? That tension between ambition and sustainability is at the heart of the game.

Sponsors are another key piece of your financial strategy. As your club grows in reputation and results, new brands will want to be associated with you. Every sponsorship deal has its own terms, duration, and financial impact. Negotiating well can give you the margin you need to sign that midfielder you're missing. Negotiating badly can leave you tied to a deal that doesn't reflect your club's true value. Financial management isn't a side feature of the game — it is the game.

Leagues, players, challenges

Football Director in its version 0.1 includes the leagues of Spain and England. Thousands of players with detailed, position-specific attributes make up the squads of the clubs you'll find in the game. A full-back who bombs forward isn't the same as one who prioritises defensive cover, and that's reflected in every player profile.

Each league has its own dynamics. The AI teams compete against each other under the same rules as you: their players get tired, get injured, lose form, and go through good and bad runs. There are no hidden advantages or shortcuts for the machine. The simulation is fair and symmetrical, which means your victories will be earned and your defeats will have a real explanation.

The game is designed to grow. The Spanish and English leagues are the starting point, but the plan includes adding new national competitions, leagues from other European countries, and continental tournaments that will expand the scope and depth of every save. Each new league won't just be another setting — it will be a new market with different players, rules, and challenges that will enrich your experience as a director.

A game in progress, shaped by your voice

Football Director is in active development and will arrive on Steam in Early Access. This means you're entering a living project that grows with every update. The foundations are already built: the simulation engine, the employee system, finances, sponsorships, and the management interface are all working. But what's coming is even more ambitious.

On the horizon are European competitions, a youth academy system to develop talent from the age of 12, the ability to sell club shares to secure funding, league assemblies, and random events. Every update will bring new features that expand what you can do as a director.

This isn't a game made by a big studio with a massive budget. It's an indie project made with passion for football and management games, inspired by those classics that kept you hooked for hours. Your feedback matters. Your suggestions will shape development. Football Director is built with you.

store_data.about_the_game:
19XX, Britain.

In a certain city, a murder case occurs.

It was considered a simple incident, but as murders with the same method occur in succession, it grows out of control.

Soon, people come to call these cases the 'Jack the Ripper incidents.'

People discover a commonality—that the 'Jack the Ripper incidents' occurred only within the 'Sullivan Family's' territory—and begin to suspect Sullivan.

As the interrogation grows intense, Sullivan, to quell the commotion, orders the enforcers Reaper and Robellia to find the true culprit of the 'Jack the Ripper incidents.'

[ The Figures Surrounding 'Jack the Ripper' ]

It is unknown who 'Jack the Ripper' is.

However, there are countless individuals that 'Jack the Ripper' points to.

Never lose sight of the suspicion that builds through the characters' actions and conversations.

  • Become 'Reaper,' enter the rough mafia world, and pursue the true culprit who murdered Robellia.

  • Do not miss suspicious points in the characters' actions and conversations. It is up to you to decide whom to suspect.

[ Repetition and Mastery ]

Who was the most threatening enemy to you?

Through repeated combat and death, weigh who you must eliminate first.

  • You are not a hero. The enemies' attacks will be fatal in every way.

  • The specially modified gun can only be loaded with 2 rounds. Eliminate enemies by using intelligence and, at times, displaying quick reflexes.

  • Break through the mafia with your own clearing formula created through death.

[ Memory and Record ]

Was there anything suspicious?

Was there anything you wanted to remember?

Robellia told you to write in a diary whenever that happened.

  • Record today's suspicious points in a 'Journal.'

  • 'Interrogate' the suspects based on the journal to get closer to the truth.

  • Find the true culprit through interrogation and punish 'Jack the Ripper,' who murdered Robellia.

As the interrogation grows intense, Sullivan, to quell the commotion, orders the enforcers Reaper and Robellia to find the true culprit of the 'Jack the Ripper incidents.'

[ The Figures Surrounding 'Jack the Ripper' ]

It is unknown who 'Jack the Ripper' is.

However, there are countless individuals that 'Jack the Ripper' points to.

Never lose sight of the suspicion that builds through the characters' actions and conversations.

  • Become 'Reaper,' enter the rough mafia world, and pursue the true culprit who murdered Robellia.

  • Do not miss suspicious points in the characters' actions and conversations. It is up to you to decide whom to suspect.

[ Repetition and Mastery ]

Who was the most threatening enemy to you?

Through repeated combat and death, weigh who you must eliminate first.

  • You are not a hero. The enemies' attacks will be fatal in every way.

  • The specially modified gun can only be loaded with 2 rounds. Eliminate enemies by using intelligence and, at times, displaying quick reflexes.

  • Break through the mafia with your own clearing formula created through death.

[ Memory and Record ]

Was there anything suspicious?

Was there anything you wanted to remember?

Robellia told you to write in a diary whenever that happened.

  • Record today's suspicious points in a 'Journal.'

  • 'Interrogate' the suspects based on the journal to get closer to the truth.

  • Find the true culprit through interrogation and punish 'Jack the Ripper,' who murdered Robellia.
store_data.short_description: A 2D noir action game of 'Reaper' seeking revenge for his partner 'Robellia'. Fight through mafia threats with a modified gun, record in a journal, and interrogate suspects to uncover the truth in the mist and punish the true culprit who murdered 'Robellia'.

store_data.about_the_game:
In this game, your objective is to survive for 14 days by protecting yourself inside your house. To stay alive, you must build and maintain wooden barricades that cover the windows of your shelter. These barricades are essential for your survival and must be placed and repaired using wood. At the beginning of the game, a radio message informs you that you need to stay inside and wait for the authorities to arrive. After that, you are on your own and must rely on your actions to survive. To gather resources, you can go into the garden and cut down trees using an axe. By cutting trees, you obtain wood, which is the only resource used to create and repair barricades. Managing your wood carefully is important, as you need enough to keep your defenses intact for the entire duration. Your goal is to survive all 14 days by maintaining your barricades and making sure your shelter remains protected.

The game features a left-click pickup mechanic and a right-click throw mechanic.

Build your barricade and place it on the windows.

To get more wood, you have to pick up the axe and throw it at the tree.

store_data.about_the_game:
DIRTY WORK, BIG CALIBER

The end of the world is a drag, sure, but clogged sewers won’t unclog themselves. In this game, you take command of the most underrated combat unit in history: the vacuum truck. Surrounded by thousands of foes, your rig must keep moving, drenching monsters in automatic fire and flooding the arena with toxic surprises. Crush them under your wheels, blast them with the hose, and never slow down!

CRAFT YOUR ABSURD BUILD

As in any proper action-roguelike, the key to survival is the right build. Collect XP from fallen enemies, level up, and pick your upgrades. Turn your basic pump into a weapon of mass destruction! Combine primary weapons with dozens of passive skills: increase your splash radius, boost reload speeds, or mount ram on your bumper. Every run is unique.

ARTIFACTS AND META-PROGRESSION

Didn’t survive the shift? No big deal. Between runs, use your hard-earned resources to buy global upgrades. Discover unique artifacts that fundamentally change your playstyle, unlock new specialized vehicles, and prove that a sewage truck driver is at the top of the food chain.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Unclaimed Goods Warehouse! 🏬

Every year, thousands of packages get lost, stuck at customs, or simply forgotten. To some, they’re just "lost mail," but to you, they’re a gold mine. Crack open boxes, examine the contents, and decide their fate: will it join your private collection or go straight to the market?

Your Collection, Your Pride! 🌟

Hidden among piles of everyday junk are unique sets of items. These aren't for sale. They are your trophies, your dream shelf. Can you find that one missing "green plastic soldier" or the fabled golden lightbulb?

One Person's Trash is Your Treasure! 🗑️

Not everything you find is museum-worthy. Old irons, worn-out tires, and empty cans are the foundation of your growth. Earn. Invest. Expand.

Tactile Experience & Thrill! 📦

  • Cardboard Boxes: Slice through tape with scissors or rip it open with your bare hands.

  • Wooden Crates: Enjoy the satisfying crunch of splintering wood.

  • Safes & Cases: Bring out the heavy tools to reach the most valuable prizes.

No deadlines, no rush. Just you, mountains of boxes, and the pure anticipation of what’s waiting inside.

What else awaits you in the game:

  • — Hundreds of Unique Finds: From worn-out tires to ultra-rare collectible artifacts.

  • — Unboxing Arsenal: Use scissors, crowbars, and bolt cutters to tackle different types of packaging.

  • — Physics & Chaos: Toss, drop, and watch as loot satisfyingly spills out of every crate.

  • — Collector’s Thrill: Hunt for complete themed sets—from retro gadgets to the ironic "Golden Junk" series.

  • — Progression & Growth: Sell your finds, expand your warehouse, and upgrade your stats.

  • — Endless Mode: Relax in a meditative treasure hunt with no timers, no penalties, and zero limits.

store_data.about_the_game:
Uncover What Lies Beneath

Carefully excavate layered blocks to reveal hidden relics buried within. Each surface is made up of different materials, and every strike matters. Use precise tools and thoughtfully chosen patterns to clear each layer as efficiently as possible.

A Satisfying Excavation Loop

Chip away at stone, sand, and clay with clean, tactile feedback. Watch each layer break apart piece by piece as the shape of a hidden artifact slowly emerges. Every action is designed to feel deliberate, readable, and satisfying.

Optimize Your Approach

There are no fail states; just the quiet challenge of doing better. Experiment with different tool patterns and refine your strategy to clear each surface using fewer moves. Like a puzzle box, each excavation rewards careful planning and precision.

Discover Relics and Their Stories

Each relic you uncover is inspired by real historical artifacts and traditions. As you reveal them, you’ll uncover the true—and sometimes surprising—stories behind the lives they came from.

A Calm, Focused Experience

With minimalist visuals, soft atmosphere, and a focus on gentle interaction, Sainthood Relics is designed to be a peaceful, meditative experience. Take your time, slow down, and enjoy the process of uncovering something meaningful.

store_data.about_the_game:
What is Solidarity about?

Solidarity is a character building, auto battling roguelike. Combine different races, classes, weapons and many more to make the perfect team. Find artifacts that synergize with your characters builds and power them up. Unlock powerful upgrades in the growth tree to progress further in your next run. Modify the stats of your team to perfectly suit your playstyle, the choices are endless!

Key features

  • Over 40 races to unlock and use.

  • Over 30 classes to unlock and use.

  • Over 80 Artifacts to build your characters up.

  • Over 70 unique pieces of weapons and armor to find and equip.

  • 10 different run types to explore and complete, each with 3 difficulty options.

  • Random events with possible rewards or difficult battles.

  • And tons of other ways to power up your characters along the way.

Build your team

  • Build a new team for the next run or stick to what works!

  • You could have an orc warrior for your front line and maybe a nymph cleric in the back to heal him?

  • Maybe a zombie to soak up damage for your team and a powerful imp sorcerer to nuke the enemy team ?

  • How about 4 werewolves that transform during the night to crush your enemy?

  • The combinations are endless, try to find a team that is perfect or maybe just one that you find the most fun and unique.

Roguelike progression

Completing runs earns you growth tree points depending on the run type and difficulty that you can spend to have an advantage on future runs.

Additionally, unlocking new races, classes, etc will earn you mutation points which you can use to modify the stats of your team. For example having a higher magic stat, being faster, more critical hit chance, even a higher chance at artifacts.

store_data.about_the_game:
“Everyone has a ‘Handover Document’—it’s only a matter of time. You sign for them today; who signs for you tomorrow?”

A Rehearsal for the End

In this rain-soaked old city, you’ve taken a job no one else wants: a mortician. Your routine revolves around a cold workbench—setting up mourning halls, giving the "guests" their final bit of dignity. People call this trade eerie, but the real terror isn't the dead; it's the realization that no one escapes the script.

The Ritual is the Appetizer; Fate is the Main Course:

  • Not a Process, But a Final Dignity: Your task is to wash away worldly ties, stitch the skin, and dress the deceased. As you go through the daily grind of your schedule, the chill of "one day, I’ll be lying here too" becomes the one procedure you can’t skip. Mortuary work is a ritual. Through these few tasks, you must touch the cold reality of death. Staring at the workbench, the feeling that this is your own future hits harder than any jump-scare.

  • Halls for the Living, Truths for the Dead: The mourning hall is for the living, but the handover slips are for the dead. In this city of blurred eras, every body that passes through your hands seems tied to the same unseen, crimson thread. You think you’re just a spectator getting paid, but you’ve been part of the play all along.

Borrowed Life Must Be Repaid:

  • “Soul-Returning”: It’s Not a Hallucination, It’s a Debt: When you touch the deceased, you are dragged into their final moments. It’s more than memory retrieval; it’s a reckoning. You must find what they "owe" in those twisted visions, because every unpaid debt eventually finds its way back to you.

  • The Cycle of Five: All the victims are linked to an ancient curse—five lives, different ways to die, one massive debt. As you handle one "guest" after another, you’ll realize the thread of fate is tied around your own wrist.

  • The Final Handover: A Familiar Name: This is more than a simulator. In the end, when you're forced to verify the final document, you'll find a name that looks terrifyingly familiar. At that cold workbench, you will face the most brutal part of the ritual: dissecting the past to see where the cycle truly ends—and who it has been pointing to all along.

The door is open. Step inside. This isn't just a game; it's a debt coming to collect its owner. And you have nowhere to hide.

[hr][/hr]

Developer's Note

This game is a solo project in early development. While still a work in progress, it is a labor of love exploring the themes of fate and our final journey. Thank you for being part of this rehearsal for the inevitable.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to your first day on the job.

Game Dev Simulator is a story-driven VR experience where you play as a new employee at Mundane Interactive, a small game development studio.

A Full Virtual Desktop at Your Fingertips

Sit at your desk and interact with a fully functional desktop OS in VR. Browse emails, manage tasks, install games, surf the web, change your wallpaper, change your cursor, buy new music, and more — all through an intuitive VR mouse and keyboard. Your virtual office is packed with things to touch, grab, throw, and break.

Test the Games

As Mundane Interactive's newest QA tester, you'll play through a variety of very different games, ranging from funny, bizarre, heartfelt, creepy, rage enducing, or just downright terrible. Some of the games include:

  • Legend Of The Elder — A 2D adventure inspired by classic RPGs

  • Tithonus — A thought provoking constellation-connecting experience under the stars

  • Click & Run — An innovative 90s OS themed rogue-lite

  • Gerbil Jam — A 3D rhythm game with multiple songs

  • Retro Racer — A throwback arcade racing game

  • Slap Game — A motion control detective game where you slap a confession out of the criminals

  • ...and more

Features

  • Fully interactive VR office — Grab, throw, and interact with everything on your desk

  • Multiple full mini-games — Each one a different genre with its own mechanics

  • Branching phone call system — Answer calls, make choices, and hear the story unfold

  • Email system — Read, reply, and download attachments that unlock new content

  • Cliphead — Your desktop mascot who pops up with commentary on everything you do

  • 50+ main and side tasks to complete — Hidden challenges scattered throughout the office

  • A story you won't forget

store_data.about_the_game:
About Gentle Night

Experience Gentle Night, a psychological horror Visual Novel where human morality shatters against the backdrop of an apocalyptic nightmare. When a quiet town becomes a prison of despair, you—the exiled shop manager—hold the power to dictate the "taboo" rules of survival.

The Story

Exiled from Tokyo to Suekawa, Ryo’s life takes a dark turn before he can even unpack. A supernatural fog has cut off the town, leaving him trapped in a midnight supermarket with monsters lurking just outside the glass.

Inside, Ryo finds himself with a group of beautiful survivors. As fear erodes their sanity, the social masks they once wore begin to slip. When these high-class beauties beg for your "shelter," will you be their savior, or their master in the descent into darkness?

Key Features

Visceral Immersion: Hear her heartbeat and her desperate whispers. Our polished script ensures every interaction is an intimate sensory journey.

Professional JP Dubbing: Fully voiced by Japanese talent for that authentic anime feel. Every emotion is captured with stunning clarity.

Deep Narrative of Possession: Explore the dark intersection of survival, lust, and control. This is a game of psychological dominance.

Apply damage over time & burn them all

Charm enemies & detonate them to regain energy!

Critical clicks trigger frozen blood projectiles - and they crit too!

As you go down the floors with the girls, you will unlock dialogs for each of them!

store_data.about_the_game:
You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

Zero Sum is a pencil on paper style twin-stick shooter. Your enemies are numbers and your weapon is math. No health bars. No hit points. Just raw arithmetic violence.

A "48" is charging at you. You fire ÷2. Now it's "24". Three more divisions: "12," "6," "3." Now switch to minus. Bang. Bang. Bang. Zero. Gone. Next.

That was the easy part.

Your Arsenal Is Unconventional

Forget guns. You carry operators. Minus and Plus are your reliable sidearms. Precise but boring, until they save your life. Division rips through enemies. Root turns big numbers into rubble. Modulo is a powerful grenade that can nuke even the biggest numbers if played right.

Multiplication? A slow trap. An AoE effect that slows everything it touches. Useful if you're smart enough to set up a kill with it. And then there's Sigma, a vortex grenade that sucks in every nearby enemy and combines them into a single number whose value is the sum of everything it ate. Turn a massive swarm of numbers into one big, easy-to-handle target.

Every operator changes the battlefield and has 3 to 4 different weapon modes to unlock. Every shot requires a decision. Every clean kill and clever combo rewards bonus points. Integer split, perfect root, modulo blast. The game knows when you're showing off and rewards you for it.

The Numbers Fight Back

Enemies aren't just walking health bars. A prime number can't be cleanly divided. A factorial grows exponentially if you ignore it. Rethink to deal with Negatives. You can't outrun fast enemies. You don't just shoot, you solve.

Bosses That Would Make Mathematicians Sweat

Each boss is built around a mathematical concept that wants you dead (a small selection):

The Euler Owl 

  • a wise creature, firing Taylor series bullets that duplicate. Deal with them before the expansion overwhelms you.

The Factorial Factory

  • an inconspicuous boss that launches factorial projectiles. 9! splits mid-air into 9 × 8 × 7 × 6 × …, each number racing toward its anchor to recombine into something enormous. Kill the pieces before they merge or face their giant product.

The Pi Boss 

  • a pie protected by digits. Each slice of pi must be dealt with to turn armor into weak points.

The Yin-Yang Boss 

  • two spinning halves, one light, one dark. Focus too much on one half and the other goes berserk. Balance the harmony meter or get swarmed.

The Prime Sieve Spider 

  • an eight-legged boss whose web is the Sieve of Eratosthenes. Trapped in its grid, you must identify and destroy the composites and avoid the prime traps. Hit the wrong number and it breaks free as a real enemy. Clear the web to expose a leg joint. Fail, and the entire web turns into a swarm.

Sketched by Hand, Animated Like a Fever Dream

Zero Sum looks like your notebook came alive and got angry. Enemies are the doodles you drew when you were bored in math class. Except these doodles want revenge.

Features

  • 7 operator weapons, each with unique features, projectile behavior and mathematical consequences

  • Operator upgrades that evolve your arsenal and change your playstyle: chain division, shotgun roots, area-of-effect modulo blasts and more

  • 9+ Boss fights built around real mathematical concepts: exponentials, prime sieves, pi, harmonic balance, factorials and more

  • Escalating enemy waves from single digits to six-figure monstrosities

  • Twin-stick controls with mouse + keyboard or full gamepad support

  • A skill ceiling made of mental math. The fastest players aren't the ones with the best reflexes, they're the ones who can factor 391 in their head while dodging the swarm

LUBA is a walking simulator with platforming elements, environmental puzzles, and a classical music soundtrack. You find yourself in a strange, confusing place that never feels truly familiar, with no memory of how you got there, and only light and shadow to guide your way.

  • World exploration built around light and shadow.
