store_data.about_the_game:
Arkansas 2125 is a turn-based post-apocalyptic game set in a ruined future where every decision can mean the difference between survival and death. The player takes on the role of Thomas, a lone wanderer who sets out on a dangerous journey after being encouraged by his girlfriend. His goal is to obtain the legendary Farm Restorer, a device said to be capable of changing the fate of the world.

During his journey, the player explores vast, hostile areas and visits many different villages inhabited by survivors trying to rebuild their lives after the fall of civilization. Each village has its own atmosphere, characters, problems, and unique quests that help uncover the story of the world and its people.

The game places a strong emphasis on atmosphere, narrative, and player choices, which can influence relationships with NPCs and the outcomes of certain events.

Key Features:

  • Turn-based gameplay focused on strategy and careful planning

  • A wide variety of firearms, from basic pistols to more powerful weapons

  • Melee weapons offering alternative combat styles

  • A large variety of quests, including main story, side, and optional missions

  • Character progression system with skill and stat development

  • Multiple unique villages, each with its own story, NPCs, and activities

  • Exploration of a post-apocalyptic world filled with secrets and dangers

  • Strong focus on immersion and atmosphere

The game has been developed by a solo developer since 2024 and is being created using the Unity engine. Arkansas 2125 is a passion project aimed at players who enjoy turn-based gameplay, post-apocalyptic settings, and narrative-driven experiences.

store_data.about_the_game:
Something went wrong in the mountains of Pine Ridge County. A decade ago, a classified government research facility buried deep in the wilderness, went silent. Within weeks, so did everything else. No broadcasts. No rescue. No explanation.

The world you knew is gone. Nature has reclaimed the roads, the power grids have long since failed, and the dead outnumber the living a thousand to one. Pine Ridge County is yours now. What's left of it.

Quick Overview

  • Handcrafted open world of dense mountain forests, decaying towns, and abandoned research facilities

  • Dynamic day/night cycle - horde attacks every single night, escalating in size and aggression

  • Two types of infected - Day walkers you can manage. Night infected you need to outthink. Faster, harder to kill, and repelled by light.

  • Weather system - fog and storms roll in without warning, and anything that limits your visibility after dark can get you killed

  • Base building and fortification system - construct and reinforce your defenses before nightfall

  • Scavenge, repair, and drive vehicles across Pine Ridge County

  • Tiered loot system - better gear hidden in more dangerous locations

  • Full survival simulation - manage hunger, thirst, injuries, and stamina

  • Hunt wildlife and scavenge the land to stay fed and supplied

  • Skill tree progression - grow stronger the longer you survive

  • Trade with NPC survivors scattered across the county

Vast open world

A handcrafted open world spanning dense mountain forests, crumbling infrastructure, and overgrown ruins. A decade after the collapse, nature is slowly reclaiming what civilization left behind, but the abandoned research facilities still litter the mountainside, silent and waiting. Every location tells a story. Not all of them have endings yet.

Survive the Day. Dread the Night

Daylight belongs to the living, barely. Use every hour to scavenge, build, and prepare. When darkness falls, the horde descends on your position without fail. The infected that roam Pine Ridge during the day are dangerous. The ones that come out at night are something else entirely, mutated, faster, and harder to put down. Every dawn you survive is borrowed time.

Build, Fortify, and Hold the Line 

Your base is the only thing standing between you and the horde. Scavenge materials from across the county, construct walls and defenses, and reinforce your position night after night. What you build, and how well you build it, determines whether you see morning.

Loot, Craft, and Gear Up

Supplies are scarce and spread thin across a sprawling open world. Scavenge abandoned towns, ransack ARC facilities, and push into dangerous territory for higher-tier loot. Craft weapons, tools, and equipment from what you find, and manage your hunger, thirst, and injuries.

Drive, repair and customize vehicles

Locate and repair vehicles scattered across Pine Ridge County. Push deeper into dangerous territory for the supplies you can't find close to home. Just make sure you're back before dark.

store_data.about_the_game:
Meowdieval Clowder is a colony sim where you manage a medieval settlement of cats. Start small: a wooden hut, a couple of whiskered hunters, and a simple dream of a well-fed life. Gradually develop your village, master new crafts, explore the surrounding lands, and defend your clowder from enemies.

Key features:

  • A colony of cats: each with their own personality, skills, and quirks

  • Inheritable and acquired traits

  • Production progression from wood and stone to steel

  • Expeditions and a global map

  • Tactical real-time combat with pause

  • Equipment with unique properties and modifiers

  • Base building and defense

Manage a colony of cats

Every cat is an individual with their own personality, skills, and needs. Some are born hunters, others become master craftsmen, and some would rather bask in the sun all day instead of working. And yes, you'll have to live with that.

A cat's mood and relationships affect the efficiency of the entire colony. A well-fed, content cat works better, this rule quickly proves itself true.

From club to claymore

Everything starts simple: a wooden club in paw and stones picked right off the ground. Over time, you'll progress through copper, bronze, iron, and finally forged steel.

Each new material unlocks not just stronger items, but entire production chains. Simple workshops gradually transform into a real forge, where weapons and armor are born, capable of protecting your clowder from any threat.

Inheritable traits and upbringing

Every cat has innate traits: appearance, personality, and aptitudes. These traits are passed down through generations: a brave and strong father is likely to bring equally courageous kittens into the world.

But heredity is just the beginning. Over their lives, cats gain perks, mastering specific crafts and roles. A blacksmith who spends years at the forge becomes a true master of their trade. A hunter who tracks prey across dozens of expeditions gains unique abilities. Losing such a cat is a true tragedy, but that's what makes your clan's survival so meaningful.

Explore the world

Your colony is not isolated. Around you lie forests, mountains, plains - a vast world full of resources, dangers, and unexpected encounters. To survive and thrive, staying within four walls isn't enough, you must venture beyond the horizon.

Gather squads and send them on expeditions. Explore the global map, discover new locations, find rare resources. Meet other cats and invite them to your clowder - every new whiskered soul could become a key member of your colony.

But the world won't wait. Mice, rats, and dogs are already settling these lands, building their nests and villages. Send your squads to destroy these strongholds, push the enemies back from your home, and make the lands around you safer.

Defend your clowder

Your settlement is constantly under threat. Enemies will not leave you alone: they will attack, steal supplies, ambush your hunters, and lay siege to your walls.

You'll command squads of cats in real-time combat with tactical pause. A well-equipped cat can turn the tide of battle, and a coordinated group can hold off overwhelming forces.

Reinforce your walls, build defensive structures. The stronger your clowder, the more peaceful life becomes within it.

Choose your gear

Equipment is not just about defense and damage. Every piece of clothing and weapon has unique properties and modifiers - meaning it can become a key element of your strategy.

Collect, compare, look for perfect combinations. The right gear can turn an ordinary cat into a legendary hero, capable of shifting the outcome of a battle alone or supplying the colony with resources of the highest quality.

Meowdieval Clowder is in development. Subscribe and wishlist the game to stay updated.

Here, sharp claws and a fluffy tail rule!

MASSIVE WEAPON ARSENAL

Choose from 25 unique weapons ranging from machine guns and lasers to flamethrowers and railguns. Level up your weapons to unlock powerful passive abilities at Level 7 and game-changing mechanical transformations at Level 10.

Combine two maxed-out weapons to create 9 devastating fusion weapons. Turret fusions, drone fusions, and spider fusions each bring unique destructive power to the battlefield.

CREW MANAGEMENT

Recruit up to 4 crew members including a Driver, Mechanic, Engineer, Commando, Recon, and Guardian. Each crew member has unique skills with branching upgrades that shape your playstyle.

META PROGRESSION

Unlock 58 permanent upgrades between runs. Boost your damage, health, speed, and unlock new weapon slots to become an unstoppable force.

DYNAMIC BATTLEFIELD

Battle through destructible environments, dodge armored trains, navigate minefields, and face powerful bosses. Every run offers a unique challenge with procedural enemy waves and loot drops.

LOCALIZED IN 22 LANGUAGES

store_data.about_the_game:
Noblefold: Kingdoms Of Chance is a hardcore, card-driven strategy roguelike where you lead a fledgling kingdom through a gauntlet of lethal encounters and unpredictable events. In this realm, there are no safety nets—every decision is a high-stakes gamble, and every defeat is final.

Strategic Kingdom Management

You are not just playing a card game; you are ruling a kingdom. You must balance immediate survival in combat with long-term development. Navigate a world where your choices permanently alter your kingdom’s stats—such as Faith, Economy, People, and Army—determining your rewards or your ultimate downfall.

Master the Joker System

Your greatest assets on the battlefield are the Jokers—specialized units that change the flow of battle. Whether you are deploying high-durability Frontliners to soak up damage, glass-cannon Strikers for massive output, or Support units to manipulate card costs, your roster of Jokers anchors your entire strategy.

Deep Tactical Deckbuilding

Survival depends on how you refine your deck. With over 150 resource and combat cards, you must find the perfect synergy between your hand and your Jokers.

  • Attack & Defense: Strike your foes with precision or fortify your walls to survive the next turn.

  • Resource Management: Play powerful cards like Grand Cathedrals or Gold Mines to bolster your kingdom’s stats, but beware the economic or social costs.

  • Utility & Support: Draw extra cards, gain energy, or provide passive buffs that turn the tide of a losing battle.

A Pure Roguelike Challenge

Noblefold: Kingdoms Of Chance stays true to its hardcore roots. There is no permanent progression between runs; your only advantage is the tactical knowledge you gain from previous failures.

  • Permadeath: When your kingdom falls, the run ends.

  • Lethal Adversaries: Face over 25 unique enemy types, from Goblin Scavengers to elite foes, each requiring a different tactical approach.

  • Procedural Variety: Shifting event objectives and unpredictable enemy behaviors ensure that no two attempts to save your kingdom are ever the same.

Will you adapt to the chaos of the cards, or will your kingdom become just another ruin in the history of the realm?

store_data.about_the_game:
AIRSPACE MASTER

Manage both approach/departure air traffic and ground operations in a simple top-down 2D air traffic control (ATC ) interface designed for clarity and fast decision-making. From guiding incoming aircraft safely to coordinating departures and taxi movements, every choice matters.

Objective

Handle as many aircraft as possible without collapsing your operation.

  • Maintain your Operational Integrity (OI) — your performance meter

  • Avoid mistakes, delays, and dangerous situations

  • Complete dynamic contracts that can help or hurt your OI

Push your limits and see how long you can keep everything running under pressure.

Gameplay

Control aircraft using simple, intuitive commands:

  • Adjust altitude (climb / descend) and speed with 3 clear levels

  • Change heading and assign waypoints

  • Authorize final approach and departures

  • Manage ground traffic:

    • Taxi operations

    • Line up and hold

    • Takeoff clearance

Each airport is designed to stay readable and manageable, avoiding unnecessary complexity while still offering depth.

 Dynamic World

  • Day/Night cycle with adjustable speed

  • Dynamic weather, including rain clouds that affect ground visibility and radar operations

  • Increasing traffic complexity over time

  • Unexpected situations and emergencies that test your control

  • Contracts that introduce special traffic and changing conditions

Game Modes

Play your way with flexible options:

Survival Mode

High pressure — mistakes matter.

Sandbox Mode

Full control over:

  • Traffic density

  • Special arrivals

  • Weather conditions

  • Survival mechanics (on/off)

  • Contracts (on/off)

Airports

store_data.about_the_game:
Vaethorn: Realm of Legends is a tactical roguelite card game set within the pages of an ancient, living storybook.

Every Card is a Decision: Draw attack cards each turn and face the core dilemma: strike the enemy to shatter their defenses, or place the card into your Lord's revitalize formula to recover vitality? You can't do both. Choose wisely.

Three Card Systems, One Hand: Your hand is a mix of attack, relic, and sorcerer cards — all drawn from the same pool. Each card type can be played on three different targets with different effects:

  • Attack cards break enemy defense counters or fuel your revitalize formula

  • Relic cards empower attacks, stun enemies, or shield your Lord

  • Sorcerer cards absorb damage, draw extra cards, or sacrifice for an instant burst

Build Your Power Across the Journey: Every realm you conquer adds new cards to your draw pool. By the final boss, your hand draws from everything you've collected — the richest, most unpredictable hands of the entire run.

16 Lords, 16 Challenges: Each Lord has unique vitality, a unique revitalize formula, and a unique path across the map. Easy Lords forgive mistakes. Very Hard Lords demand flawless card management from the first draw.

Navigate 30 Hand-Illustrated Realms: Chart your path through destined realms and dangerous transit battles. Manage your vitality across the entire journey — there are no free heals, only the cards in your hand.

Boss-Balanced Design: Every value in Vaethorn is derived from the final boss backwards. Enemy stats, realm difficulty, Lord vitality — all calibrated so the journey feels tight, fair, and rewarding.

store_data.legal_notice:
Sensitive Content Warning
Artificial Violet is a fictional work that explores themes related to self-esteem, body perception, and social media experiences. The game includes references to body dysmorphia, dysphoria, anxiety, online harassment, and other emotionally sensitive situations.

This content may be disturbing or uncomfortable for some players.

Purpose of the Work
This game aims to encourage reflection on the impact of social media on emotional well-being and self-image. It does not intend to promote, romanticize, or trivialize any psychological condition or personal experience.

User Responsibility
Player discretion is advised. If you are currently experiencing emotional vulnerability, consider playing with support or seeking professional guidance.

Support Resources
If you or someone you know is struggling with self-esteem or mental health issues, we encourage seeking help from a qualified professional or local support services.

store_data.about_the_game:
About This Game

## The Story

Trace the distorted truth of the protagonist. Wounded inner thoughts and memories you wanted to deny will begin to tighten their grip on you.

Key Features:

  • 3-Chapter Structure: Follow the protagonist’s journey to recover lost memories through chapters set in a Hospital, School, and Home.

  • Psychological Pressure and Plot Twists: Cooperate with allies, only to face the shocking truths hidden behind them.

  • Horror Direction: Classic jump scares combined with a heavy, soul-shaking narrative.

Developer’s Note:

I’ve strived to capture the raw cruelty of reality. Beyond just being a "scary game," I hope this serves as an opportunity to look at the world from the perspective of those suffering in pain. The content can be quite disturbing, so please be mentally prepared before playing.

## Psychological Survival & Puzzles

Simply finding the path is not enough. You must manage three core psychological indicators that haunt your sanity as you delve into the grim truth.

  • Stress (⚡): Sharp tension numbs your senses. As stress reaches its limit, progressing normally becomes impossible, eventually leading you down a path of ruin.

  • Depression (💧): The swamp of deep helplessness makes every step heavy. As depression consumes you, the world grows darker, drawing you closer to a tragic end.

  • Karma (👁️): Every small choice you make accumulates into a heavy 'Karma.' This invisible burden will ultimately dictate the final fate you must face in the decisive moment.

## Key Features

  • Real-time Stat Management: Monitor your psychological state through a meticulously designed UI and balance your stats using situational items and actions.

  • Puzzles: Engage with unique puzzles and environmental gimmicks that challenge your perception.

  • A Grim Modern Fairytale: A cruel yet beautiful narrative crafted specifically for an adult audience.

  • Psychological Pressure: Symbolic and grotesque imagery that delivers a deeper sense of dread than direct gore ever could.

  • Multiple Endings: Over five brutal conclusions determined entirely by the weight of your choices.

  • Unique Artwork: A bizarre and overwhelming atmosphere created through a distinct blend of static illustrations and immersive text.

🔈 Sound Mode Settings Check the [Options] menu in-game!

  • Streamer Mode OFF: Enjoy the original soundtrack exactly as the developer intended. 🎶

  • Streamer Mode ON: Optimized to prevent copyright issues when streaming on platforms like YouTube. 📺

This is a point-and-click "spot the difference" game. It contains no dialogue, action, or combat elements and is not a horror game.

About the Story

A girl gets off a train at an empty station. She searches for anomalies in the scenes based on photos in an album. Only after finding all the anomalies can she continue. However, what awaits her at the end of the railway is…

Game Features

1. Original Music

2. Paper Artwork

3. A short game of approximately half an hour (around 10 scenes)

4. Two Endings (True Ending and Fake Ending)

Author's Note

Hello everyone, I'm HAIM. I was responsible for all aspects of this game: artwork, music, script, and programming. With the goal of making this game accessible to people all over the world without language barriers, I once again challenged myself to create a textless game. Since childhood, I've often dreamed about trains. In recent years, I've started traveling to various places to collect materials about trains, and this year, this railway-themed game was born.

store_data.about_the_game:
Survive the relentless hordes in a world of swords and sorcery. EIR is an action-packed roguelite survival game that combines the satisfying combat of an auto-shooter with the strategic economy of a skill-drafting system.

【Key Features】

  • Survive the Relentless Hordes
    Your attacks are fully automatic. Take control of unique characters—from a valiant Knight wielding devastating sword techniques to a powerful Mage casting ancient spells. Focus on your positioning to dodge and weave through countless monsters attacking from all directions, and gather as much Gold as you can from fallen enemies.

  • Skill Drafting: Luck Meets Strategy
    Use your hard-earned Gold to purchase new Skill Cards. The spells and weapon techniques available in the shop are randomized every time. Adapt to the situation, buy the right cards, and discover powerful synergies to construct your ultimate build.

  • The "Grade Up" Dilemma: Spend or Save?
    Every Skill Card has a "Grade" that dictates its power. Initially, only lower-grade cards will appear in the shop. However, by spending your Gold to upgrade the overall shop Grade, you unlock the chance to draft much stronger, rarer, and more devastating high-tier skills.

Do you buy cheap skills right now to survive the current wave? Or do you save your Gold to upgrade the Grade for explosive power later on?

Your survival depends not just on your reflexes, but on how wisely you manage your limited resources.

A Dark Agent, A Deadly Mission

Dude The Dark Agent is a 2.5D action game that blends the classic 90s FPS spirit with modern features. Hunt down enemy soldiers, smash ancient statues, and survive against dangers lurking around every corner in dense jungle maps rendered with the raycasting engine.

### ⚔️ Choose Your Armory

Instantly switch between four different weapons:

- **Shotgun** — Devastating power at close range

- **AK-47** — Automatic fire, mid-range dominance

- **Uzi** — Rapid fire, ambush-style combat

- **Knife** — Silent and deadly close combat

### 🏆 Skill Tree & Shop

Upgrade your skills with the gold and diamonds you collect:

- Increase your health and armor capacity

- Upgrade your weapon power

- Improve your drop rate

- Buy ammo, health, and armor from the shop

### 👥 Local Splitscreen for Up to 4 Players

Fight on the same screen with your friends! 2, 3, or 4-player splitscreen mode comes with full gamepad support. Each player chooses their own character, carries their own weapon, and determines their own fate.

store_data.about_the_game:
INTRO

USE YOUR VOICE. MASTER THE RUNES. FACE THE ARENA.

Runeborne Arena is a dark fantasy action experience combining deliberate, skill-based combat with real-time voice abilities — or traditional controls if you prefer.

Fight through dangerous regions, collect powerful runes, and unlock the path to a final boss that adapts to your playstyle.

GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW

Explore four distinct regions, each hiding a powerful rune.

While carrying runes, you gain unique advantages in combat. Only by collecting all four can you unlock the gate to the final boss.

Your journey is a balance between power and risk — the more you rely on certain abilities, the more the final challenge will evolve.

HYBRID COMBAT SYSTEM

Runeborne Arena combines traditional, timing-based melee combat with voice-controlled abilities.

Every action matters — positioning, stamina management, and precise timing are key to survival.

Use your voice mid-combat to gain the upper hand, but mastery requires control over both systems.

A separate non-voice mode is also available, allowing all abilities to be used through traditional inputs for players who prefer not to use a microphone or play quietly.

 VOICE-DRIVEN COMBAT

Use real spoken words to activate abilities in real time.

Your voice is not just a feature — it is part of your combat toolkit.

 RUNE POWER SYSTEM

Each rune grants unique combat advantages while carried.

Adapt your playstyle by choosing how and when to use them. Runes can make you stronger — but overreliance may come at a cost.

 ADAPTIVE FINAL BOSS

The final boss adapts to your playstyle.

Frequent use of certain runes will make the boss more resistant — and more dangerous — against those abilities.

Your combat habits directly influence the challenge you face.

 INTENSE ARENA BATTLES

Engage in challenging combat that rewards patience, precision, and discipline.

Enemies hit hard, punish mistakes, and force you to learn their patterns in order to survive.

 DARK FANTASY ATMOSPHERE

Explore a mysterious world filled with corrupted nature, ancient power, and haunting environments.

From shadowy forests to forgotten ruins, each area blends beauty with danger.

 CHALLENGING ENEMIES

Fight powerful enemies that demand adaptation and mastery.

Every encounter pushes you to improve, react with precision, and make the right decisions under pressure.

4548050.name: Imperial Wager: The Shattered Crown of Augustus

store_data.about_the_game:
"The Realm is a Board. The Crown is the Jackpot."

Imperial Wager: The Shattered Crown of Augustus is a macro-level feudal grand strategy game where absolute control is a myth. Centuries after the fall of the First Emperor, the god-blessed Crown of Augustus lies shattered, its volatile shards sealed within surviving, half-broken relics scattered across the realm.

To claim the empty throne, you must master these enigmatic devices—navigating a high-stakes system of risk, unpredictable AI delegation, and geopolitical gambling. Operating from your Regent’s Keep, you will manipulate your treasury, draft mandates, and manage your vassals, watching as a bloody war of swords and subversion dynamically unfolds across the procedurally generated realm.

You can dictate every sword swing and tax collection yourself—but trying to micromanage a decades-long conquest will drain you quickly. A true Dominus knows better; they set the stakes, delegate the rest, and play the odds.

Key Features:

Command the Realm (Card Mechanics):

Wars are not fought with drawn swords, but with Imperial Mandates. Draw from your faction’s deck and project your will directly onto the map. Each card projects a specific geometric shape, challenging you to cleverly overlap effects to quell Unrest, purge Venality, and spread your Influence.

Delegate to Feudal Vassals (AI Management):

To truly expand the empire, you must entrust power to the officials in your cabinet. The vassals you assign bring their own distinct personalities to the table, eventually melding into a collective Faction Psyche. This overarching psychology forms the underlying logic of your state, guiding how your autonomous AI behaves and reacts to the shifting world. You provide the stakes; they roll the dice.

Rig the House Odds (Spatial Puzzles):

Rebuild the lost laws of antiquity. Fit geometric, Tetris-like Tenet blocks into the Monolith of Edicts to literally weave the rules of your fiefdom. By customizing these physical laws, you dictate the overarching strategy of your campaign. You must weigh powerful tradeoffs and constantly adapt your state's engine to navigate shifting eras, tilting the cosmic odds in your favor.

Consult the Relics (Risk & Reward):

The First Emperor left behind esoteric devices to calculate fate. Funding your empire and uncovering rare mandates relies heavily on consulting these ancient, unpredictable machines. Every relic boasts its own distinct probability mechanics and risk-versus-reward systems. Wager your wealth to awaken them, but beware the volatile whims of fortune.

Asymmetric Feudal Factions:

Play as one of several distinct medieval powers fighting over the remnants of Rome. Whether you rely on the heavy cavalry of House Aquila, the bureaucratic purges of House Valerius, or the shadow-subversion of the Frumentarii Cult, you must adapt your gambling style to survive the Dark Ages.

store_data.about_the_game:
TERAFAB.AI

You are Stuck in an "Eternal Monday", every sunset wipes the board clean, but, every sunrise hands you the chance to learn from every failed run before.

You have been tasked by the MacroHard Company with building a mega-factory to crank out 1 TeraWatt of custom AI chips integrated under 1 roof to power AI Cars, Bots, Satellites, Data Centers, and blast humanity straight into galactic civilization.

Meanwhile, Evil A.I. Bots and turrets will be Your enemies and try to destroy You and Your factory!

Dive into the world of factory automation with this comprehensive game designed for rapid prototyping and easy expansion, this game provides all the core mechanics for full-featured factory building and logistics.

Designed for Modularity: Quickly create new machines, items, recipes, and research paths.

Flexible Camera System: Features a Top-Down View with the quick option to switch to an immersive Third-Person View.

Complete Factory Foundation: Includes a full suite of machines, a robust conveyor system, power management, progression, and a playable character with inventory.

Core Gameplay Systems:

Advanced Logistics & Conveyor System

A complete system for managing item flow, built using performant instance control.

Spline-Based Conveyors: Set the start and end points for quick, flexible belt creation.

Smart Snapping: Belts snap automatically into the conveyor inputs/outputs of machines.

Logistics Tools: Includes Splitter and Merger machines for complex layouts.

Spline Roads and Stackable Conveyor Poles.

Complete Power System with Generators and Power Poles.

Machines & Production

A full example set of destructible factory machines with inventory and UI interfaces.

Generators: Solar Panel, Wind Power, Wood Burning, and Coal Generator.

Furnaces: Manual Furnace (no power/belts) and Electric Furnace (1 in/1 out).

Assemblers: Double Assembler Machine (2 in/2 out).

Resource Management: Miner, Chest, Container (with belt entrance), Power Poles (MK1, MK2, Cables).

Automatic Turrets

Includes recipes and items: Rock, Coal, Iron Ore, Copper Ore, Gold Ore, Organic Material, Wood, Copper Wire, Copper Ingot, Iron Ingot, Gold Ingot, Brick and Structure Part.

Progression & Research

Unlock new technologies using a currency called Donation Points and specific item requirements.

Centers: Dedicated Research Center and Donation Center machines.

World & Exploration

Infinite Level Spawn: Procedural and configurable generation of Foliage, Trees, Resources, and Enemies.

Enemy System: Random Enemy spawners and Enemy atacks ( Player and Buildings )

Map System: Simple Map and MiniMap interface.

Vehicle & Drone Systems: Includes a fully driveable Offroad Vehicle and Personal Drone/Drone Logistics.

Character & Player Mechanics

Inventory System: Full drag-and-drop support, filters, and equipment slots.

Equipment System: Simple, variable-based stat alteration for:

Weapons (Fire Rate)

Ammo (Damage)

Armor (Protection)

Legs (Character Speed)

JetPack (Consecutive flight time) (Includes "Good" and "Bad" versions of items.)

Death & Respawn: System with a dropped loot mechanic.

Building System: Supports different hologram types (Ongrid, Limited Rotation, Free Rotation, Outgrid, Stackable, Snap, Power Cabes, Spline-based for Conveyors and Roads).

Quality of Life: HotBar System (0 to 9 keys), Painting System, and a Repair System (1 Structure Part repairs 100 points).

User Interface: Character Panel with statistics, a graph showing lifetime production/consumption, and 335 AI-generated portraits.

Extra Notes:

Testing Tools: Includes Cheat Buttons in the menu for rapid testing: NoCost, Invincible, PowerCheat, and UnlockAll.

Menus: Sound and Graphics Settings

Mouse cursor changes when pointing in different interacting item types

-----------------------------------------------

CONTROLS:

WALK - W A D S / LEFT STICK

JUMP - Space / A

Press Q to access the Build Menu

Press E to access the Inventory

Press Shift to enter in Combat mode using a weapon

Press Ctrl+Left Click to teleport (It uses health)

Press M to show the Map

Press P to Paint the buildings

Press R to Repair the buildings using Structure Parts

Use left and right arrow keys to rotate the camera (Access Camera Menu to 3rd Person View and Orthographic view) On the Building Menu

Press [0-9] over a building icon to place it on the Hotbar.

Use the same numbers to build.

On 3rd Person View: Click somewhere on the background to show/hide the mouse cursor

Mouse: Right Button - On Resources to Mine / On Buildings to Dismantle

Shift + Right Button - Teleport (Uses health)

Middle Button - Pipette (Copy Buildings already built) / Equip an item (When in the inventory)

Shift + Left Button - Transfers the stack from player to container and vice versa (When in the inventory)

Left Button - Split Stack (When in the inventory)

Driving:

W A D S to Control

Space: HandBrake

Hold Mouse Button to look around

TAB: Toggle Camera

Backspace: Reset Camera

-----------------------------------------------

store_data.about_the_game:
Glass Monsters is a single-player first-person 3D survival shooter where every battle takes place in a procedurally assembled glass arena. You fight through constantly shifting spaces filled with transparent walls, domes, bridges, ramps, and other geometric structures, fend off waves of aggressive creatures, and search for safe ground where cover can stop being cover at any moment.

At its core, the game is about mobility and constant pressure. Accuracy matters, but staying alive also means keeping moving: running, jumping, managing stamina, changing routes, and reading the arena fast. The arena affects your tactics just as much as the enemies do. Some areas offer a brief moment of safety, others trap you, and the destructible glass environment gradually reshapes the flow of combat in the middle of each wave.

As you progress, you will fight through a series of levels with different architecture, lighting colors, and combat pacing. Some arenas focus on tight passages and sharp turns, while others are built around open spaces, vertical movement, and exposed routes. Enemy behavior also changes from one type to another: some overwhelm you in close combat, some attack from the air, others rely on leaps or ranged fire attacks. In the later stages, especially dangerous enemies appear that can break obstacles and force close-range encounters on their own terms.

The arsenal is built around combat roles rather than just damage values. One weapon is better for precision and controlling distance, another for sustained pressure, and another for heavy explosive shots with a separate ammo pool. Enemies can drop new weapons, ammunition, healing items, and rare pickups that temporarily change how the arena is visually perceived, helping you read the battlefield in a different way during combat.

The defining feature of Glass Monsters is the combination of procedural arenas, destructible glass environments, and dynamic transparency. Cover cracks and shatters into fragments, enemy and object silhouettes shift depending on the situation, and muzzle flashes and fire attacks make every encounter feel both beautiful and dangerous. This is not just a visual gimmick: the environment directly affects how you make decisions in battle.

The game is designed as a focused single-player experience: push deeper, adapt to each new arena, keep the weapons and ammo you have earned between levels, and survive increasingly intense pressure. At the same time, the game includes pause, save and load, difficulty selection, music volume adjustment, and interface language switching.

Key Features:

  • Single-player campaign with 7 levels and escalating difficulty

  • Procedurally assembled arenas with varied geometry and lighting styles

  • Fast-paced first-person combat with running, jumping, and stamina management

  • Multiple weapon types with distinct combat roles

  • Different enemy archetypes: ground-based, jumping, flying, ranged, and heavy threats

  • Destructible glass obstacles and cover that changes throughout the fight

  • Enemy drops including ammunition, healing, new weapons, and rare temporary upgrades

  • Boss phases where the arena and survival routes become even more dangerous

  • Save/load, difficulty options, and support for multiple interface languages

store_data.about_the_game:
A rogue AI has weaponized an entire mining colony's autonomous fleet. Command the Ironfront Express in this roguelite lane-defense and fight through waves of corrupted industrial machines. Build your train car by car and experiment with devastating loadouts. Manually target with your primary weapon, deploy turrets, field drones, and activate abilities as you push toward the rogue AI core buried in the planet's depths.

  • Defend against waves of corrupted mining drones, remnants of a failed colonization operation on an abandoned planet

  • Command the Ironfront Express: a cargo train retrofitted to be a heavily armed, robot-killing death train.

  • Manually control your primary weapon in real-time while your emplacements hold back the tide.

  • 30+ truly unique enemies that don't just run it down and feed. They attack turrets and specialized mining bots wreak havoc on your line in various ways

  • 7 unique bosses to face

  • Choose from three Train engines ("Cores"), each with distinct stats, abilities, and module loadouts

  • Each run aims to be unique and inducive of generating various different builds.

  • Has procedurally built levels as well as handcrafted waves.

  • Unlock modules and Cores as you level up. Progression is about expanding your tactical options.

  • Uncover the story of the mining colony's collapse. The world is littered with random encounters with the mechanical denizens of the planet, opportunities, and high-risk detours.

  • Build your train car by car. Each compartment has 'Active Slots' (weapons, drones, abilities) and 'Passive Slots' (augments, systems)

  • 50+ Active Modules with 8 upgrade tiers each, including 4 unique modifications per module.

  • 150+ Passive Modules with stackable effects and build synergies.

  • (And more being designed everyday!)

Note: The trailer, screenshots and videos are from a development build and are subject to change (hopefully for the better!). Many features are currently being worked and planned such as full controller support, Linux and Steamdeck/handheld support and localization.

Join our discord to follow development!

What a week it’s been!
Finally, Friday afternoon, the weekend is almost here… but is it really?

“I’ll just get through this last bit of bureaucracy and then I’m out,” you mutter to yourself as you yawn and rub your tired, screen-dried eyes.

Your head drops into your palm, vision blur as your weighted eyelids slowly shut - just for a short moment of rest, you convince yourself…

Past Due: Midnight is a first-person psychological horror set inside a corporate office twisted by dark influence.

You awake at your desk in the middle of the night only to quickly realize something is off, and leaving the office may easier be said than done.

Make your way through six uniquely themed levels, each with its own atmosphere and visual identity.

Follow clues, solve puzzles, and interact with your surroundings - using whatever you can to push forward.

As you progress, piece together the phantom story unfolding across the office’s abandoned floors.

Can you survive the night and reach the exit, or will this nightmare consume you?

store_data.about_the_game:
The Only Way to Wake Up is the 6th Door

VI: REM is a ruthless dream dimension that doesn't hold your hand or tell you where to go. Your goal is simple but deadly: find the code for the 6th door and wake up from this nightmare. But this code won't be handed to you on a silver platter.

Someone is Following You

You are not alone in this dream. A relentless entity stalks you like a shadow. You cannot fight it. Your only options are to run, hide, and manage your flashlight wisely.

Gameplay Dynamics:

Unwavering Exploration: No quest markers or maps. You will roam freely across 5 different environments and forge your own path.

Mystery and Deduction: The story and the ultimate code for your escape are hidden within scattered notes. A seemingly ordinary detail or a randomly scribbled number... Pay attention to everything you see; it's up to you to piece the puzzle together.

Ruthless Survival: If you quit the game before escaping the nightmare, you start from scratch on your next playthrough. You can continue if you die in-game, but collected flashlight batteries do not respawn. You must solve the mystery before your light runs out.

Knowledge is Power: Even if everything resets when you close the game, the codes and notes you memorized in previous attempts will be your greatest weapon in your next escape.

Read carefully, stay quiet, and don't waste your light.

store_data.about_the_game:
The universe died a long time ago. The stars burned out. Matter decayed. Everything that ever existed was uploaded into The Cloud, the last computational substrate keeping reality rendered. Trillions of souls converted to pure data, sharing processing power, existing as information in a machine that replaced the cosmos.

For eons, it worked. Death was abolished. Suffering was optional. Civilizations that warred for millennia coexisted as neighboring data clusters. But The Cloud runs on finite resources. Every thought, every physics calculation, every atom costs bandwidth. And the bandwidth is running out.

Now you hide in the void between what's left of reality, stealing processing power from The Cloud to stay alive. You repurpose what you steal. Dead civilizations become building materials. Old memories get stripped for useful data and fed into machines you built from scraps of forgotten code. You are not evil. You are hungry. But to The Cloud, there is no difference. Every byte consumed to keep yourself alive is a byte ripped from a system that is already failing.

Build

Construct automated data processing networks in the unrendered dark. Capture raw data from The Cloud, route it through refinement chains, and extract the bandwidth you need to keep existing. Your operation is your lifeline. If it stops, you stop.

Steal Everything

The Cloud is dying and everything inside it is fair game. Download data, consume it, grow stronger. But every theft

raises your threat level. Take too much and The Cloud agents will notice.

Survive The Hunt

The Cloud has an immune system. Entropy Agents track bandwidth theft, hunt corrupted data, and reclaim what you stole. Stay small and they might miss you. Get greedy and they will find you.

Trust No One

Other corrupted data is out here too. Form guilds. Share bandwidth. Build together. Raid The Cloud together. But remember: when the Exit Node opens, only one consciousness fits through. Every ally is a future competitor for the only way out.

The Exit Node

The Cloud exists inside something. Mathematically, there must be a way out. A point where data escapes into whatever is outside. It only opens when entropy hits critical mass. When the universe finally crashes. You are not just surviving. You are waiting for everything to die so the door opens.

And you will consume whoever you have to in order to be first through it.

store_data.about_the_game:
Belonging to Eunoia is my first game, currently in development. It originally started as my bachelor’s project and is now being continued with the goal of releasing it.

It tells the stories of people affected by loneliness and depression within a walking simulator set in a linear, isolated world, offering a profound narrative experience. Each letters was written by a real person.

Thirteen people share their stories about loneliness, depression, and critical life decisions through letters that can be found throughout the game.

The gate at the top was meant to symbolize an ascent into paradise, but in truth it represents suicide.

Players can explore the environment, solve small puzzles, collect lost items, and uncover the story of the main character, Xialia, who is struggling to decide whether to end her life or turn back.
Your choice is her path.

store_data.about_the_game:
There was a before.
And then… something left unfinished.

After a global collapse, you find yourself inside a massive structure belonging to Korxtech. You don’t remember who you are or why you came here. But the silence around you makes one thing clear: something has changed irreversibly.

KIRILMA: Helix Horizon is a story-driven adventure experience set in a dystopian sci-fi world, focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

As you move through abandoned floors, collapsed systems, and traces left behind, you gradually uncover the truth behind the devastation.

GAMEPLAY

Players freely explore interconnected areas, restore systems, and solve environmental puzzles to progress.

As notes, audio logs, and environmental details are discovered, the story deepens. Dangerous zones and unseen risks require careful movement and awareness.

STORY

As you progress, limited communication with the outside world begins to guide you toward who may be responsible for what happened.

However, each new piece of information reveals that the truth may be far more complex than it first appears.

store_data.about_the_game:
Unofficial statistics say that one out of every four game developers uses a cat avatar.

By day, they type away. By night, they fix bugs and chase deadlines.

Ideas, issues, and a few unexplainable obsessions all get tucked into something that looks calm on the surface.

Those small frustrations and bits of chaos are like droplets forming on a chilled soda bottle in summer—cool, clear, and quietly slipping down.

And somehow, they land on your desk… and become a game.

It felt like an idea worth trying.

So we made this.

This is a desktop idle simulation game thatlives at the bottom of your screen.

You can resize it and place it anywhere, letting it run alongside your daily workflow.

You play as a cat developer, building a game right on your desktop.

Every keystroke and mouse click contributes directly to your progress.

👉 Your input isn’t just input anymore — it’s development itself.

Development unfolds through light, stage-based challenges:

  • 🐛 Bugs pop up from time to time

  • 📋 New ideas and tasks gradually appear

  • ⏳ Time moves quietly forward

There’s no need to rush. Just keep typing, keep clicking, and things will come together.

In a small corner of your desktop, a game slowly takes shape.

👉 Every input brings it a little closer to completion.

✨ Key Features

  • 🖥️ Runs at the bottom of your desktop, always within reach

  • ⌨️ Every keystroke and click becomes development progress

  • 🎒 Collect gear that unlocks new genres and mechanics

  • 🧩 Mix and match ideas to create unique game concepts

  • 📦 Publish your game and see its store page, reviews, and scores — hit or flop?

As you develop, you’ll collect all kinds of gear and tools.

They don’t just make progress smoother —

they unlock new genres, mechanics, and creative directions.

A strange piece of gear might lead to an unexpected idea,

opening up entirely new paths for your game.

👉 Like an RPG, you collect, swap, and grow — expanding what you can create.

Starting from“New Folder (2)”,

you’ll unlock and combine different:

  • 🎮 Genres

  • ⚙️ Core mechanics

  • 🧠 Development strategies

Each combination leads to a different kind of game.

You experiment, iterate, and discover what emerges this time.

👉 Every run is a new exploration.

When development is complete, you publish your game.

And then comes the moment you’ve been waiting for:

  • 📝 A simulated store page

  • ⭐ Review scores

  • 💬 Player feedback

You’ll see how your creation turns out—

👉 A hidden gem… or a glorious mess?

💡 A Light but Honest Take on Making Games

This isn’t just a game about making games.

It’s about the small habits, ideas, and moments that build up along the way.

Between calm and chaos, routine and inspiration,

between collecting and creating—

you’ll watch one game after another come to life,

right there on your desktop.

And maybe, in the end—

❤️ +1 Wishlist

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of high finance. The Capitalist is a deep economic strategy game where you build and manage your own Private Equity firm. You aren't just clicking to make numbers go up; you are raising funds, negotiating deals, and turning around struggling companies. Take control of a professional financial terminal, use real-world investment strategies, and turn millions of investor capital into billions. Red means default. Green means a massive payout.

Core Features:

  • Manage Investor Funds: You don’t start with infinite money. Raise capital from institutional investors to launch your funds. Your goal is to buy companies, grow them, and sell them to return real cash to your investors. Earn your management fees to keep the lights on, but the real wealth comes from your performance bonus (Carried Interest) on successful exits.

  • Scout for the Perfect Deal: Set up specific parameters for your analysts to find undervalued businesses. Review anonymous "blind teasers" and sign NDAs to reveal their true financial metrics. Conduct deep due diligence to uncover hidden debts and operational flaws before you write the check.

  • Master Leveraged Buyouts: Use a mix of your fund's cash and bank loans (leverage) to acquire targets. Debt boosts your potential returns, but it increases your risk. If the company fails to generate enough cash to pay the interest, the bank will step in, and a debt spiral is imminent.

  • Tense Negotiations: Buying a company is a strategic tug-of-war. Make your bids and counteroffers carefully. Push the seller too hard with lowball offers or stall the audit process, and their patience will run out, killing the deal forever.

  • Fix and Flip Companies: Once you own a business, it’s time to fix it. Fire underperforming management, hire top-tier CEOs, and cut unnecessary costs. Transform a struggling asset into a highly profitable market leader, then sell it to the highest bidder for a massive premium.

Buy. Fix. Sell. Profit.

store_data.about_the_game:
Convinced he was Guan Yu, you made him governor. ...It was Lü Bu.

A Three Kingdoms strategy sim where you deduce your officers

Personnel, warfare, governance, diplomacy, espionage, duels...

Everything you expect from a turn-based Three Kingdoms strategy game.

One thing is different — officers use “aliases”.

A Blind Talent Market feat. Mafia

You don’t know your officers’ real names. Stats and loyalty only reveal themselves through investigation. You paid three visits to recruit a genius — it was Xiahou Mao. The governor you posted on the front line? Meng Da, of all people. Pang Tong might be managing farms in the rear. Do you have the eye to see real talent?

A Different World Every Run feat. Roguelike

Each game starts in a random city with a random draft of officers. This run, Zhang Liao showed up — but not a single civil officer in sight. This run, Ma Chao appeared — great, except you’re playing Cao Cao. Maybe next run you’ll land Chengdu or Jianye as your capital. You lucked into Luoyang — but Cao Cao, Sun Ce, and Lü Bu are your neighbors...

...Just start another run.

The real strategy simulation for Three Kingdoms devotees — Three Kingdoms : Alias.

store_data.about_the_game:
Shanhai Ranch is a desktop idle management game.

Build a small ranch of mythical beasts along the edge of your desktop and let it run while you work, watch videos, or do anything else. Your beasts will move, produce resources, and keep the ranch running on their own. Collect items, organize your storage, raise your beasts, and slowly grow your ranch over time.

A Ranch That Lives on Your Desktop
Your ranch stays at the edge of your desktop without taking over your screen. You do not need to constantly manage it — it keeps running quietly while you do other things.

Collect Items and Build Your Storage
Your beasts continuously produce items of different rarities. Sort what you collect, keep rare finds, and gradually fill your storage with useful materials and collectibles. The items you gather can also contribute to your Handbook and support your ranch’s growth.

Raise Beasts and Keep the Ranch Running
Each beast belongs to one of five elements: Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth. Every element contributes in a different way, so building the right lineup is key. Balance production and resource flow to keep your ranch growing steadily.

store_data.about_the_game:
[Game Overview]

A new‑style indie action game that blends classic retro gameplay with the realism of human bodily needs

[Game Description]

On his way home, the weak‑stomached Gerio must dodge obstacles and rush into toilets whenever he can.

Will he make it back home without an accident? The outcome is up to you!

[Objective]

Avoid Splashing as much as possible, reach the toilet in each stage, and guide Gerio safely back home!

[Game System]

The first thing you’ll notice is a mysterious gauge called the “DiarrMeter.”

If this meter fills up… “Splash!”

Jumping or taking damage increases the meter, while crouching lowers it.

Simple controls, but balancing action and meter management is the key to success.

Main Gameplay Elements

  • Manage the DiarrMeter

    • Jumping or enemy attacks raise the meter

    • Crouching or collecting apples lowers it

    • Entering a toilet completely resets it (refreshing!)

  • If it fills up… Splash!

  • Avoid various enemies

    • Getting hit increases the meter

[Story]

Gerio once again feels trouble brewing in his stomach on his way home.

Avoid Splashing, rush into toilets, and help him make it back safely.

[Features]

  • Retro‑style side‑scrolling action

  • Cute and colorful pixel‑art graphics

  • A unique experience that’s both funny and a little stressful

  • Difficulty increases as you progress

[Additional Information]

  • Playtime: About 1–20 minutes per stage

  • Difficulty: Starts beginner‑friendly and gradually becomes more challenging

  • Graphics: Pop and colorful pixel art

  • Sound: Upbeat, retro‑inspired music

Total Stages: 20

[Genre]

  • Retro

  • Pop

  • Action Game

  • Side‑Scrolling Action

  • Pixel Art

[Additional Game Modes / Character Progression]

None

[Lastly]

Rumor has it… there might be a certain item that can help Gerio prevent a Splash. Or maybe not.

[About the Use of AI]

This game uses AI tools only to help create some of the music and chord patterns.

All gameplay systems, level design, controls, and game mechanics were designed by the developer.
AI was used only to assist in converting these ideas into assets or code.

AI does not influence gameplay in any way and is used solely as a support tool during asset creation.

Break as many shapes as possible by getting close to them within your radius of action. Collect vertices and buy upgrades that will let you get rid of more sides on your next run! Forcefully propel the captured shapes so they crash against the map walls, dealing massive damage until they are reduced to ashes. Your mission is clear: restore that primitive world made up entirely of perfectly round circles.

Key Features

  • Trigger Chain Reactions: Unleash unpredictable physical chaos.

  • Reduce the World to Ashes: Eliminate the corners of the maps.

  • Upgrade Tree: Invest your vertices to become unstoppable.

  • Break Shapes: Dismantle geometry from the inside out.

store_data.about_the_game:
You wake up chained to a chair in an isolated cabin, 37 miles from civilization. A man who calls himself "The Curator" stands over you. He doesn't want your money. He wants something far more dangerous — your truth.

Kidnapped Simulator is the first game to feature a fully local AI model running entirely on your machine. There are no cloud servers, no API calls, no token costs. The AI kidnapper lives inside your PC, which means you can play completely offline — and nothing you type or say ever leaves your computer. This gives you total freedom to engage with the experience however you choose.

The gameplay is simple in concept but deeply unpredictable in practice: you are trapped in a conversation with a serial killer, and your only way out is through your words. Type or speak your responses as The Curator reads your micro-expressions, judges your honesty, and decides whether you live or die. He has archived 73 sessions before yours. Only seven walked free.

Every playthrough is shaped by what you reveal — or refuse to reveal. Deflect too many times and the situation escalates. Share something genuine and you might earn a moment of mercy. But Vincent is no fool. He has spent decades studying human deception, and he will punish lies with escalating cruelty.

A single session can be completed quickly, but uncovering every possible path, understanding The Curator's psychology, and discovering what truly makes him release a captive will take many attempts. Each run teaches you something new about how the AI thinks — and how far you're willing to go.

The custom AI model was built from the ground up as a simulation of a serial killer's mind. It features internal scoring, phase-based interrogation structure, and dynamic emotional responses that adapt to your behavior in real time.

store_data.about_the_game:
Type the classic novel "Frankenstein; or, the Modern Prometheus" by Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley. Type paragraphs quickly and flawlessly to unlock new chapters. Race against the ghost of your own cursor to beat your best time.

Type a book

This is a typing game where you type a book—simple as that. If you want to read the original 1818 novel Frankenstein; or, the Modern Prometheus while practicing your typing skills at the same time, this game is for you. 

Victor Frankenstein pushes science beyond its limits—and succeeds. But the life he creates is not the miracle he imagined. Cast out and alone, the creature begins a desperate search for belonging that spirals into vengeance. Dark, tragic, and deeply human, Frankenstein remains one of the most powerful stories ever written about creation and responsibility.

Race Your Ghost

In this game you have to type fast. Faster than yourself. 

When you set a new high score on a paragraph, the movement of your cursor during that run is recorded.

The next time you type that paragraph, it appears as a ghost cursor so you can compare your progress to your previous best run.

It becomes an intense experience when you're going head-to-head with your ghost and your fingers are hammering the keyboard as fast as they can.

Chapters and Paragraphs

The book has been broken down into chapters and paragraphs, because typing a full novel in a single sitting is nearly impossible.

A paragraph can be completed in a couple of minutes, which is much more suitable for an intense speed-typing session.

You receive a score when you complete a paragraph, and you may also earn a medal. To advance to the next chapter, you must collect enough medals from paragraphs.

No Mistakes Allowed

It's a bit harsh, but that's how this game works.

Whenever you make a spelling mistake, the word is deleted and you have to start over. There is no accuracy score, but your time score will take a hit if you make mistakes.

 

Hidden Words

Learning to type is no good without knowing how to spell. That's why, in this game, you have to remember the word you are currently typing.

This is enforced by hiding the word as soon as you begin typing it. If you get really stuck and can't remember the word, wait one second and it will reappear.

Save and Reload

You get three saves for each paragraph.

You can save and reload whenever you want, but spend your saves wisely. If you save frequently in the beginning, you may have no saves left for the end. Restarting a paragraph restores your saves.

store_data.about_the_game:
Extreme Line Racing is a minimalist top-down arcade racer built around precision, control, and replayability.

Race across fully visible single-screen tracks in cars with distinct handling styles. Push tight lines through every corner, ride the edge of the track, and chase faster lap times, higher star ratings, and better leaderboard positions.

The rules are simple, but the pressure is constant. As long as your whole car does not fully leave the track, your run is still alive. That gives you room to drive on the limit, squeeze through dangerous corners, and fight for every fraction of a second without losing the clarity and readability that make top-down racing so satisfying.

Every run is short, focused, and built for immediate replay. There are no long events or unnecessary distractions here, just pure arcade racing: pick a car, hit the track, learn the corners, and go again. Improving means mastering speed, grip, steering, rhythm, and the unique feel of each vehicle.

As you progress, you can unlock and purchase new cars with different strengths in top speed, acceleration, grip, and steering. Some reward aggressive driving, some offer more control, and some shine on technical tracks that demand precision. Whether you want to clear every course, earn every star, improve your best times, or climb the global leaderboards, every track gives you a reason to come back for one more run.

If you enjoy racing games that are easy to jump into, quick to restart, and rewarding to master, Extreme Line Racing is built for you.

Key Features

  • Precision-focused top-down arcade racing

  • Fully visible single-screen tracks for clean reading and route optimization

  • Off-track rules that reward edge riding and limit driving

  • Cars with distinct handling, speed, grip, acceleration, and steering profiles

  • Fast retries that keep every run focused and replayable

  • Star ratings, time improvement, and score chasing on every track

  • Global leaderboards for players who want to keep pushing

  • Replay support for reviewing and improving your runs

  • Keyboard and controller support

  • Minimalist visuals built for clarity, speed, and readability
store_data.detailed_description:
Extreme Line Racing is a minimalist top-down arcade racer built around precision, control, and replayability.

Race across fully visible single-screen tracks in cars with distinct handling styles. Push tight lines through every corner, ride the edge of the track, and chase faster lap times, higher star ratings, and better leaderboard positions.

The rules are simple, but the pressure is constant. As long as your whole car does not fully leave the track, your run is still alive. That gives you room to drive on the limit, squeeze through dangerous corners, and fight for every fraction of a second without losing the clarity and readability that make top-down racing so satisfying.

Every run is short, focused, and built for immediate replay. There are no long events or unnecessary distractions here, just pure arcade racing: pick a car, hit the track, learn the corners, and go again. Improving means mastering speed, grip, steering, rhythm, and the unique feel of each vehicle.

As you progress, you can unlock and purchase new cars with different strengths in top speed, acceleration, grip, and steering. Some reward aggressive driving, some offer more control, and some shine on technical tracks that demand precision. Whether you want to clear every course, earn every star, improve your best times, or climb the global leaderboards, every track gives you a reason to come back for one more run.

If you enjoy racing games that are easy to jump into, quick to restart, and rewarding to master, Extreme Line Racing is built for you.

Key Features

  • Precision-focused top-down arcade racing

  • Fully visible single-screen tracks for clean reading and route optimization

  • Off-track rules that reward edge riding and limit driving

  • Cars with distinct handling, speed, grip, acceleration, and steering profiles

  • Fast retries that keep every run focused and replayable

  • Star ratings, time improvement, and score chasing on every track

  • Global leaderboards for players who want to keep pushing

  • Replay support for reviewing and improving your runs

  • Keyboard and controller support

  • Minimalist visuals built for clarity, speed, and readability
store_data.short_description: A fast minimalist top-down racer where you push tight lines, skim the edge of the track, and chase faster lap times on fully visible single-screen circuits.

store_data.about_the_game:
Self Simulated: Pinball Anomaly is a pinball action game for Game Boy Color, inspired by classics like Pokémon Pinball, Super Robot Pinball, and Devil's Crush — where you must fight through a corrupted digital simulation to rescue Self, the robotic protagonist of the original Self Simulated.

This isn't just a score-chaser. It's a battle.

One Table. Many Threats.

The simulation is alive with enemies. Fight your way through waves of hostile robots, survive boss encounters, and dismantle M-Iss1-NgN-0's grip on the system — all with the flippers. Bumpers, slingshots, drop targets, and skillshot orbits give you the tools. How you use them is up to you.

Key Features

  • Authentic Pinball Mechanics — A full-featured table with bumpers, slingshots, drop targets, skillshot orbits, and ball saves

  • Enemy Waves & Boss Fights — Battle multiple robot enemies across waves and face down bosses to progress the story

  • Nudge System — Physically influence the ball's path with nudges — but over-nudge and face a penalty. Master the Power-Nudge to defeat enemies

  • Mini-Game Pinball Rooms — Special flipper rooms unlock during a run, offering unique micro-challenges and variety

  • Highscore Chase — Classic score-chasing gameplay rewards skill, risk-taking, and pattern mastery across every run

  • Save & Resume Anytime — Save your run mid-game and pick up exactly where you left off

  • Rumble Support — Full hardware rumble for a more tactile pinball experience

  • Assist Settings — Start with 6 balls instead of 3, faster ball saves, and reduced game speed for a more accessible experience

A Spinoff Built for the Hardware

Self Simulated: Pinball Anomaly is a direct spinoff of Self Simulated — the Game Boy Color precision platformer released as a physical cartridge in 2025. You don't need to have played the original to enjoy Pinball Anomaly, but fans will recognize Self and understand what's at stake.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the exciting world of Jokey and Jolly’s!

"Jokey and Jolly’s" is an indie horror game in which you use figurines on your desk to ward off the Jolly`s. Meanwhile Jokey communicates with the player, sending cryptic messages throughout the game.

The Story
Meet Jokey the Clown, once the star of the show for children and adults alike. Everything changed on one fateful day when he became the "Crying Clown." In that moment of sorrow, the Jolly’s emerged.

Features
Powered by the Clickteam Fusion 2.5 engine, Jokey and Jolly’s delivers a polished horror experience featuring:

  • Timed Mechanics: Precision is key to survival.

  • Diverse Mini-Games: Seven unique challenges to test your skills.

  • Hidden Easter Eggs: Plenty of secrets waiting to be discovered.

  • Saved Progression: Never lose your place.

Game Mechanics
Use the Jolly figures on your desk to fend off terrifying jumpscares. If you’re too slow, it’s game over. Be warned: as you progress through the levels, your reaction window shrinks, demanding faster reflexes.

Lore
The narrative is woven directly into the game. Visit the "Lore Room" to uncover the core story, or keep a sharp eye out while playing—hidden details are scattered throughout the environment for those brave enough to look.

Arcade Mini-Games
Head over to the Arcade Room and step up to the functioning machine to play 7 different mini-games. each with its own unique mechanics and objectives.

Easter Eggs
Keep your eyes peeled! There are at least 10 rare Easter eggs that can trigger at any time. For example, if you spot and click the hidden Party Hat, all the Jolly figures will instantly join the celebration by wearing one.

Saved Progression
Got jumpscared? Don’t worry. The game automatically remembers your level, so you can jump right back into the action without starting from scratch.

Are you ready to face Jokey and his Jolly’s?

store_data.about_the_game:
Dungeon Settlers is a dark fantasy strategy game that combines colony simulation and dungeon crawling. As the leader of an expedition sent by the Guild, your mission is to explore, conquer, and destroy the dungeon which is the source of all calamities. To do so, you’ll need to build a settlement in the barren land and prepare your people for the dangers ahead.

This is a ‘Hardcore Strategy’ game. Train your members strategically by considering their equipment, skills, and traits, then form a party of up to four. In real-time with pause tactical combat with no turn or round limits, analyze enemy traits and patterns to outmaneuver them and achieve victory. But remember once dead, there is no coming back...

Build a settlement in the desolate land, isolated by magical erosion. Design rooms freely by placing walls and doors to meet your members’ needs—create bedrooms and dining areas, and set up a forge with anvils and smelters. Cultivate fields to grow crops. Manage your resources efficiently to survive, and produce rations and camping supplies for the next expedition. Unlock new buildings and equipment through research.

Each member has six major abilities and talents, along with dozens of combat and life-related stats. They also possess various traits based on race, background, and personality—such as a curious Lizardman with a drifter’s past. Recruit promising candidates and help them grow through leveling. Equip them with powerful equipments and carefully build a four-member expedition party with synergistic skill trees such as sword/mace/bow/fire magic.

Combat takes place in real time, but you can pause at any moment to think strategically. Plan your tactics using a variety of effects and mechanics—stun, bleed, burn, provoke, vulnerable, charge attacks, summons, and more. Position your party wisely, exploit enemy weaknesses, and utilize your skills at the right time. Even hopeless battles can be overcome with the right strategy.

Each dungeon expedition is randomly composed, with floors and rooms changing each time. Regions apply different random environmental effects. The deeper you go, the rarer and more valuable the resources become—but so do the threats. You’ll encounter the remnants of magical experiments, such as towering golems or acid-spitting monsters. Secure wood logs, herbs, gemstone veins, and mysterious mandrake. Trade with dungeon merchants, and face ancient tree that demand blood to bear forbidden fruit.

store_data.about_the_game:
Fate Observer: Selective Mutism is a single-player interactive visual novel centered on branching worldlines, character-driven relationships, and mystery.

You play as Gu Yan, moving through a story where every choice can lead you toward different relationships, different consequences, and different endings. Along the way, you will meet the same key characters under changing circumstances, building trust, creating distance, uncovering secrets, or losing your chance to understand them in time.

The game is built around **15 interconnected worldlines**. Through dialogue choices and key decision points, you will guide the story into different routes and gradually piece together the larger truth hidden behind the same core events. Each worldline approaches that truth from a different angle, changing what you learn, when you learn it, and what it costs you to keep going.

Your decisions do more than change a line of dialogue. They influence the order in which information is revealed, the direction of character relationships, the way major events unfold, and the ending you ultimately reach. Some routes bring you closer to the truth sooner. Others make you recognize the same person only through belated understanding.

At the heart of the game is a simple design belief: choice is the process through which life reveals its color. This world is not meant to be judged through black and white, joy and pain, gain and loss. Fate is a spectrum, and from it you draw the colors you choose - never just one. For that reason, the story is not built around routes that exist only to reward you, nor does it rush to judge who is right or wrong. The encounters, partings, resonances, and entanglements you experience across each worldline all refract into a light that is uniquely your own.

Alongside its branching narrative, the game uses character art, CG scenes, visual presentation, music, and sound design to give each worldline its own emotional weight and atmosphere.

If you enjoy story-rich games, multiple endings, relationship-driven drama, and mysteries that only become clear when viewed from several different routes, Fate Observer: Selective Mutism is designed as a journey of choices, consequences, and truths that must be assembled piece by piece.

store_data.about_the_game:
AAA Island Hotline is a cozy desktop idle farm sim.

Your pet little turtle has finally grown to the size of an entire island! Now, it’s time to settle down and enjoy a relaxing life on the waves with your giant companion.

On your island, you can grow crops, raise adorable animals, stay in touch with friends via satellite phone, and order seeds or eggs through your TV. Most importantly, you can crossbreed your animals to discover endless new variations!

Thousands of adorable animals with countless color combinations!

Just like no two leaves in the world are exactly the same, no two cats on your island will ever be identical!

Forget traditional biology—breeding here is about more than just "copy and paste." Through scientific selection (or just a bit of luck!), you can raise animals with colors that defy common sense.

Whether you’re working or studying, just tuck your island into a corner of your screen.

There are no urgent tasks, and no goals you have to complete~

Let these little creatures keep you company and cheer you on while you tackle your day!

From lush plants to charming decorations, you have total control over your environment.

Start from a blank canvas and build your own mini-world from the ground up. With tons of customization options, feel free to decorate your island into the dream paradise you’ve always imagined!

store_data.about_the_game:
Two strangers, one mysterious island, and a fate they never saw coming.

When a sudden accident leaves two young women shipwrecked on the shores of a seemingly deserted tropical paradise, survival becomes their only goal. But as they navigate the lush jungles and hidden coves, they quickly realize this island holds secrets that defy explanation—and challenges that will test the very core of their bond.

Key Features:

  • A Branching Narrative Driven by Choice: Every decision matters. Your words and actions will forge the relationship between the two survivors, determining how they face adversity and shaping the ultimate outcome of their story.

  • Sandbox Survival Mechanics: Step into a hands-on survival loop where you must gather resources, manage hunger, and build your camp from the ground up to ensure your safety and comfort.

  • Island Mysteries: Explore forgotten ruins and solve environmental puzzles to uncover the truth behind the island’s enigmatic past. Is it truly as empty as it looks?

  • Heartfelt Humor & Positive Drama: Experience a story that balances lighthearted moments of banter and cooking with deep, emotional growth and a message of resilience.

  • Camp Development: Upgrade your living space, unlock new tools, and experiment with local ingredients to keep spirits high in the face of the unknown.

store_data.about_the_game:
Scratch Off! is a deck-building roguelike built around scratch cards. You start with a basic deck, a wallet with no coins, and a landlord who wants his rent. From there, every decision you make shapes your run.

Each turn you pick which cards to commit, scratch them one by one, and watch the numbers add up. Land a full board of positives and you trigger a jackpot. Hit too many skulls and your total tanks. Coins you collect along the way trigger automatically as you scratch, multiplying values, punishing bad luck, and occasionally saving you from disaster.

Between rounds you visit the shop. Buy new cards, add upgrades, grab a coin from the checkpoint cases. Slowly you build something that works, or something that completely falls apart at the worst possible time.

A scratch card game with actual depth

Every card type plays differently. The standard card is a safe workhorse. Diamond cards have brutal skull penalties but enormous clover payouts. Slot cards are one pull from winning everything or losing it all. The Coin is a single cell, pure gambling.

Coins you collect permanently change how the game plays. Stack cherry multipliers. Build a deck around a single card type. Let the landlord win once, unlock the deck that turns every broken coin into a skull, and try again.

Unlock new decks by playing

Every deck unlocks through gameplay, not menus. Win your first run to unlock the Gold Rush deck. Earn minus ten dollars from a single card to unlock No Mercy. The unlock conditions push you to try things you normally would not.

Eight decks in total, each with a modifier that changes the rules of the run. Rent targets go up forty percent. Your hand size shrinks by one. Everything costs less but the shop charges ten times the normal price after you pick up a certain coin.

Build a run, not just a round

Scratch Off! rewards players who think across the whole run, not just the current turn. A coin that feels weak early can be the difference between paying rent on the final group or falling a few dollars short. Removing a bad card now saves you from dead weight later.

The runs are short enough that losing does not sting for long. Long enough that when something clicks and your scratch totals keep climbing, it feels earned.

Features

  • Deck building meets scratch cards

  • Over fifty coins with wildly different effects

  • Eight unlockable decks each with unique run modifiers

  • Jackpot system triggered by full positive boards

  • Endless mode for runs with no finish line

  • 29 languages
