store_data.about_the_game:
"When Rummy meets Roguelite, space is your greatest resource—and your tightest constraint."

Rummy Attack!!

A fresh take on the Roguelite Card Battler, powered by Rummy rules!

Play cards onto the field to create "Melds"—Sets of the same rank or Runs of consecutive numbers—to unleash powerful skills.

Acquire new cards after every battle, build your ultimate deck, and challenge the final boss!

Key Features:

◆ Rummy-Style Combo System (Meld System)

  • Drag and drop cards from your hand directly onto the battlefield!

  • Combine cards into "Sets" (three of a kind) or "Runs" (same suit, consecutive ranks) to trigger various effects like Attack, Defense, and Recovery.

  • Even two cards can be placed as a "Potential Meld." Strategic placement is the key to victory—think ahead and set the stage for massive combos!

◆ Strategic Deck Building

  • Every character starts with a unique deck.

  • Each Suit has a specific role: Swords and Axes for physical attacks, Potions for healing, and Coins for increased rewards. Tailor your deck to match your playstyle!

◆ Battlefield-Shaking "Enemy Gimmicks"

  • As you progress, the enemy's interference becomes more ruthless.

  • "Ground Fissures": Cracks appear on the field, blocking you from placing cards in those areas. Can you complete your melds in the remaining narrow gaps?

  • "Curse of Gigantism": Your cards are forced to grow in size, eating up precious field space! Experience the unique tension of having the right cards but no room to play them.

  • Face a variety of other disruptive skills. Will you crush them with high firepower before they move, or build a flexible deck that thrives in tight spaces? Your preparation and intuition will be put to the test!

◆ Diverse Relics

  • Boost your Muscle to empower attack cards, or increase your Brain to enhance magic!

  • From Critical Rate and Card Size to Magic Range—upgrade various stats through Relics and events to create a truly broken build.

◆ Two Distinct Modes for Your Playstyle

  • [Tactical Move Mode]: A puzzle-like experience where every "Move" counts. Plan each step carefully to build maximum melds with minimum movement.

  • [Intuitive Time Mode]: A high-speed battle where the clock is always ticking. Can you find the optimal melds in the heat of the moment?

4553340.name: SSR Wives: The Murder Of My Winter Crush

store_data.about_the_game:
SSR Wives: The Murder Of My Winter Crush Is an upcoming Retro Survival Horror experience that takes inspiration from iconic staples of the survival horror genre with the romantic and interpersonal intrigue of a Visual Novel. The game aims to create a tense, atmospheric, and immersive experience by combining a Haunting Mystery Narrative, Exploration, challenging puzzles, and terrifying enemy encounters.

CLASSIC SURVIVAL HORROR MECHANICS AND MORE...

  • -Dynamic Fixed cameras system

  • -Classic & Modern Tank Controls

  • -Challenging Puzzles

  • -High-stakes Combat & Varied Enemy encounters

  • -Grid Inventory management

  • -Classic Door Scene Transitions

  • -Haunting Mystery Narrative & World

  • -Collectibles/Documents/Pickables

  • -Interactable Environments

  • -Retro Low-Poly Inspired Visual direction

  • -Romantic Interpersonal Intrigue

  • -Multi-ending experience

  • -Original Soundtrack Production:KORAII

キャラクター CHARACTERS



The Town That Time Forgot inhabits a variety of residents. Inflicted with disorder and scattered around the town. Their respective areas a part of their identity, Dungeons hiding dark secrets, Sins in need of light.

The player will encounter various characters with whom they can interact and build relationships. Players must make dialogue choices that impact their relationships and navigate through personal quests that reveal more about each character's backstory. As relationships deepen, The player can potentially find love, but the player must also balance their emotional connections with the need to survive...

COMBA

Players will encounter a range of grotesque and horrifying enemies, each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Some easier to engage then others the player will have to decide whether to prioritize escape and evasion or directly confront the threats lurking in the dark...

Classic Tank controls create restraint in combat... You do not want to miss your shots,for resources are scarce and consumable items are to be treasured. The Grid based inventory management system will reward organized players with plenty of room and stock to preserve the resources needed to survive until the next safe room.

If you lack the resources to engage, evasion is always an option...

WEAPONS
The game starts out with a small modest arsenal of firearms & melee weapons to collect. But as the game progresses and the combat encounters become more difficult and varied the new arsenal should follow. Earning and seeking out these legendary weapons is optional in many cases. But ultimately rewarding to those who wish to venture into darker places they shouldn't stick around in...

EXPLORATION/PUZZLES/CHOICES
A wide variety of locales,dungeons and environments await In The Town That Time Forgot. Snowy forests, A Veterinary Clinic, An Abandoned Missile Silo, Liminal Labyrinths, An Antiquated Bakery And a Clown Carnival to name just a few... Aside from dangerous enemy encounters in these areas you will also find Classic Survival Horror puzzles in need of solutions. Interact with the environment, find keys to open locked rooms, collect documents to learn more about the world and its inhabitants.

As you explore the environment you might also find situations where choices will be prompted. So be sure to interact with the entirety of an environment to find clues, discover secret items or engage in miscellaneous actions to affect the world like pushing objects, breaking containers or dialoguing with NPCs.

4553360.name: King Of Leberkas - Austria Restaurant Simulator

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to King Of Leberkas – Austria Restaurant Simulator! 

Run your own restaurant in Vienna and start with a true Austrian classic: the Leberkäse sandwich. Your restaurant itself won’t grow in size – but the number of customers definitely will!

Be careful though: your guests are not patient. They have the classic Viennese attitude – short temper, lots of complaints, and quick insults if you mess up.

🕹️ Gameplay

Easy to learn, hectic to master:

  • 👀 Take orders: Look at a customer to take their order

  • 🍳 Cook: Go to the correct machine and press E to prepare food

  • 📦 Serve: Pick it up with E and bring it to the customer

  • 🍽️ Payment: After eating, look at them again to receive money

  • 💰 Rewards: Earn cash and feedback

🔧 Upgrades & Progression

Instead of expanding your restaurant, you improve efficiency:

  • 🍺 Unlock new products (beer, coffee, schnitzel, toast)

  • ⏱️ increase customer waiting time

  • 👨‍🍳 Hire employees to assist and automate tasks

  • 📈 Attract more customers and increase income

The better you perform, the more customers arrive – and the more chaotic it gets!

German tourists will also visit and confuse things by ordering a “Fleischkäsebrötchen”… 😄

And if a customer becomes too annoying:
👉 Throw food at them!
Just be careful – it will make them even more aggressive!

Can you handle the pressure and turn your restaurant into Vienna’s most popular Leberkäse spot?

store_data.about_the_game:
Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

HUNT DOWN HERETICS BY TRAIN

Send your inquisitors out by train on deadly quests to hunt down heretics across the frontier. These expeditions cost vital supplies, can raise madness and revolt, and may leave your inquisitors wounded or broken, but they are necessary. The prisoner shipments must never stop, no matter the cost.

MANAGE YOUR RESOURCES

Weigh short-term survival against long-term collapse by upgrading taxation for desperately needed income, even as it drives revolt higher. Research barracks improvements to strengthen and level your inquisitors, and pause or time buildings carefully to match your current shortages and priorities. When Revolt rises you may need to gift away supplies to calm the population and when madness rises... sacrifices will have to be made. Every choice affects Revolt, Resources, and Madness. Resource management is the key to lasting another day.

CHOOSE THE PATHS YOUR INQUISITORS WILL TAKE

Level up your inquisitors, train them for specialized roles, and assign skills that shape how they survive and perform in the field. Manage their health, level them up in the barracks, and choose carefully who you send on each mission.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH WITH THE META UPGRADES 

Earn Blood Points by sacrificing prisoners and completing shipment quotas, then spend them in the meta progression path to unlock powerful new abilities, bonuses, and lasting advantages for future runs. Shape your doctrine between playthroughs, expand your options, and return stronger each time to face harsher demands and greater horrors.

UNIQUE POWERS TO DEFEAT MONSTERS EACH RUN

Each run lets you choose different abilities to shape your strategy and face the dangers ahead. Use them to overcome challenges, survive encounters, and defeat the monsters and magical creatures that stand in your path.

store_data.about_the_game:
Story Overview

At the edge of a small village stands the Memory Studio, a renovated old abandoned house.
It is a special photo studio that takes on requests to preserve places people don’t want to forget and moments they wish to remember forever through photographs.

Ria, a human girl, and Memo, a talking cat, run the Memory Studio together.
They accept requests and personally travel to locations filled with their clients’ memories, capturing photos and documenting both the past and present of those places.

Character Introduction

Ria

Ria is lively and full of curiosity. She quickly builds rapport even with first-time clients, leading conversations with her warm tone and playful personality.
She occasionally makes quirky jokes, but she has a strong ability to read emotions and empathize with others, making her especially skilled at opening people’s hearts.

Ria’s Memory Camera:
When she photographs an object tied to a memory, its past is captured in the image.
Through photography, she can momentarily freeze objects in place.

Memo

Memo is a quiet, bipedal cat who rarely shows emotions outwardly. Calm, realistic, and cautious in judgment, Memo speaks in a neutral and somewhat indifferent tone.
However, beneath that exterior lies a strong sense of responsibility toward both companions and clients.

Liquid Cat:
With a flexible body, Memo can slip through narrow spaces across the map and interact with objects using elasticity.

Immerse yourself as Ria and Memo, cooperate, and follow the story as you solve puzzles hidden throughout each map—helping recover the precious memories of various clients!

store_data.about_the_game:
EraPuzzle: Grid & Glory is a casual tile-based puzzle game where smart planning and resource management are the keys to victory. Grow your settlement, harvest the land, and stretch your reach across the map to claim the golden prize — all at your own relaxed pace.

Build villages to gather resources from nearby trees, then use those resources to construct towers that extend your reach across the grid. Connect your way to the goldmine to complete each level. Simple to learn, satisfying to master.

Key Features

- Tile-based puzzle gameplay with a unique resource chain mechanic

- Build villages, towers, and barracks to expand across the map

- Harvest trees for resources — but plan wisely, resources are finite!

- Destroy goblin camps with your barracks to unlock blocked territory

- Refund resources by demolishing buildings — as long as you don't break the chain!

- Beautiful visuals and a relaxing soundtrack

- Hand-crafted levels with increasing depth and challenge

How It Works

Every level starts with your main base. From there, build villages within your reach radius to harvest nearby trees and bank resources. Spend those resources on towers to push your build radius further across the map. Watch out for goblin camps — they block construction in their territory until you build a barracks and drive them out.

Every decision matters. Demolish wisely, plan your chain, and reach the goldmine to claim your glory!

store_data.about_the_game:
❀🌺🌸Overview🌸🌺❀

Overbloom is a real-time roguelite tower defense where you cultivate powerful plant builds, discover strange items from the past, and survive against a spreading corruption looking to consume all life on the planet!

Build unique setups every run, experiment with status effects, synergies and see how far your garden can go!

🌸Mother Nature always gets the last laugh in this roguelite!🌸

❀🌺🌸Gameplay🌸🌺❀

  • Place plants on a grid-based board to defend the last sapling from waves of corrupted enemies

  • Find items that transform the battlefield, giving you an edge against enemies

  • Combine plant abilities to create powerful, emergent builds

  • Adapt your strategy as enemies evolve and grow stronger

  • Survive as long as possible in increasingly hostile runs

❀🌺🌸Key Features🌸🌺❀

  • 25 unique plants, each with distinct mechanics and abilities

  • 5 starting decks, with passive abilities to suggest a certain playstyle

  • 19 items that alter gameplay, from stat buffs to proc effects such as burning on hit

  • Procedurally evolving runs. No two runs are the same

  • Corrupted enemies that become more powerful overtime

  • Clean, readable pixel art designed for clarity and atmosphere

❀🌺🌸Accessibility🌸🌺❀

Overbloom includes features intended to make the game more accessible to everyone. These features include:

  • Colorblind palettes for aspects of the game such as health, XP, and item rarities, designed for easy differentiation for people affected by deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia, or achromatopsia

  • Use of dyslexic-friendly fonts to make important information easier to read

  • The game is fully playable using just a mouse

  • Distinct silhouettes for each plant, item, and enemy for clear readability

  • Settings to adjust brightness and contrast

A grueling cyber-labyrinth spanning 100 floors. Your only lifelines are the random enhancements found beyond each door and your own resource management. Conquer luck with pure strategy in this definitive roguelike experience.

To unlock the functions of the BMI-type investigative support prototype "ADA," investigator Mutsumi Rokkaku dives into the virtual world "B2." Plunging into a massive maze without equipment or pre-set abilities, Mutsumi’s journey is truly that of a "Rising Fool."

Gameplay

This title is a floor-based roguelike where your goal is to conquer 100 levels. In each floor, players must choose one of "Three Doors" to progress through combat and events.

Combat is turn-based, where you select from "Quick, Buster, and Counter" to face enemies. The affinity between these choices, your stats, and limited ST management determine the outcome. ST is consumed for everything—exploration, combat, and skill usage. Deciding when to fight and when to evade is critical. If you are defeated or your ST is depleted, it is Game Over, and you must restart from the 1st floor.

"Select Door → Combat/Event → Power-up → Next Floor" Repeat this cycle to defeat the Guardian at the 100th floor.

The game is primarily played using mouse-driven selection.

Key Systems

1. Tactical Triangle: The 3-Way Psychological Battle

Combat is built on a "Rock-Paper-Scissors" structure: Quick, Buster, and Counter.

  • Quick seals Counters.

  • Buster crushes Quicks.

  • Counter parries Busters.

  • When affinities are tied, the outcome is determined by your Breakthrough Power stat. If Breakthrough Power is also equal, fate is left to chance.

2. Extreme "ST (Stamina) Management"

Every action—Growth, Combat, and Skill Usage—requires a shared resource: ST.

  • The Cost of Combat: ST is consumed for every single action. The longer a battle drags on, the harder it becomes to continue your exploration.

  • The Weight of Gear: Powerful equipment increases your ST Cost per action. Will you choose heavy armor for a quick decimation of foes, or light gear for a war of attrition? Your build's direction determines your survival.

3. Exploration Skills: Devouring Risk

In each floor, you are presented with three doors and six growth parameters. Manipulating these with skills is the key to conquest.

  • Bipolar: Pay ST to double your gained parameters. However, failure results in a lethal "-2x" penalty.

  • Fate Transfer: Reroll the available doors and parameters to pull destiny back in your favor.

  • Gate Summons: Summon a door leading directly to the next floor. Be warned: failure may summon the "Bone Door," bringing you face-to-face with an immediate Game Over.

The 6 Growth Parameters

Vitality / Strength / Resistance / Dexterity / Agility / Luck

These stats directly influence not only the advantages in combat but also your efficiency during exploration. Specializing in the right stats is the only way to defeat the Guardian of the 100th Floor.

store_data.about_the_game:
OVERVIEW

Early 1990s China. The reform era is tearing up the old rulebook, the economy, the streets, the people on them. Nothing is settled. Everything is moving.

SHIFU: Traffic Masters is a driving anthology set in one city at the peak of that transformation. Five protagonists, five completely different ways to work the exact same streets.

You're a Shifu 师傅, a skilled working driver. You read traffic, you know the shortcuts, you've earned your reputation one run at a time. Forget GPS. Forget racing lines. The city is your only map, and it doesn't hand anything out for free.

Every job plays by its own rules. A truck full of livestock drives nothing like a van packed with fragile goods. A nervous passenger changes how you take corners. A fleeing suspect in a packed intersection changes everything. The city watches how you drive. Drive it well.

FEATURES

Five Ways to Work the City

  • Truck — Haul goods across districts against the clock. Hit the brakes too hard and the cargo won't forgive you. Livestock panic. So will you.

  • Taxi — Read your fare, read the traffic, find the line nobody else sees. Every passenger has demands. Some of them are even reasonable.

  • Bus — Full load, fixed route, rush hour. The schedule does not care about the traffic jam in front of you.

  • Police — Chase suspects through streets that don't clear out just because you're on duty. Live traffic. Real consequences.

  • Racing — City circuits where knowing the alley behind the street market beats any horsepower advantage.

The City Changes How You Drive

  • 80s/90s vehicle roster: cargo tricycles, sedans, vans, trucks, buses, and working machines of every size. Each handles differently. Each has a job.

  • No GPS, no route lines, the city rewards drivers who learn it

  • Dynamic traffic, weather, and seasons shift the challenge every run

  • Cargo types, passenger moods, and road conditions change your approach to every corner

One City, Five Stories

  • A living city of pedestrians, cyclists, vendors, and traffic that you need to navigate through

  • Five narrative series, five working lives unfolding in the same changing streets

  • Weather and seasons woven into the story, not just the scenery

  • Fully bilingual: Chinese and English throughout

store_data.about_the_game:
Exile Era

About This Game

When the AI brands you as "inefficient," when a virus tears the world apart, when former kin divide into three irreconcilable factions—you, an Old Human exiled to the bottom-tier islands, must struggle to survive amid zombies, factions, and AI sweeps.

Exile Era is an open-world game blending RPG character progression, sandbox construction, and zombie survival. In this post-apocalyptic world ruled by algorithms, every choice reshapes your destiny.

Core Features

Three Worlds, One Desperate Situation

Human civilization has fractured completely:

New Humans occupy the core islands, commanding cutting-edge technology and AI privileges—they are the winners of this efficiency revolution;

Old Humans are the discarded survivors of the lower class, struggling on exile islands for a bite of food and a roof overhead—this is your origin;

Mutants are products of the X-virus, retaining sanity yet driven by instinct, existing in the gray zone between human and zombie.

There is no absolute justice, only the instinct to survive.

Define Your Own Survival

Lone Wolf Stealth: One person, one blade, hunting in the shadows, writing legends with silence and precision;

Path of the Leader: Recruit survivors, establish strongholds, and rebuild the spark of order in the apocalypse;

Nomadic Survival: Abandon fixed bases, make your vehicle your home, and seek opportunities between islands.


Every way of living has its cost; every path has its end.

Build Your Sanctuary

From concealed underground bunkers to heavily fortified fortresses, from mobile truck bases to automated industrial outposts—the physics-driven construction system gives weight to every brick and life-or-death stakes to every defensive line.

Set traps, establish power grids, stockpile supplies. When the horde arrives or raiders come knocking, your designs will be tested by blood and fire.

Human Hearts Are Harder to Read Than Zombies

NPCs remember every promise and betrayal. Help a stranger, and they may become your most loyal comrade; raid a settlement, and you gain resources—but may invite endless pursuit.

Teammates will fear, despair, and question your leadership. In resource-scarce desperation, how will you maintain team morale and trust?

The Weekly Trial of Survival

The AI never stops. Every seven days, drones sweep across the islands, marking those "without contribution, without resources, without value."

Hide, fight, or prove your worth—this is the ultimate test every Old Human in the Exile Era must face.

### Dynamic World, Chain of Fate

Weather, seasons, and random events constantly reshape the island landscape. A storm may flood your farmland or cover your infiltration of enemy camps; an airdrop draws competing factions, and your choice to intervene or observe shifts the balance of power.

No two journeys are the same. Your world is shaped by your choices.

Key Gameplay

Open World Exploration: Urban ruins, wilderness, industrial wastelands, underground facilities—each zone holds unique resources, dangers, and secrets to uncover

Deep Character Development: Four skill branches, trait system, and moral choices shape a unique survival specialist

Strategic Base Building: From site selection to defense design, from power networks to automated production, build your sanctuary in the apocalypse

Faction Political Maneuvering: Navigate between New Humans, Old Humans, and Mutants—ally, betray, or remain independent

Diverse Combat: Melee brawling, ranged sniping, trap ambushes, vehicle ramming—choose your hunting style

Procedural Event System: Random encounters, base defense, story choices ensure fresh experiences every playthrough

Are You Ready to Face Exile?

In this world torn apart by algorithms and viruses, efficiency is no longer virtue but a blade; humanity is no longer weakness but the final fortress.

Exile Era awaits every survivor who refuses to submit.

Procedurally generated world. Player-written legends.

store_data.about_the_game:
Self-Checkout is a co-op stealth chaos game set entirely inside a supermarket. Your crew's mission is simple: walk out with more than you paid for. Your tools are teamwork, timing, and the ability to throw your friends under the bus at a moment's notice.

Teamwork Makes the Scheme Work

One of you scans. One of you distracts. One of you is supposed to be the lookout but is currently comparing yogurt brands in aisle 4. Every heist only works if everyone does their job, and nobody ever does their job.

But the Store is Watching

Overhead cameras. Weight sensors that are smarter than they look. A floor attendant who has seen it all before. A Karen in aisle 7 who absolutely has nothing better to do. The more players on the floor, the more chaos, and the more witnesses.

Features

  • 1-4 player co-op with fully destructible trust between teammates

  • Escalating levels across increasingly high-security supermarkets

  • Assignable crew roles: Scanner, Distractor, Lookout, Getaway Cart

  • Dozens of items to smuggle, from a single grape to a flat-screen TV

  • Techniques to master together: the Decoy Spill, the Stroller Method, the Fake Price Check, the Human Shield

  • A blame system: when someone gets caught, the whole crew votes on who started it

  • Full receipt review at the end of every run. Good luck explaining the TV.

The store thinks you're valued customers. You are not valued customers.

Self-Checkout: Scan. Weigh. Steal.

store_data.about_the_game:
You spawn in with a couple of random wands, a couple of random components, and a random perk. From there you will progress through castles full of enemies that are trying to kill you. 

Enemies drop their wand on death. Pick them up, grab the components you want and move them to your current wand. Or, if the enemy's wand is better, use it as your new main one. 

At the end of each level you'll face a boss- they're bigger, stronger, and they have a staff. Good luck.

Once you defeat the boss, you get a perk and get to go to the next level. Enemies will get more health, different kinds of wands with better stats and components will spawn. 

How do wands work?

Your wand is made up of several different factors that all decide what kind of projectile you will cast.

  • Wand material: Projectile type, number of component slots, mana pool and recharge rate

  • Hilt: Status effect, colour and base projectile stats

  • Components: Modifies the projectile, including cast delay, damage, mana consumption, size, and more.

Want a rapid-fire wand for mowing down hordes? Reduce the wand's cast delay and watch the enemies get torn apart. Just make sure your wand has enough mana to handle it.

Want a powerful blast that brings bosses to their knees? Add damage and fire away. Be careful though, you might end up taking more recoil than you expected.

What kind of spells can I cast?

Currently there are four projectile types:

  • Orb (single shot, standard projectile)

  • Scattershot (many smaller orbs with a wide spread)

  • Laser (melee, attached to your wand)

  • Shield (protective barrier in front of your wand)

Three status effects:

  • Fire (damage over time)

  • Condensed Health (take more damage, and drop a health pickup on death)

  • Condensed Mana (spells cost more mana, and drop a mana pickup on death)

Components are divided into two groups:

  • Tiered modifiers (these have multiple tiers, each tier provides a better modifier bonus but also a negative effect)

  • Unique modifiers (these have a great effect and usually a really negative one too. The modifiers you want will depend on your run and your playstyle)

5 identical tiered components can be combined to get one from the next tier. This gives you an edge over the enemies in the current level.

And there are 36 different base wands, each with a different combination of projectile type, mana pool and number of component slots.

The higher the amount of mana that's remaining in the wand's mana pool, the better. If you cast a wand with 50% mana left, it's going to consume slightly more mana than when it's at 100%. If you cast a wand with not enough mana remaining, your projectiles will have massively reduced stats, including size and speed. You'll need to balance your loadout effectively to make sure you have the wands needed to take on a group of enemies.

What's a staff?

Staffs are made up of multiple wands, each firing in order when you cast.

The staff has a mana pool equal to the total max mana of all equipped wands. Staffs don't regenerate mana- you'll need to find your own to refill it. It's a powerful weapon that lets you fire a wide variety of spells in quick order, including different status effects and projectile types.

You spawn in with a couple of random wands, a couple of random components, and a random perk. From there you will progress through castles full of enemies that are trying to kill you. 

Enemies drop their wand on death. Pick them up, grab the components you want and move them to your current wand. Or, if the enemy's wand is better, use it as your new main one. 

At the end of each level you'll face a boss- they're bigger, stronger, and they have a staff. Good luck.

Once you defeat the boss, you get a perk and get to go to the next level. Enemies will get more health, different kinds of wands with better stats and components will spawn.

Your wand is made up of several different factors that all decide what kind of projectile you will cast.

  • Wand material: Projectile type, number of component slots, mana pool and recharge rate

  • Hilt: Status effect, colour and base projectile stats

  • Components: Modifies the projectile, including cast delay, damage, mana consumption, size, and more.

store_data.about_the_game:
In Chyma and the Toll of Time, you'll play as the titular Chyma, a little bell trying to unravel the story of his people to save the planet. Chyma wields the power of the Rungback, allowing him to create a copy of himself that will follow his exact movements and actions. Using this ability, solve fun puzzles to ascend the temple, uncovering secrets and learning new powerful abilities along the way!

Solve puzzles with the Rungback!

Using Chyma's special abilities, create a copy of yourself to help solve puzzles. Your copy – the Reverb – will follow your path, allowing you to be in two places at once!

Uncover the mystery of the temple!

As Chyma makes his way through the levels, he will discover special artifacts that can help him learn more about the history of the temple and the ones who lived there.

Master many mechanics!

The temple is filled with all sorts of inventions, from guards to rolling balls to dangerous lasers. Chyma will have to learn to maneuver around and manipulate these obstacles in order to continue on his quest.

Save the world!

There's a meteor swiftly approaching, and the world is without a solution. Only Chyma is courageous enough to enter the mysterious temple to save his home.

Listen to dozens of songs!

Chyma and the Toll of Time features a dynamic sound system, meaning that the music in the level will change as you interact with the environment. One song can have dozens of variations depending on what obstacles are in each level and whether or not they are activated.

Play over 30 levels!

Chyma and the Toll of Time features five unique areas, each with several levels. In total, the game has over 30 levels and a few hours of puzzle-solving fun!

store_data.about_the_game:
Plot

Play as Raiju, an electric dog spirit searching for his missing brother Fuju, a Benevolent Wind Spirit whose disappearance has thrown the winds into chaos. With powerful yokai emerging in his wake, collect the 36 Heavenly Wind Bells to unlock the path forward and bring him home.

Play Your Way

Haiju is a classic collectathon at heart, with optional RPG elements for players seeking deeper narrative and worldbuilding, designed so neither system ever interrupts the flow of the other. All dialogue and NPC interaction is entirely optional, woven into the RPG layer for those who choose to engage with it. Drop in for a short session or stay for the long haul. 

The World

Haiju is rooted in traditional Japanese mythology and folklore, bringing ancient spirits, sacred landscapes, and timeless legends to life across every realm.

Boss Fights

The deeper you dig into Haiju's world, the more secrets reveal themselves. Seek out hidden boss battles that demand skills beyond the standard game, and track down the wise sages to learn the abilities needed to topple these ancient foes.

Features

  • Explore an expansive array of spirit realms, each connected to a grounded central hub world

  • Glide across vast distances to reach hidden paths and secret areas

  • Scorch yokai with Raiju's electrical shock attack

  • Channel the thunderous Taiko drum to charge through obstacles at high speeds

  • Uncover ancient lore through the spirits and villagers you meet along the way

  • Solve environmental puzzles woven into the landscape itself

  • Collect Heavenly relics to complete each realm

  • Revisit each realm to uncover new NPC interactions and tackle time challenges

Inspiration

Spyro the Dragon meets Okami, with a hint of Princess Mononoke

store_data.about_the_game:
This casual puzzle game features beautiful graphics that make up:

A beautiful coastal area in Qinzhou, known for its serene beaches and stunning sunsets.

Game starts:

Click on 'start game', the image will be grayed out, and the colored parts will be randomly scrambled into 16 small fragments, scattered randomly on the screen

Game process:

Players click on the small image, drag it to its original position to restore it, until all the small images move to the correct position, and the game ends

End or start the next game:

All the small fragments move to the correct position, and the game ends. At this point, click "try again" to repeat the game.

store_data.about_the_game:
GameBuilder Puzzle Platformer is a unique grid-based puzzle platformer where you don’t just solve levels — you build the path to complete them.

Each level starts as a partially completed grid filled with obstacles, coins, and a goal. Your objective is to place missing tiles in the correct positions so the character can collect every coin and safely reach the end.

Every placement matters. One smart move can solve the puzzle — one mistake can block the path.

🧩 THINK BEFORE YOU MOVE

Unlike traditional platformers, success depends on planning ahead.
Design the route first, then watch it unfold.

  • Build paths using strategic tile placement

  • Solve puzzles using logic, timing, and creativity

  • Experiment to discover the perfect solution

🔄 UNIQUE TILE MECHANICS

As the challenge grows, so does the variety of tiles you must master. Arrow tiles turn the character left or right and redirect movement. Gravity inversion tiles flip the character onto the opposite surface and change the way the level must be approached. Lever tiles unlock gates and open new paths. Disappearing platforms create temporary routes that must be used carefully. Spike tiles punish unsafe paths. Cloning tiles add a new layer of strategy by creating extra characters, forcing you to think about multiple movements at once. Teleporting tiles instantly move the character from one point to another and open up new ways to cross the level. And dimension switch tiles send the character into a parallel version of the same grid, where the layout, hazards, and opportunities can be completely different.

🌌 PARALLEL DIMENSIONS

Switch between dimensions to solve puzzles in new ways.

A path blocked in one world may open in another.
Your actions in one dimension can completely change the outcome in the next.

🚀 FEATURES

  • Grid-based puzzle gameplay with path-building strategy

  • Increasing difficulty with new mechanics

  • Collect all coins to complete each level

  • Creative mix of puzzle-solving and platforming

  • Family-friendly and logic-driven gameplay

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to BOMBERCOOK!, the only restaurant where the customers are monsters and the menu is explosive!

BOMBERCOOK! is a chaotic, top-down cooking-defense hybrid that blends the frantic workflow of Overcooked with the strategic destruction of Bomberman. As the last chef in a world overrun by hungry invaders, you don't just serve meals, you blast it!.

COOK. BLAST. SURVIVE.

Running a kitchen is hard. Running a kitchen while under siege is a nightmare. To survive, you’ll need to master the art of Explosive Cuisine. Gather raw ingredients from your pantry, prep them at specialized stations, and cook them to perfection in fryers, ovens, and freezers.

A MENU OF DESTRUCTION

One size doesn't fit all when it comes to defense. Experiment with a variety of "recipes" to find the perfect counter for every enemy:

  • Blast Bomb: The standard classic for everyday defense.

  • Repair Bomb: Don’t eat it! Use it to mend your crumbling base.

  • Stun & Ice: Chill out your enemies or shock them into place.

  • Flame & Magnet: Set the battlefield ablaze or pull resources (and foes) into the path of a blast.

DEFEND YOUR BASE

Your kitchen is your fortress. Build and repair your base flags to keep the "customers (creeps)" at bay. From agile Hunters who dodge your blasts to massive Siege Units that fire from afar, you'll need to manage your workflow while manually aiming and throwing your creations to stop them blasting your base away.

SURVIVE THE KITCHEN FROM HELL

Just when you think you’ve got the rhythm down, nature strikes! Adapt to Disaster Phases that change the rules of the game:

  • Typhoons that flood the floor and make ingredients float away.

  • Earthquakes that knock items off stations and ruin your timing.

  • Blizzards that freeze your movement but speed up your cold-prep recipes.

KEY FEATURES

  • High-Stakes Multi-tasking: Balance ingredient gathering and active base defense.

  • 5 Diverse Chapters Planned: Journey from the Cooking School to the treacherous Volcano Kitchen.

  • Quality Matters: Bring in "Booster Upgrades" for massive damage bonuses and faster clears.

  • Epic Boss Fights: Face off against legendary foes like the Burnt Chef and the Disaster Master.

  • Low-Poly Aesthetic: Vibrant, stylized cartoon 3D art that keeps the chaos clear and the explosions satisfying.

Do you have what it takes to be a Master Bomber Chef? Grab your apron, light the fuse, and get cooking!

store_data.about_the_game:
The sky is no longer a road, and the railways are beyond repair.

After a catastrophic meteor impact shattered the continent of Aris, only the roads remain — and the vehicles that can travel upon them.

You are an engineer at the factory in "Karless", the last city capable of producing vehicles. Design and automate production lines to manufacture cars, and ship them out to reconnect the severed regions of Aris.

Mine raw resources, research new technologies, and build increasingly complex supply chains — from raw ore to steel plates, from engine modules to a fully assembled vehicle rolling off the line.

Key Features

  ∙ Multi-Tier Production Chains — Transform raw resources through three tiers of crafting: ores into intermediates, intermediates into 10 distinct vehicle modules, and modules into a complete car. Every component matters.

store_data.about_the_game:
The Die of Flower is a top-down perspective format that gradually reconstructs the entire story by using the special effects of cards. The story may have an order, but the order is not unique.

The Die of Flower sets at least one pass condition in each scene, and these conditions are written on some special cards.

The Die of Flower assists in completing levels through various actions, such as moving, talking, and handing the cards in your hand to the other party. These actions have special significance in The Die of Flower and can ensure the character's survival. if an important character dies, a failure result will occur.

Each time a special effect is used, the text on the card will be recorded on the right. The smoother the recorded text reads, the closer it is to the original meaning of the story.

store_data.about_the_game:
Simple. Pure. Immersive.

Pool Glow is an immersive psychological exploration experience that transports players into a bright yet subtly unreal poolcore world—where the water reflects a still, frozen glow, and echoes drift gently through the space. Clean, luminous pools and interconnected environments form a domain that feels both tranquil and quietly comforting.

There is no combat and no defined objective—only exploration, perception, and the gradual emergence of spatial memory. Original music and ambient sound design enhance the sense of presence, drawing you deeper into the experience. If you have the patience, we invite you to follow your own pace, wander slowly through these spaces, and embrace the simplicity and calm they offer. If this atmosphere brings you even a moment of peace and clarity, then it has fulfilled its purpose.

This game is inspired by poolcore artworks shared on Instagram and X, particularly the works of artists such as Jared Pike and P. Carredo.

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the night shift, coder.

You’re just an ordinary IT guy in a small tech company. While normal people sleep or live their lives during the day, you sit in a dimly lit office, illuminated only by the glow of several monitors.

But reality quickly starts to slip away.

Because of chronic sleep deprivation and an old head injury, you begin experiencing extremely realistic hallucinations. At first, it’s just shadows in the corner of your eye. Then — strange silhouettes. And soon they start moving, whispering your name, and reaching toward you with long, thin fingers.

Your only salvation is coffee.

Every sip brings you back to reality, drives the creatures away, and gives you the strength to keep going. But the coffee is running out, the coffee machine is acting up, and time is ticking.

Gameplay:

  • Manage your alertness and caffeine levels

  • Drink coffee, brew more, and search the office for supplies

  • Complete your work tasks (fix bugs, write code, finish reports)

  • Fight hallucinations: the less coffee you have, the more aggressive and realistic the creatures become

  • Search old documents and colleagues’ chats for clues about your “head condition”

A mix of coffee simulator, psychological horror, and dark office humor.

Features:

  • Atmospheric night office with realistic physics and details

  • Black humor about IT life, bugs, and procrastination

  • Soundtrack of server humming, keyboard clacking, and uneasy silence

  • Short but extremely tense sessions (perfect for one or two nights)

Are you ready to finish this shift? Or will the creatures finally get their programmer?

store_data.about_the_game:
From nobody to legend: Take control in Tactilite, a modern football manager game that combines in-depth tactics with engaging RPG mechanics. Start in the third division with a variety of Swiss cities, mold them into world-class players through rigorous training, and fight your way to the top of the first division. Win the championship, triumph in the cup, and prove you're the best manager in the world!

RPG meets football: Level up your players!

Forget static values. Tactilite introduces a dynamic player development based on real experience. Every match and every goal brings your players closer to the next level-up. Use the newly gained skill points to invest specifically in three different paths, thus defining the player class. Unlock powerful passive effects and optimize your squad synergies for ultimate success.

Tactics & Synergies

Eleven good players don't automatically make a good team. Find the perfect synergies for your starting eleven! Without a brilliant playmaker in midfield, your best striker will be starved of energy. Pay attention to your players' personalities (traits): A "diva" will shine in important matches, while a "mercenary" will abandon you immediately if the salary isn't right.

6 Unique Manager Archetypes

Every playthrough is different! Unlock new manager classes through achievements, completely changing the game rules:

  • Standard: The classic approach. No crazy bonuses, no extreme disadvantages.

  • The Underdog: Receives massive bonuses against overpowered teams. However, if you're the favorite, your players will crumble under the pressure.

  • The Tycoon: Starts with an absurd €50 million, but all your players demand exorbitant prices.

  • Youth Visionary: Your academy talents level up twice as fast.

  • The Discipline Priest: Your players have unlimited stamina, but risk constant injuries.

  • Hardcore: Only for the absolute legends.

Exciting transfer battles

The transfer market never sleeps. Find the best bargains, improve your manager skills (like becoming a financial guru or a poaching expert), and outsmart the AI. If a competitor wants the same star player as you, it's a thrilling game of dice poker at the negotiating table!

The Ascension mode (endgame)

So, you’ve won the league and lifted the cup? Congratulations. But don't get too comfortable, because now the real game begins. Is the 1st division getting too easy for you? Unlock four brand-new modifiers and crank up the difficulty exactly as high as you can handle.

Prove your worth against these brutal conditions:

  • 💰 Financial Difficulty (Lvl 1-5): Money is tight. Battle against plummeting revenues, exploding transfer fees, and demanding salaries.

  • 🧠 XP Reduction (Lvl 1-5): Progression becomes a real grind. Suffer a penalty of -5 XP per level (up to a brutal -25 XP at Level 5).

  • 🚑 Injury Risk (Lvl 1-5): Watch your legs! The injury risk increases exponentially (2^Level) – facing up to a 32% higher chance of losing players at Level 5.

  • ⚔️ Kick-Out Challenge (Lvl 1): Zero margin for error. Fulfill ruthless board expectations, or get fired on the spot!

Do you have what it takes to survive the pressure and become the ultimate Sunday League Legend?

A game for true managers: Tactilite is a purely single-player experience. No in-app purchases, no microtransactions, no online requirement. Just you, your negotiating skills, and the path to cup victory.

Before the first sunrise, five gods walked the void hand in hand.

They were siblings born from the same thought:

Alaz the Smith, Skadi the Endurer, Litavis the Grower, Shezmu the Dreamer, and Prometheus the Beating Heart.

Together they forged the world's mountains hammered on Alaz’s anvil, seas frozen by Skadi’s sigh, forests sung from Litavis's seed, deserts spun from Shezmu's laughter, and every living pulse tied to Prometheus's drum.

Then came the betrayal...

FREEDOM!

You will be able to interact and move almost everything in the world whether good or bad, but be warned, your actions will have consequences.

Features

  • Highly interactive world

  • Player Freedom

  • Monster Taming

  • Classless talent system

  • Deep Character Customization

  • Single or Multiplayer

store_data.about_the_game:
Every card can win or lose the game.

Castle Wars: Legacy is a competitive card strategy game where you build, defend, and destroy in tactical battles inspired by a true classic. Based on Ants by Miroslav Němeček and later popularized as Castle Wars by m0rkeulv, Legacy brings the timeless formula into a modern competitive experience by Proclive.

Face off against AI or real players in fast-paced matches (3–5 minutes) where every decision matters. Balance offense, defense, and resource generation as you outplay your opponent and bring their castle down.

Strategic Card Battles

Play resource, attack, defense, and magic cards to control the flow of battle.
Manage Bricks, Weapons, and Crystals, generated each turn by your Builders, Soldiers, and Mages, and use them wisely to execute your strategy.

Build, Defend, Destroy

Your Wall absorbs damage, but once it falls, your Castle is exposed.
Win by destroying your opponent’s castle or by reaching maximum strength before they do.

Build Your Deck

Earn coins through victories, tournaments, campaigns, and achievements. Use them to unlock new cards and create powerful custom decks.

  • Build decks with 75 to 200 cards

  • Create multiple decks for different strategies

  • Adapt your deck before each match to counter opponents or challenges

Multiple Ways to Play

  • Story Campaign – Battle through 6 AI levels and earn up to 3 stars per stage

  • PvP Multiplayer – Compete against real players and climb the ELO leaderboard

  • Daily Tournaments – Enter rotating arenas and compete for coin rewards

Deep Yet Accessible

  • Easy to learn, hard to master

  • Endless strategic combinations

  • Every match plays differently

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to the Arena of Elements!

Decks & Dashes is a fast-paced action-deckbuilder where strategic spellcasting meets lightning-fast reflexes. Step into the grand arena as an ambitious mage and battle your way to the top by drafting powerful elemental cards and outmaneuvering your opponents.

In this high-stakes tournament, your deck is your weapon. Will you rely on the explosive power of fire, the freezing control of ice, chaotic wind storms, or the dark arts of necromancy?

But a perfect deck isn't enough—you'll need to stay on your toes. "Decks" handle the strategy, but "Dashes" handle your survival. Dodge enemy spells, weave through dangerous area-of-effect attacks, and position yourself for the perfect devastating counter-strike.

Key Features:

  • Build Your Ultimate Spellbook: Draft and collect dozens of unique magical cards. Mix and match elements to discover broken synergies and craft a deck that fits your playstyle.

  • Action-Packed Arena Combat: Combat happens in real-time. You must constantly move, dash, and reposition yourself to avoid incoming damage while slinging your spells.

  • Master the Elements: Unleash blazing fireballs, summon freezing blizzards, conjure tornados, or raise the dead. Every element has its own unique status effects and mechanics.

  • Face Fearsome Challengers: Go head-to-head against a roster of increasingly difficult magical combatants and massive bosses, each with their own unique attack patterns to learn and overcome.

  • Endless Replayability: With randomized card rewards and diverse enemy encounters, no two runs through the arena are ever the same. Adapt your strategy on the fly to claim victory!

Once, the world was stable and at peace. But as water resources began to run dry, nations fell into crisis. Borders tightened, trust disappeared, and strict visa regulations were introduced to control the movement of people.

You are a visa officer assigned to the front line of this system.

Every day, desperate applicants stand before you each with their own story. Your task is to inspect documents, verify identities, and decide who is allowed to enter. A single mistake could have serious consequences.

As pressure rises, so do the stakes. Some will try to deceive you. Some will offer bribes. Others will beg for help. You must choose between following the rules or bending them to survive.

Outside the office, your personal life continues. You must provide for your family, manage your expenses, and live with the consequences of your decisions.

With each passing day, new challenges emerge, and the line between right and wrong begins to fade.

Loot, Fight and Mine

In Distance Travellers you're missioned with the task of flying your very own ship provided to you by Argon Space Co, your ship is all you need in the barron waste of future spaceflight.

Survival depends on every pilots skill in ruling the galaxy for their own gain, every pilot for themselves.

Mine your way to a peaceful life

You have the option of the route you want to take in this life, if you choose to mine to make your millions then so be it, try to be a shifty miner, warp in, mine and warp out asap without being seen by anyone, upgrade your cargo hold to store more while having the best radar to detect ships sooner.

Jump in Jump out!

Pick where you jump to wisely, jump into the wrong system or area and you could be risking losing all the equipment you've been working so hard on building up.

Once you jump to a system remember that fuel is your limiting resource, fuel is finite so make sure you leave before you loose your ability to fly home.

Battle against traps and AI ships

Find yourself being chased by missiles from around the corner of an asteroid because you got close to an old mine unit, or a patrolling ship trying to keep you out of their mineral area.

Crafting upgrades

Mine or loot resources to unlock better equipment to craft.

Much much more coming....

store_data.about_the_game:
Centre 18 is a management, simulation, and emergency coordination game that puts you in command of a real fire and rescue service. Build your stations, organize your teams, expand your fleet of emergency vehicles, and manage real-time missions in an environment inspired by actual emergency operations centers.

Designed for fans of strategy games, management simulators, and professional emergency simulations, Centre 18 delivers a complete experience focused on decision-making, operational efficiency, and resource management.

A complete emergency management and simulation experience

In Centre 18, every decision matters. You will:

• receive and assess emergency calls,

• dispatch the appropriate units,

• monitor mission phases in real time,

• manage reinforcements,

• ensure the safety of your teams,

• optimize your organization to improve overall performance.

The intervention system is built on realistic logic: mission phases, radio transmissions, unit arrivals, tactical progression, and return to normal.

Build, develop, command

The game is structured around several interconnected internal modules:

• Map: positioning, operational coverage, and field monitoring

• Call Center: situation analysis and resource dispatch

• Personnel: recruitment, training, skills, and assignments

• Vehicles: crew management, availability, and specialties

• Stations: construction, upgrades, and strategic organization

• Shop: fleet development and vehicle acquisition

• History: operation analysis and financial tracking

Each module contributes to the growth and efficiency of your emergency service.

Three game modes for every playstyle

• Career: long-term progression, budget constraints, strategic development

• Scenarios: scripted missions with clear objectives and operational pressure

• Sandbox: total freedom with no financial limits

A constantly evolving project

Version 0.1 lays the foundation of the game: core intervention system, full management loop, first scenarios, immersive interface, and multilingual localization.

Many updates will expand Centre 18 with new vehicles, scenarios, gameplay mechanics, visual improvements, and advanced features.

Join Centre 18 now, follow its development, and take command of a modern, strategic, and fully customizable emergency service.

store_data.about_the_game:
Everis is a multiplayer procedural sandbox game where players build a single shared world

Explore an infinite procedural world, go on adventures, meet other players, complete quests, and travel across landscapes created by the community.

But Everis is more than a world to explore : it’s a world to build.

Players can switch to creative mode, design structures, landscapes, dungeons, or entire cities, and submit their creations to the community. Through a voting system, the most loved creations are integrated into the shared world for everyone.

One world built by players.

Explore a world shaped by players

Everis is first and foremost a world to explore.

Travel across vast procedural landscapes, discover places created by the community, and embark on adventures alone or with friends. Along the way, you may encounter hidden locations, player-designed dungeons, quests, or entire cities built by other explorers.

Meet other players, form groups, and set out on journeys together. Customize your character, improve your abilities, fight enemies, collect resources, loot equipment, and trade with other players. Through exploration, combat, and discovery, players gradually grow stronger while carving their own path through a rich and ever-changing world.

Every horizon in Everis has a story behind it, because someone in the community imagined it.

The Alternate World

Beyond the shared world shaped by players lies something darker. For every landscape created in Everis, there exists a mirrored version, an alternate world consumed by shadows.

This is not a different map, but a distorted reflection of the same world. Familiar places become hostile. In this dark version, powerful enemies roam freely, far more dangerous than anything found in the main world.

Players will need courage, skill, and strong teamwork to venture into this extreme PvE experience. Every decision matters. Every encounter is a risk.

But with greater danger comes greater reward. This alternate world follows an extraction-based gameplay loop: players enter, explore, gather valuable loot… and must find a way to escape with it.

Build the world together

At any time, players can switch to creative mode and start shaping the world themselves.

Build a small cabin deep in the forest. Design a dungeon. Create a city. Sculpt mountains, valleys, or entirely new landscapes. Work alone, or collaborate with friends to bring larger ideas to life.

Once finished, your creation can be submitted to the community hub, where players discover new proposals, vote for their favorites, and share their own ideas.

At the end of each voting phase, the most appreciated creations are integrated into the shared world, allowing the universe of Everis to evolve organically through the imagination of its players.

Over time, the world grows. Not shaped by developers, but by the community itself.

How does it work?

The creative system allows players to modify a defined area of blocks, ranging from very small creations to much larger zones.

Small creations, such as a hidden object, a small structure, or a decorative element, usually have little impact on the surrounding world and may require fewer votes to be accepted. Larger creations, however, can influence a wider part of the world and potentially overlap with other proposals. Because of this, they require stronger community support to be approved and integrated.

After the Alpha phase, additional tools will expand these possibilities even further, allowing players to place items, NPCs, and logic-based elements such as doors and interactions. (See the Roadmap section for more details)

When players enter creative mode, they temporarily move into a separate instance of the area they are working on. This means they are no longer interacting with the live MMO world while building, allowing them to create freely and experiment in complete peace.

Once the creation is complete, it can be submitted to the community hub and voted on for integration into the shared world.

Everis is an ambitious project, and development will progress through several clear stages. Each phase focuses on validating core systems, expanding gameplay, and gradually opening the world to more players.

Phase 1 development has already begun, and core technical systems are currently being implemented.

Phase 1 - Alpha: Proving the Core Concept

The first milestone is the development of a playable Alpha version designed to prove that Everis works as intended.
This phase focuses on validating the core technical and gameplay foundations of the project.

During the Alpha, players will be able to:
• Explore the procedural voxel world in multiplayer
• Interact with other players through proximity voice and text chat
• Modify the world by placing and removing blocks (switching to creative mode)
• Create and submit constructions to the community hub
• Vote on community creations
• See the most voted creations integrated into the shared world

At this stage, Everis will focus on exploration and collaborative building. MMO-style features such as NPCs, quests, and advanced gameplay systems will not yet be included.

The Alpha will feature one biome (the one shown in the screenshots) and is mainly intended to validate the technical systems that make Everis possible.

Access to the Alpha will be limited. Selected players will be invited to participate in testing, for free.

Phase 2 - Beta: Expanding the World

Once the core systems are validated, Everis will move into Beta development.

During this stage, the game will evolve through regular updates. Each new version will focus on improving stability, fixing issues discovered during testing, and introducing new gameplay systems.

New biomes will progressively be added, encouraging players to explore further and generate new regions of the world.

Major gameplay systems will gradually be introduced during this phase, including:
• Character customization
• Level progression
• NPCs
• Quests
• Logic-based elements (doors, interactions, etc.)
• In-game currency
• Trading and player economy
• ...

The Beta phase will be available to the public as Early Access on Steam, allowing the community to actively participate in shaping the game as it grows.

Phase 3 - Version 1.0 Release

The final goal is the full release of Everis (Version 1.0).

This version will include the complete feature set presented in this Kickstarter campaign, bringing together exploration, player-driven world building, community integration systems, and the full MMO-inspired gameplay experience.

By this stage, Everis will have grown into a living world shaped by its players.

store_data.about_the_game:
Uncover the Truth Hidden Inside Data

Step into the role of a digital investigator in a world where crimes leave no fingerprints — only data trails.

In this immersive investigation simulation, you analyze personal devices, reconstruct timelines, and connect fragmented clues to uncover what really happened. Every message, transaction, and location ping could be the key to solving the case… or misleading you entirely.

🧠 Think Like a Detective

You are not given answers — only information.

  • Digital Traces: Browse through messages, call logs, browser history, and GPS records.

  • Evidence Management: Extract evidence and build your own freeform case board.

  • Logic & Reasoning: Connect clues, detect contradictions, and form your own conclusions.

  • Player Choice: Decide what is relevant. There is no hand-holding; only your logic.

🖥️ A Living Digital Interface

Navigate and master a fully interactive, OS-style interface:

  • Multi-tasking: Open and manage multiple apps just like a real device.

  • Deep Inspection: Switch between windows, inspect data, and cross-reference information.

  • Forensic Tools: Use tools like the Keyword Scanner and Pattern Analyzer to accelerate your investigation.

  • Flexible Organization: Organize your findings in a dynamic evidence board system.

🧩 Build Your Case

The truth doesn’t appear — you construct it.

  • Drag, position, and link clues freely on your board.

  • Visualize temporal and logical connections between events.

  • Spot hidden relationships between seemingly unrelated data.

  • Use analytical tools to reveal patterns you might have missed.

⚖️ Make the Final Decision

At the end of each case, the system won’t tell you the answer. Was the suspect telling the truth? Was the crime staged? Who is responsible? Your conclusions shape the outcome.

🎯 Key Features

  • 🖥️ OS-style interactive investigation interface

  • 📂 Multiple data sources: messages, GPS, bank, browser, gallery, and more

  • 🧩 Evidence board with freeform organization

  • ⚖️ Player-driven conclusions and outcomes

  • 🧠 Logic-focused gameplay — no hand-holding

You have arrived in a different city to take your exams. The friend you planned to live with fell ill. Now you are alone in an old apartment with a suspiciously low rent. During the day you are at the university, but every evening you return here to study and rest.

In this apartment there are two rooms, but one of them is always locked.

Features:

Post-Soviet horror: Atmosphere of a typical residential area and an old "panelka" apartment building.

4-night cycle: Return from your studies, prepare for exams, and try to ignore the oddities.

Locked door: Why is the door locked?

Psychological tension: The fear that you are not alone in this apartment.

Playtime:

Approximately 1 hour of atmospheric immersion.

store_data.about_the_game:
Lunaris is a fast, stylish sci-fi top-down roguelite shooter where every run escalates into a high-intensity battle of movement, firepower, and build strategy.

Pilot your ship through deadly wave-based combat, dodge incoming threats, and adapt on the fly as the arena fills with enemies, projectiles, and explosive effects. Early waves test precision and survival, while later stages reward smart scaling and strong synergy choices.

Build your power through passive DPS weapons and impactful active abilities. Mix close-range burst, long-range pressure, crowd control, and sustain to create a playstyle that fits your tempo.

Key Features:

  • Fast top-down combat focused on movement, positioning, and timing

  • Roguelite run flow with escalating waves, shop choices, and scaling builds

  • A wide pool of passive and active abilities for deep synergy crafting

  • Multiple viable playstyles: aggressive burst, safe poke, control, or hybrid

  • Strong sci-fi presentation with neon visuals, space atmosphere, and explosive action

In Lunaris, no two runs feel exactly the same. Experiment, adapt, and push your build from fragile beginnings to full late-run dominance.

store_data.about_the_game:
You have been assigned to the Federal Bureau of Determinations, Millbrook District.

Effective immediately.

Your job is simple. Claimants file for disability, retirement, and supplemental income benefits. You read the file. You check it against the manual. You stamp it.

Approve. Deny. Request additional information.

Every case comes with documents. An application. A physician letter, if they remembered to include one. An employer notice. Sometimes a personal statement that tells you what the claimant wants you to know about their situation, in their own words.

The manual covers most of it. The intake notes might point you in the right direction. Most of the time.

You have ten days. Dozens of cases. The Bureau expects accuracy, consistency, and throughput. It does not expect you to carry any of this home with you.

That part is on you.

What to Expect

  • 10-day narrative with hand-authored cases and consequences

  • Four endings — determined by your decisions, not a visible score

  • 80+ additional cases drawn from a pool by difficulty

  • No timer. No score. No morality meter.

The Determinator is a narrative desk simulation about the space between what the rules say and what they cost. Read the files. Make the calls. Your record will reflect your decisions.

Best experienced with headphones.

The rules are simple. The people aren't.

store_data.about_the_game:
A dream among the stars — or a nightmare.

1,000 colonists. One ship. A destination that may be fifty years away — or centuries. Some will land. Some will be born, age, and die in the dark between stars without ever knowing if the mission succeeded.

Dead Reckoning is a game about the slow, invisible erosion of civilization across generations. Every decision you make is defensible in the moment. The horror is retroactive.

Manage food, power, and hull integrity across centuries of deep space. Navigate crises, uprisings, and failures that compound silently into irreversible outcomes. The crew that arrives — if they arrive — may not remember where they came from, what they believed, or what it means to be human. A society of clones. A ship that has become a cathedral. An AI that no longer needs to ask permission.

Five forces reshape your colony across generations: genetic drift, ideological fracture, AI integration, technological regression, and class stratification. Every choice nudges the needle. None of them reset. The faction that rises in year 200 was built from decisions you made in year 40.

Settlement. Extinction. Digital transcendence. A ship that turns back. A crew that ascends without landing. Every run tells a different story. What reaches that planet is the sum of everything you did — and didn't do — across centuries in the dark.

You may not recognize it. You may not want to.

There can be random events, such as revelations of a player's romance with a pop star or social media controversy, which can effect the team morale and financial situation!

Users navigate complex, real-world-like management challenges, including interaction with the media, which can affect team and individual morale & prestige.

Games are displayed via a 2D engine, with options for detailed match analysis, tactics customization, and in-game substitutions. The challenge is there to win each game, keep players morale up and contend with controversy.

store_data.about_the_game:
THE GOLDEN AGE OF AIRLINES IS YOURS TO BUILD

You are the CEO. Starting with a handful of biplanes and a dream, build a globe-spanning airline from 1930 to 2020. Open routes, buy and lease aircraft, configure cabin classes, invest in airports, hire executives, and crush your rivals — all while history unfolds around you.

SkyChart: Airline Executive is a deep management simulation inspired by the classic Aerobiz series, rebuilt from the ground up with modern design, a retro-neon aesthetic, and systems deep enough to lose a weekend in.

AT A GLANCE

  • 4 historical eras from 1930 to 2020 — each unlocks by mastering the previous

  • 496 real-world cities across 8 regions with population-driven demand

  • 66 historical aircraft from DC-3 to A380 with realistic stats and retirement curves

  • 4 cabin classes (Economy, Premium Economy, Business, First) with per-class demand and era-gated unlocks

  • Up to 35 AI rival airlines with 4 distinct strategy archetypes (Budget, Regional, Legacy, Premium)

  • 190+ historical events — Great Depression, WWII, deregulation, 1973 oil crisis, 9/11, COVID-19

  • Live weather system with storm cells, pressure fronts, jet streams, and route re-planning

  • 100 achievements spanning operations, finance, history, and diplomacy

  • 17-chapter interactive tutorial hosted by Casey the Macaw, chief flight inspector

  • 29 languages (store-page translations rolling out EA → 1.0)

  • Full Steam Deck support with Steam Input API and automatic glyph detection

FOUR ERAS OF AVIATION

Play through four distinct chapters of airline history, each with unique aircraft, economics, and challenges:

  • Dawn of Flight (1930–1950) — Biplanes, flying boats, and the shadow of World War II. Connect the continents before the world tears itself apart.

  • The Jet Age (1955–1975) — The 707 rewrites everything. Dominate the transatlantic corridor and race your rivals across the globe.

  • The Modern Era (1980–2000) — Deregulation, oil crises, and cutthroat competition. Only the efficient survive.

  • Supersonic Future (2000–2020) — Ultra-long-haul routes, mega-hubs, and the A380 age. Build an empire that spans every continent — then survive COVID.

Each era must be conquered before the next unlocks. Prove you can survive the prop age before you earn the jets.

496 REAL-WORLD CITIES

From New York to Nairobi, Tokyo to Timbuktu — 496 cities across 8 world regions with real airport locations, population-driven demand, tourist appeal, and regional diplomacy that guide your expansion. Invest in hotels, theme parks, and infrastructure to boost demand. Upgrade airport hubs to dominate entire regions.

66 HISTORICAL AIRCRAFT

Fly the planes that made history. The DC-3, 707, 747, A380, 787, and more — each with historically accurate stats, retirement dates, and operating costs. Aircraft age realistically: old planes cost more to run, draw fewer passengers, and depreciate on a real curve. Order new-build aircraft on a realistic 1-9 month delivery backlog, lease for instant service, or store surplus frames in your hangar.

CABIN CLASS CONFIGURATION

Configure every route's seat mix: Economy, Premium Economy, Business, or First. Higher classes occupy more cabin space but earn 1.6×-4× the fare. Class availability is era-gated — First Class reappears in 1955, Business in 1960, Premium Economy in 1992 — so strategy shifts as decades pass. Six one-click templates (All Economy, Budget, Regional, Legacy, Premium, Luxury) or hand-tune per route with the stepper UI. AI rivals pick strategies too and stick to them.

LIVE WEATHER SYSTEM

A Ventusky-style weather map with animated storm cells (tropical round-with-eye, extratropical comma-heads), jet streams, pressure isobars, and cloud shading. Storms drift on prevailing winds — westerlies mid-latitude, trade easterlies in the tropics — and seed from real IBTrACS cyclone data. Route paths dynamically deviate around severe weather at FAA-style distances, and your airplanes' animated tracks update every 8 seconds as storms move.

BUY, LEASE, OR SCRAP

Every aircraft decision matters. Buy planes outright and build equity, or lease them to preserve cash with flexible 1-year, 3-year, or 5-year terms. Store surplus aircraft in your hangar for reuse. Refurbish aging fleets to extend their service life. Sell at depreciated market value when it's time to move on. Your rivals make these same calculations.

OUTSMART YOUR RIVALS

Up to 35 AI-controlled airlines compete for the same routes, slots, and passengers. Each picks one of four cabin strategies — Budget (all-economy), Regional (light premium), Legacy (full four-class), or Premium (first-heavy) — and sticks to it, so the competitive landscape feels distinct. They price dynamically, expand into your territory, upgrade their fleets, and invest in hubs. Once per era, you can buy out a rival entirely — absorbing their routes, slots, and infrastructure in one stroke.

HISTORY HAPPENS

190+ historical events and World Mega-Events reshape the playing field. The Great Depression tanks demand. WWII closes entire regions. The 1973 oil crisis doubles fuel prices overnight. 9/11 grounds the industry. COVID-19 kills 93% of passenger demand (but cargo barely flinches). Earthquakes destroy airports. Volcanic ash clouds close European airspace. You adapt or you fold.

DEEP ECONOMICS

Every route's profit is calculated monthly from population, regional economics, seasonal demand, your reputation, competitor pricing, hub bonuses, diplomatic relations, fuel costs, aircraft condition, cabin mix, transfer passenger flows, and executive team bonuses. The Strategic Advisor scans all 122,760 possible city pairs (threaded, non-blocking) to find your best opportunities. Quarterly reports track every dollar.

THREE GAME MODES

  • Passengers — Fill seats. Maximize yield per passenger. The classic airline business.

  • Cargo — Move freight. Win on price and reliability. Cargo barely flinches during pandemics.

  • Combined — Passengers in the cabin, freight in the belly. Two revenue streams, one fleet.

Each mode unlocks after mastering the previous one.

FIVE DIFFICULTY LEVELS

From Glider (generous capital, slow rivals) to Supersonic (lean budget, aggressive AI, punishing interest rates). Five finely tuned tiers so new players can learn the ropes and veterans can suffer.

SANDBOX MODE

Completed your first era? Unlock Sandbox. No bankruptcy. No era limits. No time pressure. Pick a starting decade and build forever.

YOUR COCKPIT
