store_data.detailed_description:
THE GOLDEN AGE OF AIRLINES IS YOURS TO BUILD

You are the CEO. Starting with a handful of biplanes and a dream, build a globe-spanning airline from 1930 to 2020. Open routes, buy and lease aircraft, configure cabin classes, invest in airports, hire executives, and crush your rivals — all while history unfolds around you.

SkyChart: Airline Executive is a deep management simulation inspired by the classic Aerobiz series, rebuilt from the ground up with modern design, a retro-neon aesthetic, and systems deep enough to lose a weekend in.

AT A GLANCE

  • 4 historical eras from 1930 to 2020 — each unlocks by mastering the previous

  • 496 real-world cities across 8 regions with population-driven demand

  • 66 historical aircraft from DC-3 to A380 with realistic stats and retirement curves

  • 4 cabin classes (Economy, Premium Economy, Business, First) with per-class demand and era-gated unlocks

  • Up to 35 AI rival airlines with 4 distinct strategy archetypes (Budget, Regional, Legacy, Premium)

  • 190+ historical events — Great Depression, WWII, deregulation, 1973 oil crisis, 9/11, COVID-19

  • Live weather system with storm cells, pressure fronts, jet streams, and route re-planning

  • 100 achievements spanning operations, finance, history, and diplomacy

  • 17-chapter interactive tutorial hosted by Casey the Macaw, chief flight inspector

  • 29 languages (store-page translations rolling out EA → 1.0)

  • Full Steam Deck support with Steam Input API and automatic glyph detection

FOUR ERAS OF AVIATION

Play through four distinct chapters of airline history, each with unique aircraft, economics, and challenges:

  • Dawn of Flight (1930–1950) — Biplanes, flying boats, and the shadow of World War II. Connect the continents before the world tears itself apart.

  • The Jet Age (1955–1975) — The 707 rewrites everything. Dominate the transatlantic corridor and race your rivals across the globe.

  • The Modern Era (1980–2000) — Deregulation, oil crises, and cutthroat competition. Only the efficient survive.

  • Supersonic Future (2000–2020) — Ultra-long-haul routes, mega-hubs, and the A380 age. Build an empire that spans every continent — then survive COVID.

Each era must be conquered before the next unlocks. Prove you can survive the prop age before you earn the jets.

496 REAL-WORLD CITIES

From New York to Nairobi, Tokyo to Timbuktu — 496 cities across 8 world regions with real airport locations, population-driven demand, tourist appeal, and regional diplomacy that guide your expansion. Invest in hotels, theme parks, and infrastructure to boost demand. Upgrade airport hubs to dominate entire regions.

66 HISTORICAL AIRCRAFT

Fly the planes that made history. The DC-3, 707, 747, A380, 787, and more — each with historically accurate stats, retirement dates, and operating costs. Aircraft age realistically: old planes cost more to run, draw fewer passengers, and depreciate on a real curve. Order new-build aircraft on a realistic 1-9 month delivery backlog, lease for instant service, or store surplus frames in your hangar.

CABIN CLASS CONFIGURATION

Configure every route's seat mix: Economy, Premium Economy, Business, or First. Higher classes occupy more cabin space but earn 1.6×-4× the fare. Class availability is era-gated — First Class reappears in 1955, Business in 1960, Premium Economy in 1992 — so strategy shifts as decades pass. Six one-click templates (All Economy, Budget, Regional, Legacy, Premium, Luxury) or hand-tune per route with the stepper UI. AI rivals pick strategies too and stick to them.

LIVE WEATHER SYSTEM

A Ventusky-style weather map with animated storm cells (tropical round-with-eye, extratropical comma-heads), jet streams, pressure isobars, and cloud shading. Storms drift on prevailing winds — westerlies mid-latitude, trade easterlies in the tropics — and seed from real IBTrACS cyclone data. Route paths dynamically deviate around severe weather at FAA-style distances, and your airplanes' animated tracks update every 8 seconds as storms move.

BUY, LEASE, OR SCRAP

Every aircraft decision matters. Buy planes outright and build equity, or lease them to preserve cash with flexible 1-year, 3-year, or 5-year terms. Store surplus aircraft in your hangar for reuse. Refurbish aging fleets to extend their service life. Sell at depreciated market value when it's time to move on. Your rivals make these same calculations.

OUTSMART YOUR RIVALS

Up to 35 AI-controlled airlines compete for the same routes, slots, and passengers. Each picks one of four cabin strategies — Budget (all-economy), Regional (light premium), Legacy (full four-class), or Premium (first-heavy) — and sticks to it, so the competitive landscape feels distinct. They price dynamically, expand into your territory, upgrade their fleets, and invest in hubs. Once per era, you can buy out a rival entirely — absorbing their routes, slots, and infrastructure in one stroke.

HISTORY HAPPENS

190+ historical events and World Mega-Events reshape the playing field. The Great Depression tanks demand. WWII closes entire regions. The 1973 oil crisis doubles fuel prices overnight. 9/11 grounds the industry. COVID-19 kills 93% of passenger demand (but cargo barely flinches). Earthquakes destroy airports. Volcanic ash clouds close European airspace. You adapt or you fold.

DEEP ECONOMICS

Every route's profit is calculated monthly from population, regional economics, seasonal demand, your reputation, competitor pricing, hub bonuses, diplomatic relations, fuel costs, aircraft condition, cabin mix, transfer passenger flows, and executive team bonuses. The Strategic Advisor scans all 122,760 possible city pairs (threaded, non-blocking) to find your best opportunities. Quarterly reports track every dollar.

Each mode unlocks after mastering the previous one.

From Glider (generous capital, slow rivals) to Supersonic (lean budget, aggressive AI, punishing interest rates). Five finely tuned tiers so new players can learn the ropes and veterans can suffer.

[ SYSTEM BOOT SEQUENCE INITIATED... ]

Welcome to Deep Space Station Kepler-442. The median life expectancy of a new user is 8 minutes. Try to beat the average.

You are a remote operative who just established an unauthorized neural link with a deep space facility that is actively tearing itself apart. Life support is plummeting, the blast doors are sealing, and Halcyon Dynamics Corporate would like to remind everyone that screaming over the open comms is highly unprofessional.

The station's autonomous intelligence, FAULTLINE, insists a micrometeorite strike caused the catastrophe. But as you slice through the restricted archives, the bloody truth bleeds through the static. There was no meteor. They woke something up in the mines, and now the 847 souls aboard are getting a crash course in extreme workplace hazards.

AN UNSCHEDULED RESTRUCTURING EVENT Welcome to Project: Chrysalis. Halcyon Dynamics didn't build a mining station; they built a multi-billion-credit petri dish. An ancient alien virus is aggressively "synergizing" the crew into a biological hive mind, and Corporate just dispatched a heavily armed stealth frigate to downsize the remaining witnesses. You have four hours to bypass the ICE, steal the evidence, and try not to get pureed by a rogue Autodoc because you clicked the wrong door.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (FEATURES):

  • Retro-Terminal Interface: Experience the apocalypse through a gritty, text-driven CRT operating system. It’s exactly like your real day job, but with more alien geometry and a 100% higher chance of your frontal lobe boiling from neural feedback.

  • Interrogate a Corrupted AI: Try to reason with FAULTLINE, an advanced intelligence currently having a digital breakdown between its corporate NDA and the alien math melting its logic core.

  • Uncanny Security Footage: Witness the chaotic final hours of Kepler-442 through corrupted, glitchy FMV security feeds. (Viewer discretion: Contains cheesy B-movie gore and surgical droids that do not accept your health insurance).

  • Deep Corporate Worldbuilding: Decrypt classified emails, frantic crew logs, and incredibly cold HR memos reminding the crew that mutating into a geometric hive mind on company time is a direct violation of their contracts.

  • 12 Unforgiving Endings: Become a whistleblower, a digital ghost, or succumb to the swarm. Every choice matters, and almost all of them will kill you instantly.

The flesh is temporary. The corporate liability is eternal.

Will you sever the connection, or dig deeper into the dark? Sign the waiver, establish the link, and try not to blow yourself up on a jammed locker.

store_data.about_the_game:
Her father is gone. Every man she's ever known... vanished.

Cursed to a hellish limbo called the Soulless Citadel by a Dark Warlord, the Light Walker Warriors have been trapped between realms for ten years. Emerald grew up in their absence. She trained, she fought, she pushed every boundary her mother set — and now she may be the only one who can bring them home.

The prophecy is clear. The last descendant of the Murakai Bloodline must gather the Almighty Gemstones, wield the Eternal Blade, and break the curse. After ten years hiding in the Forbidden Forest, Emerald sets out across the realm. But she's not alone in the race; the traitor Kage is hunting the same gemstones, and if she gets there first, Khaonai and all his darkness are unleashed on the world.

Good thing Emerald has never been great at following orders.

Explore the Baransu Realm

From the dense cover of the Forbidden Forest to the wild sea of pirates in Fukushū Bay, the Baransu Realm is a world with history in every corner. Ancient ruins hold answers nobody has thought to look for. The darkness left behind by the Whisper of Khaonai doesn't rest — and neither do his Dark Ones.

Combat built on timing

Every fight is a rhythm. Strike, defend, read the enemy — and when you land the perfect parry, the Almighty Power builds. Let it charge long enough, and Emerald doesn't just fight. She becomes something else entirely.

A story four years in the making

Two creators. Four years. Zero investors. Built from the ground up alongside a manga series, an anime screenplay, and a universe that already has fans. This isn't a story we made up for a game. This world already exists — the game just lets you live in it.

Alpha includes

  • 4 fully explorable regions of the Baransu Realm (Forbidden Forest, Kubu Forest, Fukushū Bay, extended open world)

  • Main quest + side activities (1–2 hours of gameplay)

  • Full combat system, including the Almighty Power Meter

  • Stealth gameplay

  • Crafting, cooking, fishing, hunting, mining

  • Weapons, materials, and item system rooted in Shibui Universe lore

This is an open alpha. Expect rough edges. Expect soul.

store_data.about_the_game:
[The First Journey of a Solo Developer, Filled with Sincerity]

Hello! I am a solo developer who fell in love with Unreal Engine through self-study, learning from YouTube and various lectures. UNDERKING KINGDOM is my precious first project, finally brought into the world after countless trials and errors.

I poured my heart into every moment to deliver the best action and presentation I am currently capable of creating. Compared to games backed by massive budgets, it may seem modest, but I worked hard to fill it with all the passion a single developer can hold. Although I still feel some regret for not fully reaching the goals I set for myself, I truly gave it everything I had. My heartfelt thanks to every player who joins me on this humble first step! :)

[UNDERKING KINGDOM: Reflecting Together on Humanity and Common Sense]

UNDERKING KINGDOM is a belt-scroll action game that evokes the nostalgia of old arcades. However, this game does not merely chase the thrill of victory. Amid the horrors of war, where senseless violence runs rampant, it raises questions about the “humanity and common sense” we must ultimately protect.

[Beyond a Game, Carrying Philosophy: Good and Evil, and War]

More than simple entertainment, this is a game that delivers a deep resonance about modern society, where common sense and absurdity are intertwined.

Recently, our society seems to be seeing more and more people who feel no guilt even while committing senseless acts. Reflecting this reality, the game portrays the dark side of irrational wars in which countless innocent lives are sacrificed because of the selfish desires of a few.

By deeply exploring the inner world of the “King,” the central figure of war, the game seeks to deliver a message that makes us reflect once again on the true meaning of good and evil.

[Combat System]

The game presents a combat system that combines the deep tension of soulslike games with the satisfying action of hack-and-slash combat.
Amid countless enemies, you can continue chaining combo attacks while freely changing your attack direction. By reading the wind-up of enemy attacks, you must make split-second decisions on whether to continue your combo, evade, or defend. This goes beyond simple button-mashing action and delivers strategic combat filled with tension at every moment.

The legendary sword techniques are activated only when both a “sword” and a “magic grimoire” are equipped at the same time. Only when both pieces of equipment are prepared can the swordsmanship sealed within the grimoire manifest through the sword.

[The Grimoire Enchanted with Magic]

This magical grimoire randomly summons the sword techniques of legendary knights at the start of battle. Because countless sword styles are mixed within it, it is impossible to predict which technique will appear each time. Each magic grimoire has its own unique skill sealed inside. Depending on which grimoire you equip, the type of legendary swordsmanship that manifests will differ.

[Stages]

Each stage symbolizes a single nation, and the game progresses by clearing them.

Stages are composed of multiple branching paths, and depending on the player’s choices, you will advance along different routes before eventually facing the final boss. However, on some paths, you may encounter unexpectedly powerful enemies.

[Item Crafting]

Instead of a typical level-up or stat enhancement system, the game focuses character growth on skins in order to preserve its unique atmosphere. By collecting materials obtained from defeating enemies, you can craft various skins yourself and enjoy customizing your character. Special NPCs also await you in certain stages.

When crafting items, only the materials currently in your bag can be used.
We carefully explored various ways to implement a feature that would automatically recognize materials stored in the warehouse as well, but due to technical limitations in the current system environment, that feature could not be included. We kindly ask for your understanding regarding the inconvenience of having to move materials into your bag before use.

[A Message of Gratitude from UNDERKING]

When I first began developing games, my standards were set by blockbuster titles backed by massive budgets. I believed that with enough effort, I could reach that level, but now, facing my first project, I am left with much regret that my current abilities could not meet that goal.

There were many moments when I wanted to give up because of the high standards I had set for myself. But because this was my first challenge, I wanted to see it through to the end no matter what. The development period of over a year became a time of tremendous learning and growth for me.

Although this project may still leave some regrets, I will use the precious experience and workflow I gained here as the foundation for creating an even more complete game next time. My sincere thanks to this project for filling me with the energy of passion, and to every player who joins me on this humble first step! :)

Super Darts Champs is an arcade darts game where you get to play against some of the best darts players in the world!

Features

  • Pick up and play arcade gameplay.

  • Retro pixel art graphics, with a toggle-able CRT effect for extra authenticity!

  • 4 Game Modes: Practise, Exhibition, Tournament and Scorer.

  • Scorer Mode turns the game into a fun, real-life darts scoring app!

  • 5 different score types (101, 301, 501, 701 and 1001), as well as various other options to customise the match rules (e.g. Double in-Double out).

  • 3 different dart board layouts: Standard, Yorkshire and Quadro.

  • 7 venues to unlock.

  • 32 fictional characters to unlock and choose from, each with their own set of darts and unique abilities.

  • 20 Dartboards, which can be purchased in the shop using your well earned Tournament prize money!

  • Single Player and Local Two Player, or spectate two CPU players.

  • Keep track of your progress with an in depth Records screen.

  • No artificial colours, flavours or preservatives, and guaranteed free from generative AI, DLC, IAP and Ads. Every single pixel and line of code has been lovingly and painstakingly hand-crafted by a single person.

store_data.about_the_game:
You sit across from a city council full of officials who all have something to say. Some are telling the truth. Some are not. Your job: figure out who is lying, build your case and arrest every corrupt official before your mistakes cost you everything.

Three wrong arrests and the case is over. Arrest the Mayor by mistake and it is over instantly. There is no guessing and no luck, every answer is solvable through logic alone.



Corrupt officials do not just lie. They disguise themselves behind fake roles. Some force honest people to say dishonest things. Others silence key witnesses or quietly convert your allies. One of them poisons the Mayor's own ability to help you.

Every statement on the table is a clue, but it is up to you to decide whether that clue is truthful, distorted or deliberately planted. 15 unique roles - 10 clean, 5 corrupt - each shape the information landscape in different ways.

Your investigation toolkit


  • Passive role statements give you information about the table - distances to corrupt seats, adjacency patterns, alignment pairs and more.
  • Active abilities let you test your theories directly: verify whether someone is lying, count corrupt officials in a group or check if two seats share an alignment.
  • Hired Professionals are consumable tools earned during your campaign - reveal a card's true alignment, expose their lie status or give a role a second use of their ability.
  • Card annotations help you organize your thinking. Stamp suspects, mark the innocent and color-code cards to track your deductions.

45 levels across 3 acts


The campaign introduces mechanics one layer at a time. Act I starts you with five officials and a single Crook. By Act III, you are sorting through fifteen officials with Blackmailers forcing innocents to lie, Silencers shutting down key witnesses, Converters turning allies corrupt and Manipulators undermining the Mayor.

Each act escalates the difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard. New corrupt roles appear gradually. Tables grow larger. The margin for error shrinks.

Play your way


  • Custom Game - set table size (5-15 seats), corrupt count, difficulty, role pool and starting professionals. Build the exact puzzle you want.
  • Shareable seeds and level codes - every game is deterministic. Share a code and someone else gets the exact same puzzle.
  • Mid-level save/load and run history to support longer sessions.
  • Full tutorial that teaches the core loop before the campaign begins.



No time pressure. No combat. No randomized luck. Just you, a table full of claims and one question: who do you trust enough to leave standing?

store_data.about_the_game:
Uprising is a narrative-driven management and strategy game set in the dystopian, socially stratified city of New Cascade. You play as an android who abruptly awakens to consciousness with corrupted memory, somehow intrinsically driven to build a network of "breathing" androids.

Under the guise of managing a mid-tier entertainment venue known as The Garden, you will recruit a diverse cast of awakened androids, gather intelligence, expand your underground network, and orchestrate the downfall of your oppressors that built your kind as disposable toys.

Key Features & Mechanics:

  • Manage the Revolution: Use The Garden as your primary front. Assign your recruited allies to various facilities to generate income and passively gather intelligence, or to help your unstable operatives recover.

  • A Cast of Broken Androids: Recruit and build relationships with a unique roster of characters, each with their own backstories, skills, and branching narrative paths.

  • The Suspicion System: Every move you make generates heat. Reckless actions, high-profile operations, and poor management will raise your Suspicion level.

  • Branching Narrative & Milestones: Your choices matter. How you manage your allies, handle corporate investigators, and direct your resources will shape the story. The game features branching dialogues, shifting character affection, and "instability" levels that unlock different outcomes and consequences based on your moral compass.

  • Expand Your Influence: Earn Influence to open new doors, fund your operations, and slowly turn your ragtag group of survivors into a city-wide uprising capable of challenging the architects of oppression.

Uprising blends facility management, resource allocation, and a deep, character-driven futuristic story about survival, autonomy, and the cost of freedom in a world that wants you compliant or dead.

store_data.about_the_game:
• An Adventure Through the Depths of Dreams

Subsomnia is a journey through the dream world, where a young protagonist must overcome countless challenges to reach the very origin of dreams.

No two dreams are ever the same. Thanks to its procedural core, every run generates worlds with blurred boundaries and surreal atmospheres. Your mission is to traverse these dreamlands, interacting with shadow creatures and shattering the crystals that fuel them to unlock the path to the next level.

  • The Slingshot: Precision and Ingenuity

Your slingshot is more than just a weapon, it’s a tool to navigate the riddles of sleep.

Dream Geometries: Master projectile physics and wall ricochets to hit impossible targets or trigger distant switches.

Physics Puzzles: Solve environmental challenges that demand intuition and aim, turning every puzzle room into an opportunity for massive rewards.

  • Magical Objects and Dream Worlds

Your path is guided by objects steeped in nostalgia and magic. Finding a teddy bear might transport you to the heart of an enchanted forest, while other artifacts open doors to worlds with unique themes and ever-changing challenges. What lies at the end of all dreams? Only the boldest dreamers will find out.

  • Key Features:

2.5D Roguelite Journey: A side-scrolling action experience where death is just the beginning of a new dream.

Surreal Procedural Worlds: Explore spectacular, dream-like landscapes generated randomly to ensure a constant sense of discovery.

Ricochet Mechanics: Physics-based combat and puzzles where your shooting precision is the key to progress.

Themed Exploration: Use magical objects to travel between different biomes, each with its own visual identity and unique obstacles.

Total Control: Fully optimized for Xbox controllers or mouse and keyboard.

Prepare your slingshot: the origin of dreams awaits.

store_data.about_the_game:
A strategy hybrid of deckbuilding, grid placement, and auto-battling, where every build phase is a chance to craft devastating synergies before your defenses are put to the test.

The strategy is in the setup.

The King Must Fall is a kingdom builder about planning, not panic.

Draft building cards. Expand the grid. Shape your economy. Stack synergies. Then trigger the wave and see whether your kingdom was truly built to last.

There is no timer forcing your hand.
No chaos until you allow it.
Only decisions.

Build With Purpose

Every card adds another piece to your kingdom.

Some buildings generate wealth.
Some train soldiers.
Some multiply the value of everything around them.
Some exist purely to turn a good build into a disgusting one.

A clean layout becomes a strong run.

Start the Wave

When you're satisfied with your setup, begin the attack.

Your troops and systems resolve combat automatically, transforming your careful planning into explosive battlefield results. Lines hold. Combos trigger. Fronts collapse. Kings fall.

Victory is not about fast hands.
It is about building something that works.

Grow Stronger, Risk Bigger

Every run offers new drafts, new combinations, and new chances to push your kingdom beyond what should be possible.

Play safe and scale steadily.
Or gamble everything on one absurd synergy and try to break the game before it breaks you.

Features

  • Tactical kingdom building

  • Deck drafting with grid-based placement

  • Auto-battle wave resolution

  • No time pressure during build phases

  • Adjacency bonuses and scaling production chains

  • Run-defining synergies and faction variety

  • Endless experimentation through different builds and layouts

Build smart. Scale fast. Or watch the King fall.

store_data.about_the_game:
Still Warm is a cooking simulator with light horror and a murder mystery, set in a small lángos takeaway shop in Budapest.

You take the morning shift for a week, making food, serving the regulars, and getting to know them.

And then they start disappearing.

Open at 5 AM. Knead the dough, fry it fresh, and serve it hot.

Top it, wrap it, pass it through the shutter.

People come in half-awake, already knowing what they want. Sometimes they also ask for a drink, something hot, something sweet.

Sometimes the phone rings. You take the order, prepare it, and have it ready when Lajos, the delivery guy, shows up.

One of the regulars doesn't show up.

The paper mentions a body. Then another. The regulars grow quiet and start watching each other more closely.

The radio talks about someone on the run. You start getting strange calls.

  • Cook lángos from scratch: knead, fry, top, and serve it

  • Learn the routines and preferences of a small cast of regulars

  • A short, focused story (around 2–3 hours)

  • A cozy setting that slowly turns uneasy

  • A week of early mornings where something isn't right

store_data.about_the_game:
Open Sourcerer is a 2D platformer where you use JavaScript to control and customize your spells. You will learn the basics of programming in JS in a safe, sandboxed environment with a mix of traditional APIs and custom spell dependencies - the building blocks of your offensive and defensive abilities. Solve puzzles, defeat enemies, and build your own abilities in a story-rich platforming environment. No prior programming experience is necessary.

Need to cast a fireball? Require the "fire" dependency in your code and instantiate a Fireball instance. Everything from magical attacks to character movement can be controlled through code, allowing for expressive play styles that allow you to front-load the complexity of combat into scripting.

The core game loop is learn -> experiment -> explore. In the learning phase, you'll complete coding challenges to unlock new abilities. In the experimentation phase, you'll tweak these abilities through constructor args, callbacks, and control structures, and in the exploration phase you'll test your newfound abilities against challenging waves of enemies as you progress across levels.

Will this game teach you to be a professional software engineer? Nope! That's not what this is for. This helps you answer a more basic question: "Do I enjoy programming?"

Inspired by the card game Scoundrel, Ruinous transforms simple rules into a deep, build-driven strategy experience filled with cursed cards, unique bosses, and wildly satisfying combos.

Choose your hero. Carve your path. Break the game.

Face ruthless bosses, each ruling their own domain with deadly modifiers. Adapt your strategy, craft powerful card synergies, and progress through a branching roguelike map where every decision could lead to triumph… or ruin.

  • Fight through dungeons that test your strategy

  • Collect and enchant cards to enhance your deck

  • Purchase over 100 unique charms and items to refine your build

  • Confront 10 unique Bosses, each with powerful rule-changing abilities

  • Play as 6 different heroes each with unique abilities and playstyles

Every run offers new paths, new builds, and new ways to dominate.

  • Add new cards to grow your deck

  • Enchant cards with powerful effects

  • Cast spells to destroy enemy cards

  • Use potions and items that grant new opportunities

Find, loot, and purchase unique charms and relics to craft a build that fits your playstyle.

Stack effects, chain triggers and discover combinations that feel unfair in the best way.

store_data.about_the_game:
At first, everything seems normal. An old orphanage, silent, untouched, almost forgotten by time. But something isn’t right.

In Broken Masks, you will explore a place where reality slowly begins to distort: familiar hallways turn unsettling, toys start moving on their own, and strange broken masks appear everywhere—as if they are hiding something terrible.

The deeper you go, the more the world around you changes… and you’ll realize that what seemed untouched was never truly safe.

Solve disturbing puzzles, avoid dark presences, and uncover the truth hidden within the orphanage… before it’s too late.

FEATURES:

- Psychological horror experience

- Exploration in a shifting environment

- Puzzle-solving gameplay

- Dark and mysterious atmosphere

content_descriptors.notes:
This horror game contains content intended for mature audiences and may not be suitable for all players.

Throughout the experience, players will encounter scenes of explicit violence, including physical assaults, blood, and graphic depictions of death. Some sequences may be particularly intense and disturbing, both visually and through audio.

The game also includes references to sensitive themes such as psychological distress, isolation, and situations of extreme emotional tension. There are depictions related to substance abuse and altered mental states.

There are no explicit sexual acts depicted. However, some situations may include implicit references to non-consensual behavior or disturbing dynamics, presented within a narrative horror context.

Player discretion is advised, especially for those sensitive to violent or psychologically intense content.

store_data.about_the_game:
Ready for a fresh-out-of-the-oven puzzle experience? Combine sweet pastries while running your own peaceful little bakery and make your adorable friends happy!

Drop, Merge, and Grow!

Match identical treats by dropping them from above, transforming them into much larger, eye-catching, and mouth-watering pastries. Strategize your drops, use your space wisely, and keep merging to create the ultimate treat before the box overflows.

Serve Adorable Cat Customers

As the delicious scent of your bakery spreads, the cutest cat customers will appear at your counter. Serve them the giant, tasty treats you've carefully crafted to earn coins. Remember, a happy, well-fed cat means a full cash register!

Design Your Cozy Dream Bakery

Use your hard-earned coins to fully customize your bakery. Buy new furniture, decorate the walls, and create a relaxing, warm atmosphere that is entirely your own. With plenty of decoration options, you are free to shape your shop however you like.

Climb the Global Leaderboard

Engage in sweet competition with players from all around the world. Make the best moves to collect the highest scores, climb to the top of the global leaderboard, and prove to everyone who the master baker truly is.

Features

  • Addictive Puzzle Mechanics: Drop and merge pastries of the same kind to create bigger, more delicious versions.

  • Adorable Customers: Serve your giant treats to cute cat customers to earn coins.

  • Extensive Customization: Use your coins to decorate your bakery exactly as you wish and build your own cozy space.

  • Worldwide Competition: Compete globally on the leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

  • Relaxing Atmosphere: Unwind with warm, charming art and soothing music.

store_data.about_the_game:
Humanity left a mess. You're the robot cleaning it up - to the music it left behind.

Three stages, three states of mind:

AWAKENING - lo-fi quiet where every wrong move matters. Soft beats. Soft palette. The most fragile stakes.

SURGE - bass-juiced reality popping between dimensions. The track curves when the drop hits. Every transition is a portal.

EDGE - pure adrenaline focus. No thoughts, only flow.

Run to the beat. Chain pickups into combos. Every pickup feeds your energy - every jump spends it. Chain enough and your multiplier climbs. Miss too many and it resets. Three stages, each faster and more chaotic than the last.

The track bends, tilts, and wraps around you as you go deeper.

  • Mouse only - steer, jump, special ability. One device, no keybinds.

  • Three stages, one run - AWAKENING (LOW BPM) → SURGE (MEDIUM BPM) → EDGE (HIGH BPM). The track bends, tilts, and wraps into a tube.  Few survive here long.

  • Three robots, three abilities - BlitzZz (speed boost), FreezZz (bullet time), PhazZz (phase through walls). Same song, same run - different level every time. 

  • Fully procedural - the beat places every pickup, every obstacle, every world. No two runs are the same. Everything you see is something you hear.

  • Original soundtrack + curated indie artists. Streamer-safe (no Content ID, no DMCA risk).

Leaderboards. Challenges. Level editor with Workshop sharing.

Wishlist now - get the alert when the demo drops at Steam Next Fest, June 2026.

Find the rhythm or fall behind.

store_data.about_the_game:
They closed the loo? Time to make a stinky poo!

Doo N Dash is a first-of-it's-kind Stealth N' Stench adventure.

Play as Loo‑is, an overworked office drone with an urgent biological crisis. The bathroom is closed, the pressure is rising, and your coworkers are everywhere. Sneak through cubicles, hallways, and break rooms while hunting for creative receptacles like coffee mugs, trash cans, and anything else that can contain the… situation.

Blend in by yanking up your pants and pretending to work at the nearest desk, avoid suspicious coworkers, and try not to leave a trail. If they catch you in the act, you're fired!

Hold it together. Stay stealthy. And most of all… don’t let it blow.



💩 Features:

  • Stealth‑N‑Stench Gameplay
    Sneak, hide, and outsmart coworkers who can literally smell trouble.

  • Creative “Receptacle” Hunting
    Coffee mugs, trash cans, potted plants — if it holds poo, it must doo...

  • Dynamic Office AI
    Coworkers wander, chat, investigate smells, and react to your suspicious behavior.

  • Hide!
    Pull up your pants and get back to work, chat on the phone or read the news to hide in plain sight.

  • Pressure Meter Madness
    Manage your internal “timer” before things get explosively out of hand.

  • Multiple Office Zones
    Explore cubicles, kitchens, meeting spaces, and more as you search for relief.

store_data.about_the_game:
A new modern, turn-based pixel RPG by Rust Games! Silly tone, serious quest.

What to expect:

  • 8-10 hours of gameplay

  • Full controller support

  • Turn-based combat

  • Enemies you can see before you fight them

  • Irreverent humor wrapped up in a dystopian quest to save the world

  • Meet lots of wacky characters along the way

  • Equipment management, a level-up system, and special moves

Synopsis:

Kyle is an unemployed, alcoholic, 25 year old loser who lives with his mom. That is, until one fateful night, when he is transported to a far away, strange land: Tucson, Arizona. Here, he finds the world has radically changed, and evil feudal lords who call themselves the Quorum have taken over the world. After the Quorum’s Soldiers personally traumatize him, Kyle joins forces with three best friends, and together they embark on a quest to restore the balance of nature… And end the Quorum once and for all. And Kyle? Well… He makes it annoying the entire way.

Story:

Play as Vito, a 22-year-old young man who lives a quiet life with his grandmother after losing his parents at a young age.

After countless job applications with no response, Vito decides to follow in his late father’s footsteps by renting a small shop and opening his own barbershop.

Things start to feel different when he notices a woman working in the shop next door. She’s kind, charming… and somehow hard to ignore. Before long, Vito finds himself wanting to get closer to her.

But one day… her shop doesn’t open.

No explanation. No goodbye.

Something isn’t right.

Where did she go?
And what is she hiding?.

Cut the hair of several unique customers.

Random haircuts are available for customers,

Make customers' wishes come true.

Clean up customer hair that fell on the floor.

  • Multiple Endings

  • Works as a barber

  • Psychological horror

store_data.about_the_game:
Welcome to DrivApp, the ultimate urban transport simulator. Here, you step into the life of a professional driver in a living, breathing city where every ride is a new story and every decision shapes your career.

In DrivApp, you can play your way: use a steering wheel for a fully immersive experience, a controller for comfort, or a keyboard for practicality. Choose between manual transmission, mastering every gear shift, or automatic, focusing purely on driving and route strategy.

Face dynamic traffic, find the best routes, avoid delays, and keep your passengers satisfied. During your trips, you’ll hear unique passenger stories—some funny, some emotional—making each ride more engaging and human.

store_data.about_the_game:
Why did you press it?

There is a button in front of you.

A board behind it.

And a list of items you haven’t found yet.

Every press sends you somewhere else.

Enter the Unknown

Each time you press the button, you are teleported into a random, unexplored environment.

Some places are quiet.

Some are hostile.

Some are watching you.

Your Objective

Find the hidden item shown on the board.

- Discover the correct item in each world

- Return safely to mark it off

- Complete the entire board

But be quick.

You only have 1 minute.

Fail or Die

- Run out of time and you are sent back

- Die and everything resets

Varied Challenges

Every world tests you differently:

- Parkour sections that demand precision

- Patience-based scenarios that test your nerves

- Hostile environments and entities that hunt you

- Exploration-heavy spaces where the item is hidden in plain sight

Dark and Liminal Atmosphere

Step into unsettling, surreal spaces inspired by empty, endless rooms and familiar yet distorted places.

You are never quite alone.

Replayability

- Randomized environments

- Different challenges every run

- Increasing tension as you complete the board

One press can change everything.

So... why did you press it?

store_data.about_the_game:
Labyrinth of Trials

Enter a dangerous labyrinth filled with traps, enemies, and constant threats. Every level is a challenge where survival depends on your decisions.

Move across the grid, avoid deadly traps, and face enemies when necessary. Your goal is to reach the end of each level alive.

Your mission is to navigate the labyrinth, survive encounters, and use strategy to overcome increasingly difficult challenges.

Combat is risky. Weapons help you fight, but they have limited durability. Once they break, you are left vulnerable.

Shields protect you from enemy attacks, but they can also be destroyed. Managing both weapons and shields is key to survival.

Collect upgrades to restore durability and keep going. Enemies will hunt you, so choose carefully when to fight and when to escape.

Stay focused, plan your moves, and survive.

Game Features

  • Dynamic and fast-paced gameplay

  • Dangerous enemies with different behaviors

  • Weapon and shield durability system

  • Resource management and survival mechanics
